cases.situation: At 11:20 I replied-all on the Northwind client thread and it went to their whole distribution list, including my boss Karen's joke that their CFO is 'hard work'. I've recalled it, which caught about half the recipients, and drafted a note to Priya, our contact there. Need to tell Karen on Slack right now.

The calendar invite I sent everyone for the team offsite said Friday, but it's Thursday 29 October. I've already updated the invite; small thing, but people might book trains. Posting in the team channel.
我是公司出纳，昨天给供应商华诚包装重复付了一笔货款，多付了38,000元，今天上午对账才发现，原因是我提交前没核对付款记录。我已经联系了对方财务刘姐，她确认收到两笔，同意本周五前退回。要跟财务总监王总说，怎么开口？

I'm a freelance email marketer. This morning I sent my client Rachel's newsletter to 8,400 subscribers with the code FALL40 instead of FALL14; 31 orders have used it, about $1,100 more in discounts than planned. I turned FALL40 off at 11:20, and I need to email her now.

I'm a junior analyst. On 15 September I sent the Q3 pricing deck to our VP, Marisa, and just found a formula on slide 6 pointing at the wrong range: monthly churn is 4.1%, not 2.4%. She's quoted the 2.4% in the board pre-read for the October 8 meeting, which hasn't gone out yet; I've corrected the deck and rechecked every other figure. I need to tell my manager Tom first.
我是部门经理，答应帮组员陈佳提交今年的晋升材料，结果系统9月25号就截止了，我记成了30号，没交上。今天上午问了HR周姐，可以走补录，但要部门总监刘总签字；下一轮是明年3月。她还不知道，今天要跟她说。
今朝、取引先の山本様に旧単価のままの見積書を送ってしまった。10時半に訂正版を送り、山本様にも電話で経緯を説明済み。部長に報告したら「またか。先月も似たようなミスがあったよね」と言われた。どう返せばいい？

I was cleaning up our team's shared slide deck last night and accidentally deleted my colleague Priya's six slides for her Harlow client pitch this Thursday. I restored four from version history, but her two pricing comparison slides are gone. She doesn't know yet.
我是后端开发。今天上午10:15上线订单提醒功能时发送任务配置写错了，大约12000个用户每人收到了三条一样的短信，多出的短信费约1200元。10:32我已经回滚，客服的统一回复口径也发给了小林。要马上在工作群里跟技术负责人周总说。

I'm a project coordinator at an architecture firm. This morning I submitted the Elm Street extension planning application with the August drawings, which show the old roof height, instead of the revised set; the council validated it at 11, and I've emailed the planning officer, Ms Okafor, asking her to call me today. My director Paul is on site, so I'm calling him now.

My manager Deepa just messaged me 'Why am I hearing from finance that Monday's invoice batch failed?' I spotted it yesterday afternoon and was planning to fix it before telling her: 46 invoices, about $38,000, didn't go out because I uploaded the file with last quarter's tax code. I've corrected it, it's re-running now, and finance will confirm by 3pm.

Ich bin Werkstudentin in einer Webagentur und kümmere mich um die Domainverlängerungen. Die Domain unseres Kunden Bäckerei Hoffmann ist heute Nacht abgelaufen, weil die hinterlegte Kreditkarte ungültig war und ich die Warnmail übersehen habe; Website und E-Mail sind seit 6 Uhr down. Ich habe die Domain um 8:40 mit der Firmenkarte verlängert, laut Anbieter kann es bis zu 24 Stunden dauern, und ich muss es jetzt meinem Chef Herrn Brandt sagen.

In standup this morning our lead Anna said Leo's deploy broke staging yesterday. It was actually my config change at 4:10pm; Leo deployed right after me and it surfaced then, and I reverted my change at 9:20 today, since when staging has been green. Leo looked embarrassed and didn't say anything, and I want to message Anna now.

I'm the office coordinator at a physiotherapy clinic. At 10:15 I picked the wrong contact from autofill and emailed our linen supplier, Crisp Linen, a spreadsheet meant for our billing company: 230 patients' names, phone numbers and appointment dates. I've called their office manager, Dave, who is deleting it and will confirm in writing; now I need to tell the practice manager, Helen.

I'm Ms Harper and I teach Year 9 maths. The algebra test grades I posted to the parent portal last Friday were wrong: my answer key for question 7 had an error, so all 28 students lost 4 marks they'd earned. I've corrected the grades on the portal and explained it to the class this morning; three parents have already emailed, and I want to message all the parents.
上周交的差旅报销里，我不小心把一张私人聚餐的发票（426元）也夹进去了，今天发现时报销款已经打到我卡上。想跟财务李姐说清楚。

Yesterday I told my manager Owen that I'd sent the Hartley client the wrong version of their contract, that I'd asked their legal contact, Ms Reyes, to disregard it, and that from now on I'd check the version number before anything goes out. This morning she replied that they had already countersigned the wrong version on Tuesday. I need to update Owen on Slack.

I'm an account manager in London. This morning I missed a 9am call with our client Hiroshi Tanaka in Tokyo because I'd put it in my calendar as 9am London time; he waited 15 minutes. The call was to agree the Q4 delivery schedule, and I've since set my calendar to show both time zones.

I changed our nightly sales sync on Monday evening. Today my colleague Ines noticed Tuesday's dashboard total is about 3% below the till system; my change seems to be dropping rows, but I don't know why yet. I've already rolled the sync back to last week's version, so tonight's run should be clean. Need to tell my manager Kofi on Slack.

I'm an account executive. On last Thursday's sales call I told Oakridge Dental that our payroll integration was live, but it's only on the roadmap for Q1. They signed a 40-seat annual contract on Monday, and their ops lead, Hannah, asked this morning when she can switch it on. I need to tell my manager, Chris, on Slack before I answer her.
我是装修公司的项目经理。业主刘女士卫生间的墙砖定的是浅灰哑光，我下单时选成了浅灰亮光，工人昨天已经铺完一面墙，她还没去现场看。公司同意拆掉重铺，费用我们出；正确的砖周五（10月2日）到货，整体完工要从10月9日推到10月13日。

Llevo dos semanas como auxiliar administrativa en una clínica dental. Ayer confirmé por WhatsApp las 14 citas de hoy con el horario de la semana pasada, y esta mañana tres pacientes han llegado cuando la doctora Ruiz no estaba. Ya he llamado a los otros 11 con la hora correcta y he recolocado a los tres el jueves 8 de octubre; quiero decírselo a mi jefa, Lucía.
我和同事小李一起做给客户的月度报告，我负责的销售数据那页用成了8月的数据，报告昨天已经发给客户周经理。小李负责的部分没问题。我已经把9月的正确数据更新好了，要跟组长陈姐说。

I'm the closing shift manager at a café. On Tuesday night I didn't shut the walk-in fridge door properly; the morning team found it at 6am reading 12°C, and following our food safety log they binned about $640 of dairy and prepped food. I've ordered replacements, arriving by 11am, and we're running a short menu until then. I need to text the owner, Marta.

I'm a team lead. At 6:30 this morning we published release notes that used Halden Bank as a named customer example, which their contract doesn't allow. My report Nina wrote them, but I approved the draft without catching it. I took the page down at 9:40 and need to tell my director, Victor, on Slack.

I'm an in-house recruiter. This morning I sent our standard rejection email to Maya Torres, who is actually our top candidate for the senior designer role; the hiring manager, Felix, wants to talk to her about next steps this week. I picked the wrong name from the candidate list, and I've already told Felix. I'm calling Maya now and need the email to send if she doesn't pick up.
我是行政，负责订会议室。上周给我们部门10月8日（周四）下午的培训订会议室时，我把市场部当天下午见客户的大会议室预订覆盖掉了，今天他们的同事小王来确认时才发现。我已经把培训挪到小会议室，大会议室给市场部重新订好了，截图也发给了小王。要跟市场部负责人周姐说一声。

I manage a small bookshop with a team of four. Last month I approved both Tom's and Lucy's leave for 19 to 23 October without noticing they overlap, which leaves us one short of the three people we need on the floor. I'm not cancelling either; I'll work the shop floor myself that week. I want to post in our team WhatsApp.
我负责公司的官方微博。今天上午10:05，我本想用个人号吐槽一部电视剧，结果发到了公司官方账号上，10:30同事提醒我才删掉，删之前大约有120条转发，我已经截图保存。要马上在企业微信上跟市场部赵总说。
我是公司的配送司机。今天下午3点在仓库倒车时，我没下车看也没请人指挥，把尾号27的货车右后角撞到了装卸台的柱子上，尾灯碎了，后门有一道凹痕；没人受伤，货也没事，照片我已经拍了。尾灯不亮我就没再开上路，今天剩下的四单请同事老李用他的车帮忙送了，要跟车队主管孙姐说。

I'm the office manager at a dental practice. In March I handled the renewal of our cleaning contract with Sparrow Cleaning and missed that it auto-renewed at a rate $180 a month higher, so we've overpaid $1,080 since April; I found it today. I've emailed them asking to go back to the old rate and they'll reply by Friday 9 October, and I've set a reminder 60 days before every contract renewal. I need to tell the practice owner, Dr Lin.

At 9:50 this morning I clicked a link in an email that looked like our payroll portal and typed in my work password before I noticed the web address was wrong. I changed my password at 10:05 and signed out of all sessions, and I haven't seen anything odd yet. I need to tell our IT lead, Marcus, on Slack and forward him the email.
我是一家小设计公司的行政，负责对外付款。插画师小鹿8月31日发来6,000元的稿费发票，合同约定30天内付款，我把发票归错了文件夹一直没提交，今天她来问才发现，已经逾期两天。我刚提交了加急付款，财务说今天下午5点前到账；以后每张发票收到当天我都登记进付款表。
我在一家代账公司做会计，负责客户陈总的小贸易公司。这个月我漏报了他们9月的增值税申报，今天上午才发现，已经逾期一天；税务局的通知写的是罚款200元。我上午11点已经补报完成，罚款我自己承担，下周一前交清；以后每个客户的申报我都会在截止前三天做完并在表上打勾。

I'm a research technician in Dr Amara Osei's lab. Last Monday I swapped the labels on the control and treated plates in her drug-response run, so this week's data from that run can't be used; I found it today when I checked the plates against the freezer log. I can restart the run on Monday with results by Friday 16 October, and from now on I'll ask a colleague to double-check every label before plates go into the incubator.
我是社区药店的药师助理。今天上午10:20给王大爷发降糖药时，处方写的是每片0.5克，我拿成了同一种药每片0.85克的规格。11点核对发药记录时发现，11:05给他打了电话，他说还没吃，下午2点会把药拿回来换。要马上跟值班药师刘姐说。

I'm a freelance developer billing Brightwater Studio hourly. Going through my records today I found I logged the same 6 hours twice on my September timesheet, so they overpaid me £390; nobody there has noticed. I'll take it off my October invoice, which goes out next Friday, and I've switched to a time tracker that blocks duplicate entries. Emailing their producer, Siobhan.

My roommate Nadia and I had a blowup on Sunday about the cleaning rota. She said some unfair things too, but I called her lazy and brought up her being out of work. I want to text her and apologize for my part without starting the argument again.
早上赶时间，把合租室友小林放在冰箱里的一盒酸奶当成我的喝掉了，刚发现。想在微信上跟她说一声，不想搞得很严重。
I already apologized to my girlfriend for joking about her cooking in front of her parents. She just replied 'whatever, it's fine' and it's clearly not fine. What do I send now?
My girlfriend Zoe had her driving test on Thursday, her third attempt. I forgot completely: no good-luck text, and I didn't ask how it went. She passed, and last night she said 'you didn't even ask'.

I yelled at my 14-year-old son Ethan last night for leaving dishes in the sink. I'd had a bad day at work and it was way out of proportion, he went to his room and slammed the door. I want to text him before school.

My friend Dev texted me last week that his dog Biscuit, who he'd had for 12 years, had died. I replied 'oh no, RIP' and in the same message asked if he was still coming to my birthday drinks. He didn't come and hasn't messaged since.
前同事小顾三周前微信问我能不能帮她看一下简历，她想投我们公司的市场岗。我一直忙，看完就忘了回，今天才想起来。岗位10月9号截止。

At Sunday dinner at our parents' place, Mei's first time meeting the family, I said my brother Sam's new girlfriend, Mei, was 'another one who won't last'. Mei was in the kitchen and heard it. Sam hasn't answered my texts since. He prefers voice notes, so I'm sending one.

El sábado me dejé abierto el grifo de la bañera y el agua pasó al piso de abajo. La vecina, Carmen, tiene una mancha grande en el techo del baño. Ya avisé al seguro y el perito puede pasar el jueves 1 de octubre por la mañana. Quiero mandarle un WhatsApp.

My friend Hana told me in confidence that she and her husband are doing IVF. At drinks on Friday I mentioned it to our friend Chloe, thinking she already knew. She didn't, and Chloe messaged Hana to say she was thinking of her. Hana just texted me 'I can't believe you told Chloe.'
我是小区志愿者群的负责人。上周六（9月26日）的垃圾分类宣传活动，我在群里把集合时间写成了早上8点，其实是9点，十几位邻居白白早到，在门口等了一个小时。想在群里正式道个歉。

My college roommate Jess's dad died three years ago and I never called, didn't go to the funeral, and we just drifted after that. She was the person who got me through college. I want to message her now, even though it's late.
妻の美咲に相談せず、共同口座から30万円のロードバイクを買ってしまった。彼女は通帳を見て気づき、「なんで一言もないの」と言った。LINEで謝りたい。
本来想跟闺蜜吐槽婆婆周末来我家一直挑我做饭咸、说孩子穿少了，结果手滑发到了婆婆微信上。两分钟后撤回了，但她回了一句“看到了”。老公说让我自己处理。
昨晚快递柜被占满，我在小区门口冲保安刘师傅发了火，说他们什么都不管，其实这根本不归他管。今天下班想当面跟他道个歉。

At my friend Olu's 30th on Saturday I drank too much and got into a loud argument with his cousin about politics in the middle of the party. Olu had to step in and walk me outside. I want to text him.
昨晚教我爸用手机挂号，他问到第三遍的时候，我不耐烦地说了句“跟你说了多少遍了”。他把手机一放说“不学了”，今天也没怎么理我。我周六会回家。

On Monday I posted in our building's group chat that someone in the lobby had taken my parcel and should be ashamed. It turns out the courier left it at number 14 next door. My neighbour Priyanka in 4B was the only person in the lobby when it arrived, so it basically pointed at her, and she's been cool with me since. I posted a correction in the group this morning and now want to message her privately.

In our last three team meetings I've talked over my colleague Farah several times, including yesterday when she was halfway through explaining the vendor delays. Nobody said anything, but she went quiet for the rest of the meeting. I want to message her on Slack before Friday's meeting.
相亲认识的小周，我们聊了一个多月，见过两次面。后来我觉得不太合适，就直接不回她消息了，已经两个月。下周六共同朋友的婚礼上可能会碰到，我想先发个微信跟她道歉，不是想重新开始。

My grandmother Rose broke her hip last month and spent two weeks in hospital. I live 20 minutes away and didn't visit once. She's home now and doesn't really use phones, so I'm bringing her a card when I visit on Sunday.

I promised my friend Amara I'd collect her son Jonah, who's 7, from school at 3:15 yesterday because she was stuck at work. I had the wrong day in my calendar and didn't show; the school called her and Jonah waited in the office for 40 minutes until she got there. She texted 'I trusted you with him' and nothing since.
上周借了好朋友阿杰的相机去拍朋友婚礼，收工时我不小心把镜头摔了，镜片裂了。维修店报价1,800元，我约好了这周六送修。还没跟他说，想今晚在微信上先讲清楚。

Meu irmão Rafael passou dois meses organizando uma festa surpresa para os 40 anos da esposa dele, a Bia, no sábado 10 de outubro. No almoço de domingo eu falei da festa sem querer na frente dela. Ainda tem um vídeo com mensagens dos amigos que ela não sabe que existe, e eu posso juntar e editar até sexta.

Samedi, j'ai dit à mon amie Claire que j'étais malade pour ne pas aller au vernissage de son expo photo. En fait j'étais à un dîner chez d'autres amis, et elle l'a vu sur Instagram. L'expo reste ouverte jusqu'au dimanche 18 octobre.
前天晚上趁老公洗澡，我偷偷翻了他的微信聊天记录，什么都没发现，但他看到我把手机放回去，很生气，说觉得不被信任。他最近常加班到很晚，我心里一直不踏实。想发微信跟他道歉。

My 4-year-old, Leo, pushed his classmate Maya off the slide at nursery pickup yesterday and she scraped her knee. Leo said sorry on the spot, but I only managed a rushed 'so sorry' to her mum, Grace, before she left. We've talked to Leo at home about pushing, and I'm going to stay closer to him at pickup. I want to text Grace tonight.

My friend Robin came out as non-binary in June and uses they/them. At book club on Tuesday I called them 'she' twice and then laughed it off with 'old habits'. Robin left early and I want to text them.
上周我在小红书一个手工皮具博主“阿木”的视频下面留言，说她做的钱包“针脚歪成这样还好意思卖”。今天看到她发动态说这条评论让她难受了好几天。我已经删了评论，想私信跟她道个歉，我们并不认识。
女儿小雨今年26岁。上周她跟我说，从她初中起我就老在亲戚面前说她胖、让她少吃，她这些年一直很难受。我当时还辩解说是为她好。想给她发微信认真道个歉。
上周六和好朋友阿珍去爬山，我没问她就把合照发了朋友圈。那天她跟公司请的是病假，被她领导看到了，周一被叫去谈话。她跟我说“你发之前能不能问一下”，照片我已经删了。

For six months I've been calling my running club friend Aoife 'Ay-oh-fee', at least twice a week, including when I introduced her to the whole group at the summer relay. Yesterday she corrected me, laughing: it's 'EE-fa', and she said everyone gets it wrong. I want to text her before Saturday's run.

Auf meiner Geburtstagsfeier am Samstag habe ich vor etwa zwanzig Leuten den Akzent meiner Freundin Aylin nachgemacht, mitten in einer Geschichte, die sie erzählt hat, und alle haben gelacht. Sie hat danach kaum noch geredet und ist früh gegangen. Wir kennen uns seit dem Studium, und ich will ihr auf WhatsApp schreiben.

My daughter Isla, 9, had her first violin solo at the school concert on Wednesday at 6pm. I'd promised I'd be there, but I stayed late for a client call and arrived after she'd played; she said 'you always say you'll come'. I've told my manager I'm leaving at 5 on concert days from now on, and the winter concert is in December. I'm her dad, and I'm writing her a note to put in her lunchbox.
钟点工王阿姨在我们家做了三年，每周二、周五来。上周我找不到金手链，当面问她是不是拿了，她很委屈。昨天手链在沙发缝里找到了。想在她下周二来之前先发微信好好道歉。

My friend Priya has been vegetarian her whole life. At my dinner party on Saturday I made a Thai curry and forgot the paste had shrimp in it; she'd eaten a full bowl before I checked the jar and told her. She was gracious in front of everyone but has been quiet since, and I've started reading every label.
上周在家族微信群里，我转了一篇说吃大蒜能防流感的文章，当医生的表哥建忠出来说不靠谱，我当着全家回了一句“就你懂，显摆什么”，群里一下子安静了。我已经在群里补了一句那篇文章不靠谱，现在想私下给他发微信道歉。

I've been fighting a flaky Cypress checkout test for two hours: it fails about one run in three, only in CI, and I've ruled out the test data and the retry config. Jonas wrote most of that suite; we're peers and he's busy with the release too. How do I ask him without sounding helpless?
我是组长，想把11月18号客户年会的物料统筹交给新来的同事小周，她之前在上一家公司做过活动。要在11月8号前把展架、手册和伴手礼定稿下单，预算3万以内，我会跟王经理说好算进她的工作量。怎么说才不像甩锅？

In a meeting today our VP, Carla, asked me what our churn rate was for enterprise accounts last quarter and I blanked. Ahmed is helping me pull it from the billing data now. I want to send her a follow-up on Slack.

I'm a marketing manager and need someone from legal to review the two-page rules for our October giveaway by Wednesday Oct 7, before it goes live on Monday Oct 12; I'm least sure about eligibility, prize value and the entry deadline. Nobody in legal reports to me and I've never worked with them. The legal ops contact is Grace Liu.

I asked my peer Ravi on the data team to build the churn dashboard for our QBR by Friday Oct 9. He replied that there's no way, he's on the migration until the 16th. I still need something for the QBR on Monday Oct 12, and the monthly churn chart by plan tier from the existing billing table would do.
我手上同时有三个项目：官网改版、双十一活动页、还有领导上周又加给我的供应商系统对接，都说要10月底前完成，我估计一个人最多保证两个。活动页11月1号要开始预热，技术部小王能先接对接的接口梳理。想让李总定优先级，但不想显得在推活。

I'm the new team lead and about 20 years older than most of my team. My report Maya is the Figma expert and I need to edit our onboarding prototype before the Harlow client review on Thursday Oct 8; I've done the basics tutorial but I'm stuck on components and how the flows link up. Asking someone junior to teach me feels strange.

Yesterday I posted in our #data-help Slack channel asking why the Salesforce sync dropped 43 leads created last weekend. Nobody replied. I've checked the field mappings and API limits and suspect the scheduler; Tomás built the original sync but moved to the payments team in June.
我10月12号到16号请了年假。手上跟华东几家供应商的对账邮件每天三四封，基本是确认金额，想请同组的小林帮我盯一下，对不上的留给我回来处理。我们是平级，她手上的活也不轻，我可以以后帮她接周报。

I'm an account manager at a payroll software company. On a call today, a client, Deborah at Fernway Clinics, asked whether our system will handle Colorado's new overtime rules starting in January. I didn't know, said I'd check, and have asked our compliance lead, Marcus Webb. Sending a follow-up email.
I'm three weeks into managing a team of 5. In our team Slack, Omar asked whether unused holiday days roll over into next year. I have no idea, I don't want to guess, and Priya in HR would know.

My friend Jess has been really low since her divorce in the spring. We talk every Thursday and she keeps saying she can't sleep and can't see it getting better, but she's never mentioned therapy. I want to suggest it once without it sounding like I'm handing her off.

My friends Tariq and Hana's son Sami, who was 7, died last week after a short illness. At their barbecue in June he insisted on showing me every one of his football tricks. I live two streets away and can cook.

My ex-boyfriend Tom's mum, Janet, died on Sunday. We broke up two years ago on okay terms, and I was close to her; she taught me to make her Sunday roast. I want to text Tom without it seeming like I'm trying to get back into his life.

My friend Nadia's father died on Monday. She hadn't spoken to him in six years because of how he treated her mum, and she just texted me 'I don't even know what I'm supposed to feel.' We've been friends since uni.

In our class parents' WhatsApp group, Olga posted that her husband Viktor died suddenly on Sunday. Dozens of people are replying with heart emojis. Her daughter Mila and mine are best friends, and Viktor coached their Saturday netball team and always stayed after practice to feed balls to any girl who wanted extra shooting. I want to message her privately.
我是初二（5）班班主任。学生小宇的爸爸上周五去世了，小宇请了一周假，下周一回学校。他爸爸每次家长会都来，坐第一排认真记笔记。我打算让课代表帮小宇补这周落下的课，想给小宇妈妈发条微信。
我姑姑前天因病去世了，她儿子是我表哥阿峰。我从小寒暑假都住在姑姑家，她每年都给我包荠菜馄饨。我自己也很难过，但想先给表哥发个微信。周六追悼会，我可以提前过去帮忙招呼亲戚。
高中好友小楠在多伦多读博，她外婆前天在老家去世了，她因为签证的事回不去参加葬礼。葬礼是北京时间10月4日周日上午9点，她那边是10月3日周六晚上9点。高中时我常去她外婆家，外婆每次都端出自己做的桂花糕，说我们太瘦了。

My sister-in-law Karen died of cancer last week. Her daughter, my niece Lily, is 15, and she and I have a thing of going to the secondhand bookshop together; Karen always dropped her at mine and honked twice when she came to collect her. I want to message Lily directly, not just her dad.

My friend Priya's best friend Anjali died in a car crash on Saturday; they'd been friends since they were 11. Priya told me she feels silly being so wrecked because 'it's not like she was family'. I met Anjali at Priya's 30th, where her speech had the whole room crying with laughter.
取引先の田中部長から、お母様が9月29日に亡くなられたので来週はお休みする、とメールがありました。去年の打ち合わせのとき、部長がお母様の漬けた梅干しをお土産にくださいました。10月8日（木）の定例会議は私が主催しているので、延期するつもりです。

I'm Dr. Amara Bello, a vet at Larkfield Vet Clinic. Yesterday we put Mr. Okoye's 16-year-old cat, Pepper, to sleep; he'd brought her in every year since she was a kitten, and she always purred on the exam table. We send a handwritten card, and we'll post Pepper's clay paw print to his home next week.

Ollie in my online D&D group posted in our Discord that his mum died on Tuesday. We've played every Wednesday night for three years but never met in person, and he once told us she taught him to play with her old dice. I run the game and want to DM him.

My colleague Ben Adler's father, Saul, died on Sunday. Ben's email says the family is sitting shiva at his home through Thursday 8 October, visitors welcome 7 to 9pm. I'm not Jewish and have never been to a shiva. Saul came to our office summer picnic last year and spent the whole afternoon teaching the interns backgammon. I want to text Ben that I'd like to come on Tuesday evening.

Mon amie Léa a perdu son compagnon Hugo dans un accident de vélo il y a dix jours. Le jour même, je lui ai écrit « il est dans un monde meilleur » et elle m'a répondu sèchement « non, il devrait être ici ». Hugo jouait de la guitare à chacun de nos pique-niques au bord du canal, et je voudrais lui réécrire sans tout aggraver.

My dad, Frank, is 72, and his best friend of 50 years, Ray, died on Monday. They fished at Miller's Pond every Saturday morning for as long as I can remember, and Ray taught me to bait a hook. Dad doesn't do big feelings talk, I live three hours away, and I'm visiting the weekend of 10 October.
我是研究生，导师王老师的爱人李阿姨上周因病去世了。每年中秋李阿姨都请我们课题组去家里吃她包的饺子，还总让我们打包带走。王老师这周请假了，我和师兄小陈商量好，这两周实验室的日常和师弟师妹的问题由我们俩先盯着。想给王老师发条微信。

My five-a-side teammate Callum and his wife Sara lost their baby daughter, Isla, who was stillborn at 38 weeks last Thursday. Everyone has been messaging Sara, and Callum has gone quiet in our team chat. We play every Tuesday at 7, I live nearby and can drop food round on Thursday, and I want to text him directly.
好朋友小雅的妈妈今年3月因病去世了。10月5日是阿姨的生日，也是她走后的第一个生日。以前每年阿姨生日都会煮一大锅长寿面，叫我们几个去家里吃。我想那天晚上下班后煮碗面给小雅送过去。

Greg posted on Facebook that his wife Linda died on Tuesday after a short illness, and dozens of people are commenting. I worked with Linda at Brookfield Library for six years, and she ran the Saturday story time, doing every character in a different voice. I don't know Greg well and want to leave a public comment, not a private message.

My neighbour Carla's son Leo is 7, and his grandad Bill died last week. Bill used to bring Leo round every Sunday to see my tortoise, Pickle, and Leo always fed him a strawberry. Carla asked if I'd write Leo a little card he can read himself, and she's happy for him to keep visiting Pickle.
我叫周明，开一家小装修公司。跟了我八年的师傅老赵上周下班路上出车祸去世了。他每次干完活都把工地扫得干干净净，好多客户点名要他。我想给他爱人刘姐发条微信；他9月和10月这几天的工资我这周内一并转给她，公司这边要办的手续我来跑。

I'm Sunita, a home carer. For two years I visited Mrs. Evans every morning; she always had the crossword half done and saved the hardest clues for me. She died last week, and I want to write a card to her daughter, Claire, whom I've met a few times.
闺蜜小林发微信说，怀孕10周的宝宝没保住，昨天做了手术，现在在家休息，除了她老公只告诉了我。我周末不上班，周六中午可以给她送一锅汤，放门口就走。

Got a DM from Ben at a coffee subscription brand, Ridgeline, saying 'love your content, want to collab?' That's it. I have 45k on Instagram and I've actually been drinking their Ethiopia roast for months.

A Rafa, de uma marca de biquínis, me mandou DM oferecendo 3 peças em troca de um reels e 3 stories. Tenho 22 mil seguidores, curti a coleção nova deles, mas não faço permuta. Meu valor para um reels com 30 dias de uso orgânico começa em R$ 1.500.
一个国产护肤品牌找我做小红书笔记，预算2000，但要求永久授权还能投流。我平时单篇出镜图文报价3000，不出镜的纯产品图文是2000，都含30天授权；投流或更长授权一般按内容费的30%每90天另计。

I'm a fitness creator on TikTok, 120k followers, a lot of them 16 to 20. A sports betting app, BetBlitz, offered $2,500 for one video. Their contact is Jordan. Easy money but not right for my audience.

I sent a quote to a kitchenware brand, Oakfield, on Sept 24: $900 for one TikTok featuring their cast iron pan, with 30 days of organic usage. The contact, Priya, went quiet. It's been 8 days. Worth one follow-up? A story set of three would be my smaller option.
和一个露营装备品牌谈好了：一条抖音视频加三篇小红书图文，10月15号到25号之间发，总价8000元，先付一半，含30天授权，不排他。对接人是小林，想发条消息把条款确认下来。

A protein bar brand, Fuelwell, offered $1,200 for one YouTube integration on my running channel (80k subs). Their contract, from Nina, asks for 6 months of category exclusivity covering all nutrition brands. I have an ongoing paid nutrition partnership, so I'd offer 60 days on protein bars and snacks within the $1,200, or six months on that category for $1,800.

Skincare brand Lumen paid $1,200 for one TikTok. They approved my script, I filmed it and did the one round of revisions in our contract on Sept 24. Now their manager Ellie wants a full reshoot with a different outfit and a new opening hook. I'd reshoot for $400 by Friday 9 October, or recut the existing footage with a new text hook for free by tomorrow.

J'ai refusé une collab « contre produits » avec une marque de bougies et j'ai proposé une story payée à 250 euros. La responsable, Camille, m'a répondu : « D'autres créatrices le font gratuitement, vous savez. » J'ai 30 000 abonnés sur Instagram.

An agency, Brightloop, emailed asking my rate for 3 UGC videos they'd run as ads for a meal-kit brand, nothing posted on my own account. Their contact Marcus won't share a budget and just says 'send your rates'. I charge $450 per UGC video with one revision and 30 days of paid-ad usage, $200 per video per extra 30 days, and ads run through my handle cost extra.
一个坚果品牌找我在小红书发一篇测评，给1500元，但要求不走蒲公英平台、私下转账，笔记里也不要标注合作，说“写成自己买的更真实”。我有3万粉，他们家的坚果我自己确实常吃；走蒲公英的话1500元含30天授权我可以接。

A luggage brand, Voyant, agreed $2,000 for one YouTube integration on my 60k travel channel. The contract from Alex in partnerships says payment net 90 after the video goes live, nothing upfront. I normally take 50% upfront and the rest within 30 days; my fallback would be the full $2,000 within 30 days of publishing, no deposit.

A candle brand, Hearth & Co, paid me $600 per reel for three reels last autumn. Their contact Marisa wants to rebook for the holidays. I've grown from 40k to 95k followers since then and my reel rate is now $1,100 with 30 days of organic usage; as a returning partner I'd do three for $3,000.
我在抖音做家居收纳，5万粉丝。一个收纳盒品牌找我挂小黄车带货，只给20%佣金，不给坑位费，还要求至少发两条视频。我两条视频的报价一般是坑位费4000元加15%佣金，含30天授权；想试水的话可以先做一条，2000元加15%佣金。

Skincare brand Veracalm is paying me $1,500 for a reel about their new balm, and I'm due to film on Monday. The script from their contact, Theo, has me say 'it cleared my eczema in 7 days', but I don't have eczema and I've only used it for a week on dry patches.

Uma marca de café, a Serra Alta, cancelou a campanha depois que eu já tinha gravado o reels. Recebi 50% adiantado (R$ 1.200 de R$ 2.400) e agora a Bia, do marketing, pediu o sinal de volta. A cláusula 6 do contrato diz que o sinal não é reembolsável depois do início da gravação; posso publicar o vídeo até 15 de dezembro pelos R$ 1.200 restantes.

Eine Outdoor-Marke, Gipfelwerk, lädt mich zu ihrem Launch-Event in München am Samstag, 17. Oktober, ein: vier Stunden vor Ort plus drei Instagram-Stories. Sie zahlen nur Anreise und Hotel, kein Honorar. Ich habe 35.000 Follower, nehme für drei Stories 350 Euro und für Präsenz-Events 500 Euro; die Ansprechpartnerin heißt Lena.

An outdoor gear brand, Northpine, wants me as an ambassador for three months: one reel and one story set of three every month, for $700 a month. My rates are $900 per reel and $350 per story set, with 30 days of organic usage, and I'd do $1,050 a month for a three-month deal. The contact is Grace and she hasn't mentioned exclusivity.

I review budget tech on YouTube, 140k subscribers. Earbud brand Sonaro offered $2,000 for a dedicated video, and the contract from Kevin includes clause 11: I can't post anything negative about Sonaro products for 12 months. I'd happily do the video and let them check the script for factual accuracy, but my channel runs on honest reviews.
我是抖音探店博主，8万粉。三个月前我自费去一家茶饮店拍了条视频，播放不错。现在他们品牌的小周私信说想把这条视频转到官方账号，还想剪进广告里投流。官方号转发并@我的话我不收费；投流授权我一般按内容费的30%每90天另计，我单条视频报价5000元。

Home fitness brand Coreline offered $1,000 for one TikTok, but only if it hits 50,000 views in 7 days; otherwise they'd pay $300. I have 70k followers and my last ten videos averaged 35,000 views. My flat rate is $900 per TikTok with 30 days of organic usage, and I'd be open to a $200 bonus on top if it passes their target. The contact is Sofia.

I post about my two rescue greyhounds on TikTok, 50k followers. Hannah from a dog treat brand, Tailwise, wants three detailed video concepts plus a 15-second test clip 'so the team can decide', with no budget or deliverables yet. My rate is $850 per TikTok with 30 days of organic usage; once a brief is agreed I'd share a short idea direction.
我是小红书美食博主，6万粉，单篇图文报价5000元，含30天授权；档期一般提前两周约，48小时内交稿加收30%加急费。一个调味品牌的对接人小米今天下午找我，说新品明晚8点前就要发一篇测评，产品今晚送到，但brief还没给。

My daughter Ella is 15 and has 30k followers on TikTok for her crochet videos. A yarn brand, Loopwell, DMed her directly offering $400 for one video; the contact is Sasha. I'm her mum, Karen Holt, I handle anything paid, and I want them to deal with me at karen.holt@example.com and put the deliverables, usage and payment terms in writing before Ella says yes.

I write a weekly personal finance newsletter with 18k subscribers and a 52% open rate. Owen from a budgeting app, Pocketwise, emailed asking my price for a 'dedicated send' to my whole list, with copy written by their team. I don't do dedicated sends; I sell one sponsor slot at the top of a regular issue for $600, I write it myself from the brand's brief, and I always label it as sponsored.
去年跟一个母婴品牌合作，说好交付后30天付款，结果拖了两个多月才到账。现在对接人阿琳又来约双十一的两条抖音视频，我单条报价3000元，含30天授权。我想接，但这次要全款预付才开拍。
我是小红书穿搭博主，10万粉，单篇图文报价6000元，含30天授权。一个服装品牌的对接人小雅发来合同，第9条要求我授权他们永久使用我的肖像和声音，用来生成AI数字人广告，不另外付费。我愿意接这篇笔记，但不想把脸和声音永久交出去。

I have 25k followers on Instagram for my plant care videos. Someone called Mia, DMing from a brand-new account, offered $1,500 for three posts for a brand called Verdeluxe, but says I first need to pay a $79 'shipping and onboarding fee' for the sample kit, and she won't give a company email or a written contract. I want to reply without burning a bridge in case it's real.

I review kitchen gadgets on YouTube, 90k subscribers. Dana, partnerships lead at a blender brand, Kova, offered $1,800 for a sponsored video on the Kova 2, my usual rate with 30 days of organic usage, but says their team needs my YouTube login to upload it and manage comments. I upload my own videos and can send the final cut for approval 48 hours before it goes live.

I post dog training tips on Instagram, 40k followers. Maya from a small local dog rescue, Second Chance Paws, asked if I'd make three reels for their adoption drive for free, since they have no budget. I love what they do and I'm happy to donate one reel and share their adoption posts in my stories through October, but three reels is about two days' work I can't give away.
料理系のYouTubeチャンネルで、登録者は約8万人、視聴者の約7割が25〜44歳の女性です。調味料メーカー「ひかり醸造」の田中さんから、依頼内容を決める前に視聴者層のデータと料金表がほしいと連絡があり、アナリティクス画面のスクリーンショットも出せます。タイアップ動画は1本25万円で30日間のオーガニック利用込み、広告での二次利用と競合排他は別料金です。

Sunscreen brand Solene paid me $1,000 flat for one Instagram reel that went live on 15 September, and the contract has no view guarantee. Their contact, Rhea, says it got 12,000 views against my usual 30,000 and wants a second reel for free to make up for it. I'm happy to send the reel's full insights and add a free story set of three resharing it, labelled as a paid partnership like the reel, but a second reel would be my normal $1,000.
我写一个家居改造的微信公众号，去年给一个灯具品牌报的是平均每篇阅读2万，今年改版后降到1.2万左右。现在他们的对接人小陈又来约稿，准备按去年的数字下单。我现在一篇软文报价6000元，是按1.2万的阅读定的，文章会标注“广告”，可以发近三个月的后台截图。

I'm a running creator on YouTube with 70k subscribers, and I'm under a signed exclusivity for running footwear with another shoe brand until 31 December. Paolo from a shoe brand, Kestrel Run, emailed offering $2,200 for one video in November. I'd genuinely like to work with them from January, and my rate for a dedicated video is $2,200 with 30 days of organic usage.

I host a weekly gardening podcast, Dirt Under Nails, averaging 6,000 downloads per episode in the first 30 days. Dev from a seed company, Sproutbox, offered $400 for a 60-second host-read ad in four episodes. My rate is $150 per episode for a host-read mid-roll, so four would be $600; as a first test I'd do three episodes for $400, and I always open the read with 'this episode is sponsored by'.
我是B站数码区UP主，12万粉。和一个充电宝品牌的对接人小何谈好一条定制视频，8000元，含30天授权。今天他发来brief，最后补了一句要所有原始素材（未剪辑的源文件），方便他们自己剪广告。我的做法是：原始素材另加3000元，只能用在他们自己的渠道，授权90天；或者不给源文件，我免费多导出一版竖屏成片。

I'm Maria, a wedding photographer. Priya and Ben just paid the deposit for their 14 June wedding at Hollins Barn; we'll have a 30-minute planning call in April. I need their rough timeline, must-have family groupings and venue coordinator's contact by 31 March, and I answer texts on 0161 496 0718 within a day. Want a welcome email that isn't a novel.

Ich bin Jana Hofmann und gebe Online-Nachhilfe in Mathe per Zoom. Frau Becker hat für ihren Sohn Luca (10. Klasse) ein Paket mit 10 Stunden gebucht; die erste Stunde ist Dienstag, 6. Oktober, 16:30 Uhr, den Link schicke ich am Vortag. Bis Sonntag brauche ich ein Foto der letzten Mathearbeit und das aktuelle Thema; erreichbar bin ich per WhatsApp unter 0176 5550 2231, meist am selben Tag.

Web design client (Dev, runs a bakery with a chalkboard menu) was supposed to send his photos and menu text last Friday for the site launch on Oct 20. If I get them by Wednesday we keep that date; otherwise launch moves to the 27th. I don't want to sound annoyed.
我是大理民宿“苍洱小院”的阿雯。客人林女士刚订了10月2日到4日两晚的洱海景观房，1360元已付，下午两点后入住，中午12点前退房。想发条欢迎微信，要她10月1日前告诉我到店时间和入住人身份证信息；我白天微信一般一小时内回，国庆古城人多，想提醒她下午五点前到，正好看日落。

I'm Dan, a kitchen fitter; client Ruth paid her deposit two weeks ago and the install starts Monday Oct 12: Jake and I arrive at 8am to strip the old units, and worktops get templated Thursday the 15th. The cabinets arrived at our workshop Friday and I checked them myself. She's emailed twice this week asking if it's on track; I need a clear kitchen by Sunday evening, and she can text me on 07700 900456.

I run customer success at a small scheduling software company. Harbor Physio (4 clinics) just signed, and their ops manager is Lena; plan: 45-minute kickoff this week (Thu Oct 1 or Fri Oct 2 at 10am), we build their setup by Fri Oct 23, go-live Mon Nov 2. I need their staff list (name, email, clinic, role) and any treatment types over 60 minutes by Fri Oct 9; I reply within one business day.

I'm Jess and I run small-group puppy training. Tom just booked our 6-week Puppy Foundations course for his cockapoo, Biscuit, every Saturday from Oct 10 at 9am at Elm Park community hall. I need a photo of his vaccination record by Wednesday Oct 7, owners bring a flat collar or harness, a lead and small treats, and I answer texts on 07700 900456 the same day.
我是自由插画师，9月21号接了茶饮品牌的包装插画，当时跟客户陈经理说10月9号交初稿，初稿后她有一周时间反馈。现在印刷厂的刀版图10月8号才能给我，初稿得推到10月14号。想趁早跟她说。

I'm Tom and I make personalised walnut chopping boards at Grain & Co., sold on my own site, and Grace just ordered one ($95) engraved 'The Okafor Kitchen, est. 2026' as a gift for her sister's housewarming on Saturday Oct 10. I engrave Thursday, ship by Tuesday Oct 6, and delivery takes about three days. I want the confirmation to double-check the wording.

I'm Ines and I run a two-person home cleaning business. Marta just booked a fortnightly clean, first one Thursday Oct 8, 9am to 12; each visit covers kitchen, bathrooms, dusting, floors and bins, not ovens or inside windows; by Monday the 5th I need to know how we get in, any pets, and rooms or products to avoid. I answer texts on 07700 900456 within a couple of hours.

Sou a Marta e arrendei o meu T1 na Rua de Arroios, em Lisboa, à Inês Carvalho, que já pagou caução e primeira renda. Ela entra quinta, 1 de outubro, e a D. Rosa, a porteira, entrega as chaves a partir das 14h. Preciso de uma foto da leitura do contador da luz nesse dia; o meu número é 912 345 678 e costumo responder no mesmo dia.
我是阿宁，网上卖手机摄影课，399元，8节约20分钟的录播，用付款手机号登录，另有两次直播答疑。学员刘先生刚付款，助理小周今天会加他进学员群。第一次直播10月11日周日晚8点，我要他10月9日前往群里发一张自己拍的照片当点评素材；工作日一般两小时内回复。

I'm Sarah Lin, a self-employed accountant, and Mr. Hughes, 81, has hired me for his tax return and doesn't use email, so I'm posting a welcome letter with a prepaid envelope. I need his pension statements and bank interest letters by Friday Oct 30 (or I can collect them Wednesday Oct 28); I'll post him a copy of the return by mid-November and go through it by phone before submitting. My office line is answered weekdays 9 to 5.
陶芸工房つちの山本です。佐藤さんが母の恵子さんに体験レッスンのギフトチケット（6,600円）を贈り、陶芸が初めての恵子さんが10月17日（土）14時、約2時間の回を予約しました。教室は桜台駅徒歩5分、道具とエプロンは用意し、汚れてよい服と短い爪でお願いしていて、作品は約1か月で焼き上がり郵送も可、電話は090-1234-5678で平日は当日中に返信します。
我是小橡树托班的陈老师，收1到3岁的孩子。周女士刚给两岁的女儿乐乐交了10月托费4800元，10月12日周一入托，第一周上午9点到11点半适应，第二周全天。10月9日前我需要疫苗本照片、过敏和饮食禁忌、能接孩子的家人名单，名单外的人不能接走孩子；工作日微信一般一小时内回，想提醒她带个孩子喜欢的小玩偶。

I'm Mae, a tattoo artist. Chloe just paid a £100 deposit for a botanical forearm piece, booked for Saturday 24 October at 11am at my studio. I send designs two days before, I need her reference photos of the flowers by Sunday 11 October, and I usually reply to messages within a day. I want her to know how to prepare without it reading like a list of rules.

I'm Jo and I run a one-person dog grooming salon. Amy just booked a full groom for her nervous rescue greyhound, Pippa, on Tuesday 13 October at 10am, and her booking note asks if she can stay and watch. Mi cuñado Andrés me pidió prestado el coche una semana, del 10 al 17 de octubre, para irse a la costa con unos amigos. No presto el coche a nadie y el seguro solo me cubre a mí. El verano pasado alquilé uno en una agencia con buen precio por semana.

My friend Ben asked me to help him move out of his third-floor walk-up on Saturday October 10. I don't want to spend the day carrying boxes, but I'm free that evening and would genuinely like to help in some other way.
表姨让我帮她儿子在我们公司内推，还想让我跟HR打个招呼“关照一下”。表弟专业不太对口，公司招人的事我一向不插手，但也不想让表姨觉得我不帮忙。
同组同事小周让我明天早上帮他在钉钉上代打卡，他要送孩子去医院复查，大概晚到一个小时。我理解他，但考勤的事我一向不替人做。

My friend Marco just opened a taco place and asked me and my partner to post 5-star online reviews this week. We haven't eaten there yet and I only review places I've been to. My partner Sam and I are planning to go on Friday night.
大学同学老吴找我借身份证，说他名下的手机号办满了，想用我的身份证再办一张卡，给他店里的收款账号用。我们关系不错，但证件我一向不外借。
女儿明年3月产假结束，想让我从那时起每周一到周五全天帮她带孩子。我今年刚退休，想留点时间给自己，不想全天都带，但每周三可以全天去带，平时有急事也愿意搭把手。
大学同学阿琳11月要来上海面试，问能不能在我家住一个星期。我一个人住一居室，一向不留人过夜，不想破例；但愿意帮她找我家附近的酒店，面试结束后请她吃顿饭。

A colleague I barely know, Ethan from sales, DMed me on Slack asking me to sponsor his charity half marathon for a children's hospital, suggesting $100. I give to a fixed set of three charities every year and don't add others, but I'm happy to share his fundraising page on LinkedIn.

My great-aunt Ruth, 84, asked me on the phone yesterday to be the executor of her will. I'm honoured, but I live in Singapore and she's in Ohio, so I couldn't be there to handle things properly. She sees her lawyer about the will next month, and I'd genuinely like to help her think through who else could do it.

Jen, another mum from school, asked if I can drive her son Leo to school every Tuesday and Thursday from October. I don't drive other people's kids, as a rule for everyone. We live on the same street, so on Tuesdays I could walk Leo in with my son, Sam.
高中同学阿芳现在做保险代理，这周在微信上约我聊，想让我给女儿买一份年缴8000元的重疾险。我家的保险都是我和老公一起定的，今年已经配好了，不想再加，也不想伤了同学情分。

My friend Matt texted asking me to say he was at my place on Saturday night if his wife Sophie asks. He wasn't, and he won't tell me where he was. I'm not lying to Sophie for anyone, but I don't want to lecture him.

Minha vizinha, dona Lurdes, tem 79 anos e mora sozinha no apartamento ao lado. Ela me pediu para guardar a senha do cartão dela e fazer os saques do mês por ela, porque tem medo de ir ao caixa eletrônico. Não quero ficar com a senha de ninguém, mas posso acompanhá-la até a agência na quinta de manhã para ela ver com o gerente outras opções.
小区业主群里的王阿姨私信我，让我在要求更换物业公司的联名信上签字，说已经有60多户签了。我对现在的物业还算满意，不想签。平时跟王阿姨关系不错，在电梯里经常聊天。

My friend Callum is going travelling for six months from November and asked if he can store his sofa, bed and about 20 boxes in my garage while he's away. We're turning the garage into a home office in January, so the space won't be free. I'd genuinely be happy to help him load the van on moving day.

A stranger on LinkedIn, Tobias, who's switching careers into software, asked me, a senior backend engineer, to do weekly mock interviews with him for the next two months. I don't do ongoing mentoring with people I haven't worked with, but I'm happy to give written comments on his CV once if he sends it by Friday Oct 9.

My neighbour Graham is having an extension built and asked if his builders can come through my back garden every weekday for six weeks from 2 November, because it's easier than carrying everything through his house. I don't want people crossing my garden every day, but I'm fine with them bringing the big steel beam through once, as long as he tells me the day before.
大学室友阿杰12月12日结婚，请我当婚礼司仪。我一上台讲话就紧张得发抖，不想当；但那天早上可以去帮忙接亲，也可以负责礼金登记。

My manager, Graham, asked if I could spend a couple of Saturdays helping his daughter Ellie with her university personal statement, since I studied English. I keep my weekends for myself and don't want to start doing personal favours for my boss. I'd be happy to send Ellie the guide I used when I applied.

My cousin Hannah asked me to be godmother to her baby son, Rory, at his christening on Sunday 8 November. I'm not religious and wouldn't feel right making the promises in church, but I'd love to be at the christening and be a really involved part of Rory's life.

I work at Northgate Appliances, and my friend Dom asked if I'd buy a £900 fridge for him with my 30% staff discount. Staff policy says the discount is only for staff and immediate family. Our store-wide sale starts on Monday 12 October and is open to everyone.

I'm 16. My friend Zoe asked me on Snapchat if she can copy my chemistry lab report, due Tuesday 6 October, because she's behind. I don't share my written work with anyone, but I'm happy to go through the method with her at lunch on Monday.

My old school friend Nathan is raising money for his meal-kit startup, Forkful, and asked if I'd put in $5,000. I don't invest in friends' businesses, as a rule for everyone, but I'm happy to give him written feedback on his pitch deck if he sends it by Friday.

Mon ami Hugo me demande de lui prêter mon appartement le samedi 17 octobre pour fêter ses 30 ans avec une trentaine de personnes, pendant que je serai chez mes parents à Lyon. Je ne prête mon appartement pour des fêtes à personne. Par contre, je peux lui prêter mes guirlandes lumineuses et ma grosse enceinte.

Mein neuer Nachbar, Herr Yilmaz, hat geklingelt und gefragt, ob er ein paar Wochen mein WLAN mitbenutzen darf, bis sein eigener Anschluss freigeschaltet ist. Mein WLAN-Passwort gebe ich grundsätzlich niemandem außerhalb der Familie. Ich will freundlich bleiben, wir wohnen Tür an Tür.

I'm organising a surprise 40th for my friend Claire on Saturday 10 October, and Osteria Rosa, where we'd booked 18 people, just cancelled after a flood in their kitchen. A few people booked trains for it, and I've got holds at two other places near the station. Need to tell the group chat.
我是部门经理，公司今年冻结调薪，我得告诉组里的小陈，她之前一直在等这次涨薪，我也答应过帮她争取。打算先发消息约她聊。

I'm Sam, a freelance dev. The one-tap wallet payments I promised my client Rachel for her Nov 1 launch turn out to be only on her payment provider's enterprise tier; their support confirmed it this morning. I can launch with cards only or add a second provider, which adds about a week, and I need to email her.

Borrowed my friend Nick's car for the weekend and this afternoon scraped the passenger door reversing out of a parking space: a hand-width scratch and a small dent, and I've taken photos. My fault entirely. He only got it back from the garage last month.
我和室友小周合租两年了，合同明年1月15号到期。我决定到期不续了，要搬去和男朋友住，她得自己找新室友或者换房子。她挺喜欢这套房子的。

Yesterday I texted my sister Hannah that I can't lend her the $3,000 for her car repair after all, because my hours at work got cut; I could drive her to work next week instead. She replied 'Great, thanks for nothing, you promised.' I don't want a fight, but I can't change my answer.

I coach my town's U12 girls' soccer team, and at last weekend's tryouts 26 girls went for 16 travel squad spots. Zoe, 11, two seasons with us, didn't make it because of her speed on the ball; she has a rec team spot and can join our Thursday skills sessions before spring tryouts. I need to text her mom, Karen, before the list goes out tomorrow.

I'm in the second year of a law degree and my parents put in $12,000 a year toward it. I've decided to leave at the end of this semester, in December, start an electrician apprenticeship with Carver Electric in January and cover my own costs from then on. I'm calling them Sunday, what do I actually say?
邻居刘姐出差一周，托我喂她的猫年糕。今天下午我开门拿快递，年糕从门缝溜出去了，找了两个小时还没找到，已经在业主群发了照片，物业也在帮忙查监控。她明天晚上才回来，我得现在告诉她。

My old university friend Dev was diagnosed with bowel cancer last week and starts chemo on Monday 12 October. He asked me to tell our friends, including Sophie in Canada, who was close to him; he'd love messages but would rather not take calls for now. I'm texting Sophie.

I'm Ruth, and I've run Crumb & Co, a small bakery in Leeds, for seven years. The landlord is doubling the rent at renewal, so we're closing on Saturday Oct 31. I need to email our mailing list of about 900 people, a lot of them regulars.
我和老公在多伦多，今年春节不回国了，三月我要论文答辩，机票也贵了一倍，打算五一回去住两个星期。我爸妈每年从十月就开始盼、开始准备年货。想先在微信上跟他们说清楚，再约视频。

I'm an account manager. Our biggest client, Norland Freight, worth $180k a year, told me this morning they won't renew in January because a competitor, Carrow, quoted them about 30% lower; I've asked their COO for a call next week. I need to tell my VP, Dana, before Friday's forecast call.

We're moving from Denver to Seattle in January for my wife's new job. Our son Max is 8 and his best friend Leo lives next door. We want to tell him this weekend before he overhears it. What do I actually say?

Our nanny Rosa has looked after our twin girls for three years. They start full-day school in January, so we won't need her after Friday Dec 18. We're telling her in person tonight and want to follow up with a text, and we'll pay her four extra weeks.

I'm a wedding photographer. Aisha and Tom got married on Saturday. One of my memory cards failed and about 60 ceremony photos, including my front-on shots of the ring exchange, are gone; recovery software got nothing back. My second shooter, Jen, has the ring exchange from the side. I'm calling them this morning and want to follow up by email with a £400 refund and a free portrait session.
我11月要搬去杭州，答应把现在租的房子从11月1日起转租给好朋友小林，她已经跟她的房东说了10月底退租。今天我去问房东，房东说合同不允许转租，不同意。不过房东说如果小林愿意直接跟他签新合同，月租5200可以谈。

I'm renovating Mrs. Greene's bathroom. Today we lifted the old tub and found rot in two floor joists underneath, which has to be fixed before we can tile. It adds $2,400 and moves the finish from Friday Oct 9 to Wednesday Oct 14. I'm texting her photos now and would rather talk it through on a call before we go ahead.
我和大学同学阿峰去年合伙开了一家奶茶店，各投了8万，开张时我们说好“如果续租房租涨超过20%就关店”。今天房东通知11月底续租，月租从1万涨到1万5，涨了50%。阿峰这周在外地出差，我估计把设备转卖掉每人能拿回3万左右。

I run a six-person design studio. On Sept 21 I offered Lena a junior designer job starting Monday Oct 19, and she has already handed in her notice at her café job. Yesterday our biggest client cancelled a $90k contract, so I can't afford the hire and have to withdraw the offer; I'm calling her at 5pm today and emailing straight after, and I can pay her $1,800 (two weeks' salary), give her a reference and introduce her to two studio owners I know.
我是硕士生导师。学生小何原计划12月答辩，但这周复核发现她第三章的实验数据有问题，得重新做，论文达不到送审要求，答辩只能推到明年6月。她已经签了明年1月入职的工作。我愿意给她的用人单位写一封说明信，也想明天下午跟她当面谈。

I'm the volunteer adoption coordinator at a small cat rescue. Jenny Park's family were approved last week to adopt Mochi, a two-year-old tabby, and her kids have already been talking about her; their approval carries over to any of our cats. At Mochi's pre-adoption vet check yesterday she was diagnosed with a heart condition that needs a few months of monitoring with an experienced foster, so the adoption can't go ahead, and we have two other cats, Pepper and Juno, who are great with kids and whom the family could meet this Saturday, 3 October.
我和未婚夫商量好和平分手了，原定11月21日周六在南京办的婚礼取消。要在微信上给大约40位已经收到请柬的亲友发消息，已经收到的礼金我会在10月15日前一一退回。原因不想多说。
家里养了12年的狗豆豆查出肝癌晚期，兽医说它已经很痛苦，建议这周六上午安乐死，我和她爸都同意了。女儿在英国读研，跟豆豆最亲，这次赶不回来。想今晚先在微信上告诉她，周六可以开视频让她陪豆豆最后一程。

My neighbours Pat and Leo are away until Sunday. In last night's storm the big oak in my garden came down and flattened about 4 metres of their back fence and smashed their greenhouse; nobody was hurt and I've taken photos. I reported it to my home insurer this morning, a tree surgeon is coming Saturday morning to clear it, and I've decided to pay for the fence and greenhouse myself if insurance doesn't. Texting them now.

My teammate and close friend Priya and I both applied for the senior analyst role, and I got it. Our manager, Tom, announces it Monday at 10am and said I could tell her first, so I'm telling her in person on Friday. She's been working towards that role for two years.

I volunteer as an editor for Tidelines, a small poetry anthology. My close friend Mara submitted three poems and none made the final cut; the panel reads every submission blind and we picked 24 out of 310. The results email goes out Monday Oct 5, the next call opens in March, and I want to text her before the email lands.
上个月我在一个网上认识的“理财导师”推荐的平台上投了6万，是我和老公一起攒的存款，现在平台打不开，人也联系不上了。我昨天已经去派出所报了案。老公还不知道，他今晚7点下班回家，我想先发条微信让他有个准备，回家再当面说。

My colleague Owen spent two months on a four-day-week pilot proposal, and leadership turned it down at Tuesday's review: they won't consider it before the new financial year in April, though they called his staff survey data strong. Owen wasn't in the room, and our director Hannah asked me to tell him before her formal note goes out on Friday. I was in the review and I'm messaging him on Slack.

Me llamo Inés y alquilo un apartamento turístico en Valencia. Ayer reventó una tubería y el piso estará en obras al menos tres semanas, así que tengo que cancelar la reserva de Marta y Jorge, que llegaban el viernes 9 de octubre para cuatro noches por 480 €. Hoy ya les he devuelto el importe completo, y mi vecina Carmen tiene un apartamento libre esas fechas en la misma calle por 440 €. Les escribo por la plataforma.
我是小区水果团购的团长。32户邻居一共预付了4800元订阳光玫瑰葡萄，供货商收钱后电话打不通，微信也把我拉黑了。我昨天已经报警，也决定自己先垫付，10月9日前把钱按大家当初的付款方式全部退回。要在团购群里说。

I'm Josh, singer in our four-piece band, Low Tide. The other three of us have decided to part ways with our drummer, Callum, after four years, because we want to tour next year and he can't take time off his job; his playing isn't the issue. He can play our Halloween show on Saturday 31 October as his last gig if he wants, and he gets his equal quarter of the £1,200 in the band account. He's coming round tonight and I don't know how to open.

My brother Daniel needs a kidney transplant and I went through donor testing for him. On Wednesday the transplant coordinator told me I'm not a compatible match. He's still on the waiting list, and she'll go through other options with him, including a paired exchange scheme, at his appointment on Wednesday 14 October; I want to offer to come with him. I'm calling him tonight and don't know how to open.
今天查了法考客观题成绩，我差6分没过。这一年我在家全职备考，爸妈每个月给我2000块生活费，一直盼着我考过。我想好了不再考了，这周就开始投简历找工作。想今晚先在微信上跟他们说，周末回家再当面聊。
今年五月我结婚时，表姐把外婆留给她的玉镯借给我戴，后来一直放在我这儿没还。昨天搬家打包时我没收好，镯子掉在地上断成了两截，是我的错。我问了一位老师傅，说可以用金包镶接起来，大概1500元，我愿意出这笔钱，但修不修应该由表姐定；镯子我已经用盒子包好，想先发微信再给她打电话。
我爷爷88岁，一个人住，耳朵不太好。他在老家的亲弟弟、我三爷爷，昨天夜里在医院去世了，堂叔今早打电话告诉我，让我去跟爷爷说。爷爷和三爷爷感情最好，上个月还视频过。我今天下午去爷爷家当面说，葬礼在这周日，我可以开车带他回去。

A fellow team lead, Priya, proposed in our Slack thread that the whole team move from our current tracker, which keeps slowing us down, to a new tool, Trackly, mid-quarter. Our SOC 2 audit evidence lives in the tracker and the audit is Dec 9, so I'd rather pilot Trackly with one squad now and move everyone in January.
老公想把家里30万存款全部拿去买理财，我觉得至少要留8万做应急。想跟他说清楚又不想吵架。
My dad and I disagree about electric cars, and he brings it up every time we text. I've told him my view once and don't want to keep going back and forth. We're watching the game together on Sunday.
部门群里大家都赞成把周会从周三挪到周一早上8点半，领导也说挺好。我觉得不合适，因为我们组周一上午9点到11点要跟华南区对账，想在群里提议改到周一下午2点。

Mon associé veut baisser tous nos prix de 20 % pour remplir le carnet de commandes d'ici décembre. On a une petite menuiserie, nos marges tournent autour de 25 %. Je pense que c'est une erreur mais je ne veux pas qu'on se braque.

My mother-in-law Linda, who raised three kids, keeps saying we should put our 4-month-old Leo on his tummy to sleep because 'all my kids were fine'. Our pediatrician, Dr. Shah, said back only, and we swaddle him so he settles. She's babysitting Saturday and I need to text her without starting a war.

GitHub code review. A senior engineer, Sam, commented on my PR asking me to switch our date formatting to moment.js. I think native Intl.DateTimeFormat is better: moment is in maintenance mode and would add about 70 KB minified for the three date formats we use. I don't want to look like I'm fighting a senior dev in a public thread.

My 17-year-old daughter Ava just told me she's not applying to college this fall; she wants a gap year teaching at a surf school in Portugal. I actually like the gap year idea, I just think she should apply now and defer. She gets defensive fast.

I'm on our community garden committee. At last night's meeting everyone liked Frank's idea of spraying weed killer on the paths to save weeding time. The paths run right beside the plots the local school's kids grow food in. I want to post in our committee group chat.
我妈想把她和我爸住了三十年的老房子卖了，给我和老公凑首付。她说“反正以后也是你们的”。我们俩再攒一年半也能凑够，我不想让他们这么做，但不想让她觉得我不领情。

I'm a freelance web designer. My client Marco, who owns an Italian restaurant, wants me to take the prices off the online menu so people 'come in and see'. I think it'll cost him bookings, but it's his call and I want to keep the relationship good. Email.

My friend Nadia texted that The Salt House, the novel we both read for book club, is the best thing she's read this year, and asked what I thought. I liked the first half, but I found the second half slow, mostly because the sister's storyline just stops. I don't want to dampen her enthusiasm.

I manage a design team of five. In today's team meeting Tariq, our junior designer who joined four months ago, proposed redesigning the whole onboarding flow this quarter, with drop-off numbers showing most new users quit during onboarding. I think it's too big with our Nov 20 release, but I don't want to crush his first big idea. Replying in Slack.
对门邻居王阿姨提议两家合出钱在楼道口装一道铁门，把我们这头的公共楼道圈起来放鞋柜，每家出1500，她说是为了安全，前阵子楼里丢过快递。物业之前在业主群里说过楼道不能加门、不能堆东西。我们做了十年邻居，关系一直很好。

Final-round interview for a design lead role on Friday. Last round the design director, Paula, said they're cutting user research entirely to ship faster, and I'm sure she'll ask what I think. At my last job, two days of calls with five users caught a checkout problem that would have cost a full sprint to undo. I disagree with her, but I want the job and don't want to sound preachy. Spoken.
同期の佐藤さんが部の会議で、来月から全員Excelで日報を出す案を出し、課長は来週決めると言いました。うちのチームはすでにチャットで毎日進捗を共有しているので二重になると思います。会議の場ではなく、佐藤さんに個別にチャットで伝えたいです。
好朋友阿琳想辞职开奶茶店，打算把攒了五年的20万全投进去，店面选在她家小区门口那条街。那条街上已经有4家奶茶店了。她问我怎么看，我觉得风险太大，但不想泼冷水。

My brother Paul wants to move our mum, 81, into a care home after her fall in August. I think we should first try a carer three mornings a week for two months; her care assessment said she could manage at home with that support. Paul lives nearby and does most of the visiting, and I'd cover the carer's cost and come up every other weekend. I don't want to sound like I'm judging from a distance.
我是博士生。导师王老师想让我两周内把论文投出去，赶在年底前有结果。我觉得现在只有一个数据集，审稿人很可能会要求补实验，返修反而更慢。补一组对照实验大概要三周。想在微信上跟他说。

Mi compañera de piso Irene quiere contratar a una limpiadora cada dos semanas, 60 euros al mes entre las dos. A mí también me agobia cómo está la cocina, pero desde que me bajaron las horas en el trabajo voy justa y prefiero seguir con el cuadrante de limpieza. Se lo quiero decir por WhatsApp sin que se lo tome mal.

In today's incident review for last week's outage, my peer Kyle said the root cause was that Jana, our junior engineer, ran the database migration on production without checking. Jana is in the room. I think the real cause is that our deploy script lets anyone run migrations on production without a second approval, and I want to say it out loud without making Kyle look bad.
爷爷82岁，打算春节自己开车回河北老家，单程四百公里，他说开了五十年车没问题，到了老家用车也方便。上个月他倒车时刮了两次邻居的车。我想周末当面提议这次我来开，但不想伤他面子。

In our hiring debrief, the hiring manager Laura wants to pass on Omar because he 'wasn't a culture fit', mainly because he was quiet at the team lunch. I ran his technical interview and scored him the strongest of the five candidates. I'm a peer interviewer and want to say this in the meeting without putting Laura on the spot.

I'm one of four volunteer moderators on a 3,000-member Discord for indie game devs. Fellow mod Jess wants to permanently ban Ray, who's been helpful there for two years, over one heated post on Tuesday where he called someone's game 'lazy garbage'. Our rules say a first offence gets a warning or a 7-day mute. I'm replying in the private mod channel.

I'm a hairdresser. My regular client Bea is booked for this Saturday and texted that she wants to go from her dark brown to platinum blonde in one session for a wedding on the 17th. Her hair's been bleached twice this year and snapped at the ends last time, so I'd rather take her to a soft caramel blonde on Saturday and finish the platinum in a second session three weeks later.
部门同事群里，小刘提议给下个月退休的张师傅凑钱买礼物，每人500元，已经有三四个人回了“好”。我觉得心意到了就行，500元对刚来的几个实习生压力太大，想在群里提议每人随意、上限200元。
