My aunt Linda comments on my weight at every family dinner. I've deflected it at least five times. Thanksgiving is next month and I want to text her before then.
每年过年大伯都当着一桌人问我一个月挣多少，我不想说，也不想让场面尴尬。大伯退休后在院子里种了个小菜园。
実家に帰るたびに母から「結婚はまだ？」と聞かれます。けんかにはしたくないけど、そろそろやめてほしい。母は先月、友達と旅行に行ってきたばかりです。

I finally texted my mum asking her to stop asking when I'm moving back to Manila. She replied 'So I can't even ask my own daughter anything now.' She sounds really hurt. I'm flying home for Christmas on 19 December.

My husband's parents ask 'so when are you giving us a grandchild?' at every family dinner. We're in the middle of IVF and don't want to tell anyone yet. Diwali dinner is at their place in a few weeks.

My brother Mike and his wife just separated. Aunt Carol, who's been redoing her kitchen all summer, texted me 'So what really happened with Mike and Jen?? Was it her?' I'm not going to gossip about my brother.
我在上海做游戏策划，干得挺开心。每次打电话我妈都劝我回老家考公务员，说图个稳定。她前阵子说想学用手机拍视频。国庆要回家待五天，我不想一回去就吵起来。

Minha sogra, dona Célia, pergunta toda semana quando vamos batizar a Lívia, que tem seis meses. A gente ainda não decidiu se vai batizar e não quer discutir isso com ela. Domingo tem almoço na casa dela.

Every year my grandma asks if I'll come to midnight Mass with the family on Christmas Eve. I stopped going to church years ago and I'm not going, but she's 88 and I don't want to hurt her. The family has dinner at her house after Mass, and I'm happy to come at 6 to help cook. She asked again on the phone this week.
家族微信群里二姨当着所有人@我：“老二什么时候安排上？你家朵朵都四岁了。”二姨的女儿下个月办婚礼。我和老公还没想好要不要二胎，不想在群里解释，也不想让二姨下不来台。

My divorce from Mark was finalised in June. At my cousin's wedding on Saturday my great-aunt Rosa will definitely ask what happened, probably at the dinner table. I don't want to talk about it or make a scene.
国庆回老家，一大家子吃饭时，我婶婶每次都当着我儿子小宇（10岁）的面问他期中考了第几名，还拿他跟表哥比，说表哥次次第一。孩子每次都低着头不说话。他最近在搭一个航母模型。这次想提前想好怎么接。

I've been sober for eight months. At every family barbecue my uncle Dave hands me a beer, and when I say no he jokes 'what, you pregnant or something?' His 60th is on Saturday and I don't want to explain my recovery to the whole patio.

I'm gay and out to my parents, but not to my 85-year-old grandma Rose. Every visit she asks if I've 'found a nice girl yet'. I don't want to lie to her and I'm not ready to tell her. Lunch at hers on Sunday.
国庆第一次带男朋友小陈回老家见亲戚。我舅妈说话很直，肯定会当着他的面问他家有没有房、一年挣多少。她做的桂花糖藕是一绝。我不想让他难堪，也不想跟舅妈闹僵。

I was laid off in August and I'm job hunting. At Sunday dinner my uncle Ray asked 'so, found anything yet?' and I said 'When there's news, you'll hear it first' and asked about his fishing trip. Twenty minutes later he's asking again in front of everyone.

Estamos en la comida del domingo en casa de mi tía Maribel. Ya me ha preguntado dos veces cuándo vamos a dejar de 'tirar el dinero en alquiler', y ahora lo ha soltado delante de todos: 'a vuestra edad ya deberíais tener algo propio'. Su hija Lucía acaba de volver de hacer el Camino de Santiago.
年夜饭上，我已经跟姑姑说过两次“结婚这个话题不聊了”。她刚才又当着全家人说：“三十五了还嫁不出去，肯定是自己有问题。”这次明显是故意让我难堪。

We adopted our daughter Lucia (6) from Colombia. At Easter my aunt Pam asked right in front of her whether we know anything about 'her real mother', and I'm sure she'll ask again at Sunday lunch at hers. Lucia spent this morning drawing a dinosaur for Pam.

I've been a stay-at-home dad since our twins were born two years ago, and my wife Priya and I are happy with the arrangement. Her dad, Gerald, keeps asking at family lunches 'so when are you going back to real work?' He's been building a garden bench in his new workshop. Lunch at theirs on Sunday.
我32岁，我妈又没问我就给我约了相亲，这周六下午见她同事的儿子。前两次我都去了，这次不想去，以后也不想她再帮我约。周六下午我正好有空，可以回家陪她吃饭。她最近在跟小区阿姨们排广场舞准备比赛。在微信上回她。
我今年高三，每次家里聚会舅舅都当着一桌人问我模拟考多少分、想考哪个大学，还说“考不上985就白读了”。这周六外婆过八十大寿，一大家子吃饭。舅舅最近迷上了钓鱼。

My dad's wake is on Saturday and I know my cousin Gary will ask me, probably in front of people, who's getting Dad's house. My sister Claire and I haven't sorted the will yet and we're not discussing it with anyone. Gary and Dad went fishing together most weekends.

I'm seven months pregnant with our first, a boy. My father-in-law, Emeka, asks on every family video call whether we'll name him after his late father, Obinna; my husband Chidi and I haven't decided and aren't sharing names before the birth. He's been teaching himself to bake bread since he retired, and the next call is Sunday.

Depuis qu'il a appris que j'ai été suivie pour une dépression l'an dernier, mon oncle Bernard me demande à chaque repas de famille si je « prends toujours mes cachets ». Je vais bien et je ne veux pas en parler devant tout le monde. Dimanche on fête les 60 ans de ma tante Sylvie, et Bernard vient de se mettre à la randonnée.
我前阵子在手臂上纹了一小枝桂花。国庆回老家吃饭，表姨一看见就当着一桌人问：“纹这个以后还怎么找工作？你妈也不管管？”表姨家今年刚换了新车，她特别爱聊。
我和未婚夫明年五一结婚，我们商量好只办五桌，请最亲的家人和朋友。我妈每次打电话都说至少要办三十桌，“亲戚们都等着呢”。她最近在挑婚礼那天穿的旗袍。

It's an election year, and my father-in-law, Walt, asks me at every Sunday dinner who I'm voting for, then lectures me whatever I say. I keep my vote private. He just finished restoring a 1968 pickup and loves talking about it.
我男朋友阿凯离过婚，有个6岁的女儿。奶奶知道后，每次视频都劝我“别找二婚的”。我们感情很好，我不想跟奶奶争，也不想替他解释。奶奶最近在阳台上养了几盆多肉，天天拿给我看。
我吃素两年了，每次去奶奶家吃饭，她都往我碗里夹肉，说“不吃肉哪来的营养，你看你脸色”。我跟她解释过好几次，没用。这周日去她家吃饭，她最近在学做手工月饼，天天在家族群里发照片。
我和老公结婚五年，已经商量好不要孩子。公公每次家宴都当着一桌人说“趁年轻赶紧生，不然以后后悔”。他最近在练毛笔字，前几天说在写一幅“宁静致远”。
我下个月结婚。国庆家宴上，三姨肯定会当着一桌人问“男方给了多少彩礼”，还会拿她儿媳家比。彩礼是我们两家私下商量好的，双方都满意，我不想说数字。三姨最近在学跳交谊舞，一聊起来就停不下来。
女儿下个月办满月酒，她跟我姓，这是我和老公商量好的，公婆也同意。老公的堂伯说话很冲，肯定会当着一桌人问“孩子怎么跟妈姓，是不是倒插门”。堂伯今年刚抱上孙子，三句话离不开他孙子。

I'm 72 and widowed four years. Since I started seeing Harold, a retired teacher I met at the library, my son Paul asks on every phone call whether Harold is 'after the house' and whether we're going to marry. I'm not discussing my relationship or my money with him. Paul has just started coaching his daughter's soccer team.

Since my brother moved to Canada, my dad asks on every Sunday phone call when I'm going to take over his hardware shop, which has been his life for 30 years. I'm a nurse, I love my job, and I'm not taking the shop on, but I've never said so outright. He's been restoring his old motorbike since the summer.
我在深圳工作，攒了一些钱。我妈打电话说弟弟明年结婚要买房，让我出20万帮他凑首付，说“你是姐姐，应该的”。我不打算出这笔钱，也不想跟她吵；弟弟婚礼那天我会包个红包。我妈最近在跟邻居学打太极。
Matched with a girl on Hinge. Her profile says she ran the Tokyo marathon, and one prompt is 'my most irrational fear: ramen that isn't hot enough'.
想从产品运营转做用户研究。在领英上看到一位在大厂做UX研究的前辈陈然，她写过一篇《5个用户够不够》，讲可用性测试样本量，我读完第一次弄明白了。想私信请教一个问题。
I'm building my first walnut side table and DMed a woodworker on Instagram asking what finish he uses on his walnut tables. He just replied 'hardwax oil, two thin coats' and nothing else.

I emailed a researcher I don't know, Dr. Ines Alvarez, on Sept 21 with one quick question: are the 2023 sensor readings in her public urban heat dataset hourly or daily averages? No reply after 8 days. Is one follow-up okay?
Hice match en Bumble con Lucía. En una foto sale con un galgo y en su perfil dice que es de Cádiz y que "el mejor pescaíto frito no está en Cádiz", sin decir dónde.

I'm Kate. My 6-year-old Zoe keeps talking about a boy in her class (1B), Oscar; they play dinosaurs every break. I don't know his parents. The class WhatsApp shows his mum is Hannah. I'd like to suggest a playdate.

Just moved to Leeds and found a board game group on Meetup. The organiser, Tom, posted about a Wingspan night on Thursday Oct 8. I've only played Wingspan twice and never been to one of these groups, so I want to message him first.
上周六在北京三里屯参加了一场播客线下分享会，嘉宾苏晴讲了怎么从听众来信里挑选题，我觉得特别好，但当天没来得及跟她聊。我自己在做一个聊城市散步的小播客，想在小红书私信她。
Matched with Sam on Hinge. His profile is almost empty: one photo of him holding a cello in what looks like a kitchen, and the only prompt answer is 'ask me'. No idea what to open with.

I DMed a woman on our city's climbing Discord to thank her for her beta on a V5 at the gym, then asked if she wanted to climb together sometime. She replied that she's only there to talk climbing and finds DMs from strangers asking to meet up uncomfortable.
我在HelloTalk上找日语语伴。看到一个在学中文的日本女生，资料里写上个月刚爬完富士山，还说《龙猫》看了二十遍。想发第一条消息。
我平时画画只是爱好。上周去了杭州一家新开的咖啡馆'慢岛'，那杯咖啡我到现在还记得，回家凭记忆画了一张店门口的水彩速写，想发在自己的小红书上。看到老板在小红书上发帖说豆子都是自己去云南保山挑的，想先私信问问他介不介意，也想把原画送给店里。

Matched with a guy on Tinder and he opened with just 'hey'. His profile says he's a firefighter and his photos are mostly bowls he's made on a pottery wheel. I want to reply with something better than 'hey' back.

A DNA-testing site matched me as a likely second cousin with Margaret Kelly in Cork. Her public tree has a Bridget Doyle born 1911 in Kilkenny, and my great-grandmother Nora Doyle was born there in 1908 and emigrated to Boston. I'm in Boston and want to message her through the site.

My husband and I bought 212 Elm Street, a 1920s house in Asheville, this summer. In the attic we found a box of letters and photos addressed to the Whitfield family, including a 1961 photo of a girl on the porch swing. A neighbour says the daughter, Carol Whitfield, now lives in Ohio and gave me her email.

Found a room in a shared house on Cowley Road in Oxford, £720 a month. The poster, Priya, says she's a nurse on night shifts, wants a quiet housemate, and has a very spoiled cat called Mango. She mentions she's had loads of messages. I work 9 to 5 in a library and I'm a quiet homebody.

I've used a small open-source note-taking tool for my thesis notes for three months; the keyboard-only capture is why I switched. It's maintained by one person, Jonas Weber, and the README says 'translations welcome, but open an issue first'. I'm a native Traditional Chinese speaker and happy to translate the UI and keep it updated for new releases.
上周六在朋友婚礼上跟一个女生坐同一桌，她叫林夏，聊了几句，她说最近在学拉坯，第一个碗歪成了烟灰缸。当时加了微信，但一周了谁都没说话，想发第一条消息。

On our neighbourhood app, a woman called Ines posted that she's on parental leave with a 4-month-old and looking for someone to do morning walks with around Victoria Park. I'm on leave too with my 5-month-old, Theo, and honestly a bit lonely. I want to message her directly.

Sur Instagram, une photographe, Camille Roux, publie des devantures de vieux commerces de Lyon. Son dernier post montre la boulangerie de la rue Ney, que tenait mon grand-père jusqu'en 1985 ; on voit encore son nom peint au-dessus de la vitrine. Je ne la connais pas et je veux lui écrire.

I'm 68 and a retired carpenter, 40 years in the trade. A young man in our town's online community group, Kwame, posted that he's restoring an old wooden rowing boat down by the harbour and doesn't know how to replace the rotten transom. I'd love to help and I've done that job plenty of times.

En un mercadillo de Madrid compré una taza azul de un taller llamado Barro Lento y la uso cada mañana. En su Instagram la ceramista, Inés, enseña cómo esmalta con ceniza de olivo. Me caso en mayo y quiero preguntarle si haría 12 tazas iguales para regalar a los invitados.

I'm 61, widowed three years, and this is my first time on a dating app. Matched with Helen, 58; her profile says she's restoring a 1970s caravan, and one photo shows it half-painted in mint green. I have no idea what people say first these days.

This morning I found a small brown dachshund with a red collar but no tag wandering near the Elm Park playground, and she's safe at my flat now. In our neighbourhood group chat, a woman called Tara posted last night that her dachshund Pip went missing near Elm Park. I want to message Tara without giving away every detail, so the real owner can confirm it's her dog.
我住502，楼上602好像新搬来一户，每天晚上八点左右会弹半小时钢琴，最近一直在练《卡农》，我挺爱听的。我小时候学过八年琴。不知道他们叫什么，想在他们门上贴张纸条打个招呼。
在B站关注了一位修老电子管收音机的UP主“老周修旧”，他上个月那期讲怎么判断滤波电容有没有鼓包，我反复看了三遍。我爷爷留下一台六十年代的电子管收音机，通电后只有嗡嗡声，没有台。想私信问他一个问题。

Every Saturday at the Riverside Saturday 5k I finish within a few seconds of a woman called Aiko; we've never spoken. She's in our running club's Strava group and last week posted a new 5k PB of 24:10 with the caption 'finally kept it together in the last km'. I want to message her there.
我叫林晓，下个月去成都读大一。新生系统显示我和一个叫苏蔓的女生分在同一间宿舍，我在新生群里找到了她，她朋友圈刚发了自己养的三盆多肉，配文“只要不死就算成功”。想加她微信，第一句话不知道说什么。

My daughter Maya, 9, was diagnosed with type 1 diabetes in July, and her first school camp is in November. On a forum for type 1 families, a dad called Rob posted that his son has done three school camps on his insulin pump, and that they always write a one-page plan for the teachers. I want to message him.

I'm Tom Hale, a parish councillor, and I'm on a panel about rural broadband at the Northfield Planning Forum on Thursday 15 October with people I've never met. One of them, Dr. Grace Obi, wrote a report on community-owned broadband networks that we've quoted in two of our council papers, especially her finding that volunteer-dug trenches cut costs by about a third. The organisers shared our emails and I want to write to her before the panel.

I'm doing an online evening course in Python while working full-time. On the course forum, a classmate called Farah posted a solution to the week 3 exercise using zip that was far cleaner than my three nested loops, and she mentioned she's on UK time and studies after work too. I'd like to message her and maybe compare notes on the weekly exercises.

Ich studiere Geschichte in Leipzig und schreibe meine Bachelorarbeit über die Montagsdemonstrationen im Herbst 1989. Im Online-Forum unseres Stadtteilvereins in Gohlis hat ein Herr Werner Vogel geschrieben, dass er am 9. Oktober 1989 mit 24 Jahren auf dem Ring mitgelaufen ist und sein selbst gemaltes Plakat noch im Keller hat. Ich kenne ihn nicht und möchte ihn um ein Gespräch von etwa 30 Minuten bitten, am Telefon oder in einem Café; die Fragen würde ich vorher schicken.

I'm a night-shift nurse in Glasgow. I just finished Ruth Okonkwo's novel The Night Ward, and the scene where the nurse writes the 4am handover on her own arm in biro is exactly what I've done on bad nights. Her website has a contact form, and I want to write to her without expecting a reply.

A local indie band, The Paper Lanterns, posted in our city's online musicians' group that they need a bassist for gigs starting in January. Their demo of 'Low Tide' has a walking bass line in the bridge that I love. I've played bass for five years in a covers band and want to message their singer, Mia, who posted it.

I took on a plot at our town allotments in the spring. The woman on the next plot, who I've never spoken to, grows huge dahlias, and she's there weeding today. Slugs ate my first dahlias down to stumps, and I want to say something to her as I walk past.

My name is Ellen Marsh, I'm a structural engineer in Bristol, and I just found another Ellen Marsh on LinkedIn who is also a structural engineer, in Melbourne. A recruiter emailed me this week congratulating me on the Yarra footbridge, which turns out to be her project. I want to send her a friendly first message.

I'm Alina. Had a final-round interview yesterday for a product designer role at Larkspur Health with the head of design, Marcus. He talked a lot about their accessibility audit. I fumbled a question about design systems: I forgot to say that at my last job, at Norvell, I set up the shared component library, which cut our handoff time roughly in half.
我是陈静。今天下午和合作方开了项目启动会，定了几件事：先做华东区试点，对方的孙经理10月9日前提供门店数据，我10月10日前出排期。想发个会后纪要。
Interviewed for an account manager job at Crestline Logistics 5 weeks ago; the recruiter, Hannah, said I'd hear back within two weeks. I sent one check-in two weeks ago and still nothing.

Had a phone screen today with Grace, the director of Harbor Food Bank, for the program manager role. She said long wait times at the pantries are the biggest complaint from clients, and invited me to a final round on Wednesday 7 October at 10am at their Pier Street warehouse with her and the operations lead, Ben. She asked me to bring a one-page plan for cutting wait times.
今天约了行业前辈刘老师喝咖啡，聊了一个小时。她建议我找一个产品从头到尾拆一遍，推荐了《用户体验要素》，还说可以把我介绍给她的前同事陈磊。我打算拿自己天天用的记账App来拆。想发微信谢谢她。

At the HospitalityX trade show yesterday I talked for 10 minutes at our stand with Priyanka, head of procurement at Aster Hotels. We sell commercial laundry equipment; our HX-40 washers use about 30% less power per load than the 2018 models most hotels are replacing. She said they're replacing machines at 3 properties next spring and asked about energy use. I have her card.

After Monday's kickoff with our design agency I sent a recap saying they'd deliver wireframes by Friday Oct 9. Their lead, Tom, replied-all: 'That's not what we agreed, we said the 9th for the homepage only and the other pages the week after.' Thinking back, he's probably right.

I'm Maya. Had my 1:1 with my manager Dana today about getting promoted to senior engineer. She said if I lead the billing migration (cutover planned for 15 January) and mentor our new hire Theo, she'll put me forward in the March cycle. I want it in writing without sounding like I'm lawyering her.

I'm an internal candidate for team lead on our support team of six. Interviewed yesterday with the director, Renata. She asked how I'd lead people who were my peers until last week, and I think my answer was too vague. Want to send her a thank-you on Slack.

I'm Rachel Moore. Met today with my son Oliver's Year 5 teacher, Mrs Adeyemi, and the SENCO, Mr Hart, about his reading. We agreed he gets three extra reading sessions a week with the TA from Monday Oct 5, I read with him 15 minutes each evening, and we review on Monday Nov 16. I want a recap so it doesn't get lost.
我叫陈宇。9月22日终面了一家新能源车企的供应链岗位，HR刘女士说上周五前给结果，到今天还没消息，我还没催过。手上另一家的offer要10月9日前答复，但我更想去这家。国庆马上放假了。

I'm Arun. Pitched my B2B invoicing startup yesterday to Sofia Marin, a partner at Northbeam Ventures. She pushed hard on our churn and asked to see monthly cohort retention; we have cohorts since January 2025, and the March dip was two customers lost when their payroll platform shut down. Her partner meeting is Monday Oct 12.

Je suis Claire Martin. Hier, entretien pour un poste de chargée de communication à la mairie de Villeurbanne, devant la directrice de la communication, Mme Garnier, un élu, M. Delorme, et une RH, Mme Haddad. Mme Garnier a beaucoup parlé de la refonte du journal municipal. Sur les réseaux sociaux, j'ai oublié de dire qu'à la communauté de communes du Val d'Ozon j'avais rédigé la charte de modération. Je voudrais remercier sans en faire trop.
今天和房东王阿姨当面谈了续租：她同意11月1日起房租从4500涨到4700，签两年，10月底前她找人把坏了的热水器换掉。都是口头说的，我想发个微信确认一下。
今天跟合作方开会，对方李总和我在交付时间上争得有点僵，我当时语气也冲了。最后定了分两期交付：第一期11月20日，第二期12月18日，他们10月16日前给齐素材。想发个会后纪要，顺便把气氛缓和一下。

I'm Maria. Had a video interview yesterday for a data analyst role at Brightwell Insurance with the hiring manager, Olu. He talked about moving the claims team from monthly spreadsheets to a live dashboard. My wifi dropped for about ten minutes, so we rushed my SQL case study answer at the end; he was gracious about it, and I've since written my approach up properly on half a page.

Today's meeting with facilities and HR about the office move ended without deciding whether we move on Dec 12 or Jan 9. We agreed it depends on whether the new lease can start Dec 1, which Greta in facilities will confirm with the landlord by Monday Oct 5, and that we'll decide at Tuesday's meeting on Oct 6. I said I'd send the updated seating plan by Friday Oct 2.

I'm Tom. In yesterday's renewal meeting with our client Hollis Dental, their ops manager Grace Liu asked for one invoice covering all four clinics, and I told her the new plan would cut their $3,000 monthly fee by 15%. I checked this morning and it's actually 11%, so $2,670 a month, not $2,550. She's taking the numbers to her CFO on Monday Oct 5.

I viewed a one-bed flat on Elm Row yesterday with the letting agent, Sarah. At least five other people were there. I told her I can move in from November 1, and she mentioned the landlord wants a long-term tenant and is fine with my cat as long as I pay the pet deposit.

The recruiter at Fenwick Labs, Dana Ruiz, called me this afternoon with a verbal offer for the UX researcher role: $92,000 salary, starting Monday Nov 2, 25 days' leave, and working from home on Fridays. She asked me to reply by Monday Oct 5. I want to accept, but only once it's in writing.

Dave, a roofer from Keel Roofing, came round yesterday to look at our leaking roof and showed us photos from the loft of where the water gets in. My husband Tom has been learning guitar for a year and wants to play and sing a song at his mum's 70th in two weeks. He played it for me tonight and asked what I really think. The chord changes are solid now, but he speeds up as soon as he starts singing.

My friend Ollie hosted his first dinner party on Saturday for eight of us and texted the next day asking how it really went, because he's hosting his in-laws next month. The lamb was excellent, but he spent most of the night alone in the kitchen and we didn't eat the main until after 10pm.

Mon ami Julien a organisé notre week-end à quatre à Lisbonne du 23 au 25 octobre et m'a demandé ce que je pensais vraiment du programme. Les restaurants qu'il a choisis ont l'air géniaux, mais chaque journée est remplie de 8 h à minuit, sans aucune pause.

Hired a freelance designer, Amara, for our cafe logo. The first round of 3 concepts came in; the lettering on concept 2 is lovely, but all three feel corporate, and we're a tiny neighbourhood cafe with mismatched mugs and a chalkboard menu. Round two is included and I don't want to crush her.
我爸退休后开始写回忆录，写完前三章发给我，说想听听真实意见。写他1978年进厂当学徒、师傅让他锉了一整天铁块那段写得很好，但大部分是按年份一件件记流水账，读着有点累。

My friend Dani did her first open mic last week and asked what I thought. I told her the dentist opener killed but the middle bit about dating apps felt like stuff we've heard before. Now she's texting 'so you thought it was bad?? just tell me it was good'.

My 17-year-old son Eli asked me to read his college essay, due Nov 1. It's all about winning the state debate final and reads like a résumé. The one paragraph about his grandpa driving him to practice at 6am is the only part that sounds like him.
闺蜜小雨准备在相亲软件上重新写个人资料，发给我让我提真实意见。照片选得挺好，尤其是在大理骑车那张，但自我介绍全是“不要抽烟的”“不要妈宝男”这种，读下来像在设门槛。

My friend Nadia just launched her jewelry shop on Etsy and posted the link in our group chat. The pieces are lovely, especially the hammered silver hoops, but the photos are dark and shot on a busy floral tablecloth. She didn't ask for feedback.

My friend Dev, 38, hasn't exercised in years and has signed up for a marathon on Sunday 22 November. He sent me his training plan and asked for my honest take: it has rest days and a food plan, but it jumps straight to 30-mile weeks, and last month he told me his knee has been aching.

My friend Priya shot our small wedding for free as her gift and sent 30 preview photos, asking what we think before she edits the other 400. The shot of my dad during the vows made me cry, but she's used a heavy orange filter on all but a few church shots and our skin looks very tanned. We're so grateful and don't want to hurt her.
8岁的女儿朵朵写了一篇作文《我的妈妈》，下周交给学校参加比赛，拿来问我写得怎么样。写我下雨天去接她、伞全往她那边歪那一段特别真，但后面一大段是“我的妈妈很漂亮，很勤劳，很善良”这样的套话。

My partner Mei finished the first draft of a short story at 1am and sent it to me with just 'thoughts?'. The opening line about her grandmother's sewing tin is perfect, but the ending feels rushed. She's often hard on herself late at night.
好朋友阿琳开了家咖啡店，这周试营业，特意请我去喝，让我提真实意见。手冲和肉桂卷都很好，但菜单上有二十多种饮品，我点单时纠结了半天，后面排队的人也等得不耐烦。

My friend Marcus wants to quit his warehouse job in the spring and put his $20,000 savings into a taco truck. He had me over to taste the menu and asked for my honest opinion. The food was genuinely great, especially the birria, but when I asked how many tacos a day he'd need to sell to cover costs, he said he hadn't worked that out yet.
表妹小雨10月10日周六要去纹身，把设计稿发给我问真实意见：手腕内侧一只小猫，尾巴绕成一个圈，下面是奶奶的名字“秀兰”。猫画得很可爱，但名字的字又细又小，我自己脚踝上那行小字三年后就有点糊了。
表姐怀孕七个月，打算给女儿起名“林梓涵”，发微信问我真实意见。我很喜欢“涵”字，她说是希望孩子有涵养。但“梓涵”这几年特别常见，我女儿班上就有两个梓涵。
我妈退休后开始在短视频平台上发自己做家常菜的视频，已经发了十几条，让我说说真实意见。我最喜欢红烧肉那条，她边做边讲特别亲切。就是每条都有5分钟左右，开头差不多两分钟在聊买菜和家长里短，真正做菜要等好久。
大学同学阿泽想从销售转行做数据分析，把简历发我让我提真实意见，下周一开始投。他自学半年做了一个分析外卖平台评论的项目，写得很扎实，但放在第二页最底下，第一页全是以前做销售的经历。

My friend Jess drafted an email to her landlord about the mould in her bathroom and asked if it's okay to send tonight. The facts are strong: she reported it on 3 August and 1 September and attached photos. But the last paragraph calls him a slumlord and says she'll 'make sure everyone knows what he's like'.

Mi pareja, Andrés, va a hacer paella para mis padres el sábado 10 de octubre, la primera vez que cocina para ellos. Anoche hizo una prueba y hoy me escribe por WhatsApp desde el trabajo: '¿Qué te pareció de verdad?'. El socarrat le salió perfecto, pero el arroz estaba bastante salado.

My friend Sam's dad died last week and the funeral is Saturday. Sam asked me to read his eulogy draft and be honest; he has five minutes. The story about his dad waking him at 5am to fish at Lake Wren is beautiful, but most of the rest is a list of his dad's jobs and dates.

My grandma Joan, 84, asked me on the phone why hardly anyone in the family replies to her emails. They're full of lovely news, like last week's one about the robins nesting in her porch light, but she writes everything in capital letters, and my younger cousins read that as shouting. I'm visiting her on Sunday and want to text her before then.
好朋友周周明天下午去一家律所面试行政岗，发来穿搭照片问我真实意见。米色西装外套很合身，但里面配的是一件印着大卡通图案的T恤。她衣柜里有件白衬衫，上次见她穿过。

My friend Callum spent three years writing his first fantasy novel and plans to send it to literary agents next month. He asked me to be brutally honest. The world-building is wonderful, especially the floating salt markets, but his hero Wren doesn't make a single choice of her own until chapter 6; things just happen to her.

Meu irmão Rafael está aprendendo a pintar retratos a óleo e me pediu uma opinião sincera sobre o retrato da nossa avó, que ele quer dar no aniversário de 90 anos dela, dia 18 de outubro. Os olhos ficaram idênticos, com aquele jeito dela quando ri, mas a pele ficou acinzentada e ela parece doente.
我在一个网上写作小组里，组员“青柠”发了一篇八千字的短篇小说求真实点评，写一个女孩在县城陪外婆度过的最后一个夏天。外婆教她腌梅子那段写得特别好，但结尾突然揭晓“原来一切都是梦”，我读完有点失落。我们素不相识。

My friend Leo has started a podcast interviewing local small-business owners and sent me episode 3, with the woman who runs the bike repair shop, asking what I really think before he records episode 4 on Saturday. His questions are well researched and the one about her first year nearly going bust was great, but he cuts in on her answers a lot, five or six times in the first ten minutes alone, and I kept losing her thread.

My mate Kris has been applying for warehouse supervisor jobs for four months with no callbacks. He sent me his CV only so I could print it at my office; he didn't ask for opinions. The line about rebuilding the stock system at Hallam's is strong, but it sits under a 400-word personal statement at the top.

Last Sunday my friend Hannah asked for honest thoughts on her wedding vows. I told her the line about her and Tom burning their first pancakes was perfect and that the middle section felt long to me. She replied 'ok thanks' and has been quiet for four days, which isn't like her. We usually go to yoga together on Thursdays.
弟弟小凯打算10月17日周六向女朋友求婚，今晚把求婚词念给我听，问我真实意见。开头讲他们第一次在雨天的公交站认识那段特别打动我，但后面一大半都是“以后我一定买大房子、让你过上好日子”，听着像在写保证书。

My friend Rosa built a website for her new dog-grooming side business and asked me to look at it before she shares it in our neighbourhood Facebook group on Monday. The before-and-after photos of the dogs are brilliant, but I couldn't find her prices until page three, inside a PDF, and I gave up twice on my phone before I got there.

My neighbour Graham, 70, wrote a short piece for the village newsletter asking for volunteers to tidy the memorial garden, and asked me to 'tear it apart'. Honestly it's good: the bit about his late wife planting the roses there is moving, and the ask is clear (Saturday 17 October, 10am, bring gloves). The only small gap is that it doesn't say who to contact if you can't come on the day but want to help.
闺蜜小芸今天剪了短发，比她想要的短了不少，明天要给表姐当伴娘，发自拍问我是不是剪坏了，让我说真话。其实我觉得短发很衬她的脖子，戴那对珍珠耳环更好看，只是刘海吹得太蓬，有点乱。她包里一直带着一小盒发蜡。
My coworker Jen presented our joint churn analysis to the VP yesterday and kept saying 'I found' for work I did. We're peers. I want to raise it with her one on one.

Just had a feedback conversation with my report Kevin about typos in client emails. We agreed he'll read client emails aloud before sending, and for the next month send anything to a new client to me first. Need the short written follow-up.
On 8 September I told my direct report Aisha she needs to be at our 9:30 standup on time. She's been late four times since, including today. I want to say it firmly in our 1:1.
我是小组长，上周私下跟组员小周说过，他的周报数据连着两次算错，让他发之前自己核一遍。今天这份又错了，我提了一句，他回我：大家周报都有错，你怎么只盯着我。

My manager Greg keeps sending me 'urgent for Monday' tasks on Slack after 6pm on Fridays. Third week running, I worked Sunday again. I want to raise it in our 1:1 this Thursday without sounding like I'm complaining.
我是设计组长。同级的产品经理老吴上周四在需求评审会上当着大家说我组里刚来两个月的设计师小林的方案“完全没想过用户”，小林会后哭了。老吴人不坏，就是说话冲，我想私下跟他聊聊。

I manage a dev team. Marcus, a senior engineer, left three comments on junior dev Leah's pull request last Thursday that just said 'wrong, redo'. She told me she's now nervous about opening PRs. I'm raising it in our 1:1 tomorrow.

Yesterday I told my report Hannah that her weekly client reports keep arriving Monday afternoon instead of by 9am. She explained her kid's school start moved and she can't be online before 10 now. I didn't know. I want to follow up in writing with a revised ask.

I manage an account manager, Dev. Twice this month he's promised clients a delivery date on the call without checking with production, and last Friday we had to walk back the Kessler date, which made us look bad. We have our 1:1 tomorrow.

Ich bin Teamlead in einem Remote-Team. Jonas aus dem Plattform-Team (gleiche Ebene) beantwortet Slack-Fragen oft erst nach zwei Tagen. Letzte Woche hat meine Frage zur API-Freigabe von Montag bis Mittwoch gewartet, und unser Release ist von Donnerstag auf Freitag gerutscht. Ich will es in einem kurzen Call ansprechen.

I coordinate volunteers at our food bank. Gerald, a retired volunteer of six years who's brilliant at logistics, told a mum at the pickup table on Saturday to 'hurry up, other people are waiting', and she left without her box. He's unpaid and I don't want to lose him.
我在运营组，同级的市场部同事阿伟最近三次在邮件里跟我有不同意见时，都直接抄送了我的领导和他的领导，其实当面五分钟就能说清。明天想约他喝咖啡聊一下。

I was promoted to lead our 5-person support team last month. Tom was my peer and is a good friend; we get drinks most Fridays. Twice this week he closed tickets as resolved without the customer confirming, and one customer reopened hers with an angry note. I need to raise it without it getting weird.

Rob, a senior engineer a level above me (not my manager), keeps repeating our new colleague Deepa's updates in standup in an exaggerated Indian accent, most recently on Monday and today. People laugh and Deepa laughs along, but she's barely spoken in the last two retros. I want to raise it with Rob privately.
我28岁，刚当上销售组长。组员老刘45岁，干了十几年，客户关系特别好，但一直不用公司的客户系统，跟进记录都记在自己本子上。上周他请假三天，华信的客户来催报价，组里没人知道进度，客户投诉到了陈总那儿。明天想找他单独聊。
我和同事小张是同组平级，工位挨着。他这两周经常在工位上外放短视频，声音不小。上周二下午我跟客户开电话会，客户问了一句“你那边在放什么”，挺尴尬的。想私下跟他说。

I manage Luis, an analyst whose dad died in July; he came back to work in August. Since then two reports for our client Halvorsen have come in late, due Sept 10 and Sept 24, and Halvorsen flagged the second one. I want to raise it kindly in our 1:1 on Thursday.
我是设计组组长。组里资深设计师雯雯能力很强，上周一晚上她没跟新人小杜打招呼，就把他做的首页方案整个重做了，周二客户评审直接讲了她的版本，小杜是在会上才知道的，事后跟我说挺受打击。明天和雯雯一对一，不想打击她的积极性。

My report Nadia just did a run-through of our client pitch with me for Friday Oct 2. She read most of her slides word for word and took 25 minutes; we have a 15-minute slot, and pricing is the last section. I'm free Thursday at 2pm for another run-through. I want to say it now, in person.

I'm head chef at a 40-cover bistro, and our kitchen uses red boards for raw meat. On Saturday night I saw our line cook Diego cut raw chicken and then the salad garnish on the same board without washing it; I pulled those plates before they went out. He's fast and the team likes him. I want to talk to him privately before Wednesday's shift.

My report Hiro told me on Monday, the day our data migration was due, that it wasn't done because the vendor's API had been down since the Tuesday before. He's careful and conscientious, and I think he didn't want to bother me. I want to raise it in our 1:1 tomorrow.

Owen and I are both account leads. On Tuesday's video call with our client Brightwater he cut in three times before I'd finished, once in the middle of the pricing, and the client asked me to repeat the number. I want to raise it with him on a call tomorrow.
我是运营组长。组员小林昨晚在朋友圈吐槽“甲方又改到第八版了”，配图是带着客户新禾食品logo的设计稿截图，而客户的对接人跟他是微信好友。他平时做事很拼，改稿次数的事我也打算去跟客户谈。想今天找他单独聊。

I manage Priya, a data engineer. In the last two weeks she's sent Slack messages at 1am or 2am at least six times, and on Tuesday her 2am deploy broke the morning dashboard. Two newer teammates have started replying late at night too. I want to raise it in our 1:1 on Monday.
我是项目经理。组里来了三个月的小郑负责在客户微信群里回消息，这周我看到他两次回客户用的是“亲～收到哈哈哈”，客户问交付时间那次他回“应该快了吧”。昨天客户方的刘总私下问我交付时间到底定没定。想今天找小郑单独聊。

In our last four project planning meetings, my peer Martin, who chairs them, has asked a woman to take notes every time: me twice and Sofia twice, never any of the men. I don't think he's noticed the pattern. I want to raise it with him privately before next Tuesday's planning meeting.

I manage Zara, a marketing analyst. Her market-sizing memo for Thursday's leadership review cites '68% of mid-size firms plan to switch vendors in 2027' with no source; I searched and couldn't find it anywhere, and she's mentioned she drafted parts of the memo with an AI tool. The rest of the memo is solid. I want to raise it with her today and get a sourced version by Wednesday noon.

I'm a charge nurse on a surgical ward. On Monday and Wednesday this week my colleague Kelsey did handover to the night shift without mentioning patients' allergies, and on Wednesday the night nurse nearly gave penicillin to the patient in bed 4, who is allergic; she caught it at the last check. Kelsey has been here eight years and is great with patients, and I'm talking to her privately before her shift tomorrow.

I manage Mateus, a support engineer in São Paulo; the rest of the team is in Berlin, five hours ahead, and he and I only overlap properly on Tuesdays. On the last two Monday handoffs, 21 and 28 September, his escalated tickets had no steps to reproduce, and each time the Berlin team lost about half a day waiting for him to come online to ask. I want to raise it today in a Slack DM rather than wait for Tuesday.
同组的同事小雅下周三要做晋升述职，今天把PPT发给我，说“帮我狠狠挑毛病”。一共32页，前20页都在列她这一年做过的事，她最大的成绩是把客户续约率从78%提到91%，却放在第27页才出现。述职一共只有15分钟。我想在微信上回她。

My co-founder Leo and I run a two-person design studio. On client calls on 14 and 29 September he agreed to extra revision rounds for free, beyond the two rounds in our contracts, and the Harbor Dental job ran 11 hours over. I want to raise it with him over coffee tomorrow.
チームリーダーをしています。メンバーの佐藤さんが、先週火曜と今週月曜の企画会議で、新人の出した案にすぐ「それは無理ですね、前にやって失敗したので」と返し、その後は誰も案を出さなくなりました。佐藤さんは経験豊富で頼りにしています。明日の1on1で伝えたいです。

Our annual 360 reviews are due Friday, and I'm writing peer feedback for Ines, a product manager I work with every day. In the last three sprints she has changed priorities mid-sprint in Slack threads QA wasn't in, and twice our testers spent about two days on features that were then dropped. The form has a 'one thing to change' box, she'll see my name, and I'm happy to talk it through with her.
我开了家面包店，表弟阿强在店里当店员半年了，手脚麻利。最近两周他给来店里的朋友免单了好几次，上周对账少了260元，监控里都能看到。家里人都知道他在我这儿干，我不想闹到亲戚那边，打算明天早上开店前单独跟他聊。
我是初二年级组长。新来的数学老师小李（工作第一年）上周五在班级家长群里发了全班月考成绩排名表，周末有两位家长私信我，说孩子看到自己排在后面，哭了一晚。学校规定成绩只单独发给每位家长。明天想找她单独聊。

I manage Ama, a junior account executive who joined six months ago. In the last two weeks she's sent me 14 client emails to approve before sending, including one-line meeting confirmations, and her Oakridge renewal email sat for a day waiting on me. Her emails are consistently good; I've barely changed one. I want to raise it in our 1:1 on Thursday: only emails about pricing or contract changes need to come to me.

I'm Marcus Lee, renting 2217 N Oakley Ave, Unit 3B in Chicago; section 14 of my lease says 60 days' written notice. I want to be out Dec 31. The property manager is Denise at a small management company.

Je suis propriétaire d'un T2 à Nantes, le bail se termine le 31 mai 2027 et ma fille va y habiter. Je veux prévenir les locataires, Julien et Sarah, avant d'envoyer la lettre recommandée, et leur proposer une attestation de bon locataire et de la souplesse s'ils trouvent plus tôt.
在上海租房，合同到明年3月，公司把我调去深圳，11月底就得走。房东是位王阿姨，合同写提前退租押金不退。我愿意帮她找下一位租客、配合带看，房租交到新租客入住为止。想跟她商量一下。

I emailed my landlord Mr Okoye yesterday giving a month's notice to leave my flat at 7 Cotham Road, Flat 3, Bristol, on 28 October. He says it's invalid because it's a rolling tenancy and notice has to end on the last day of a rent period. Rent is due on the 15th. I think he's right.

I'm Maya Collins. Three of us rent 42 Linden Street on a joint lease through Parkside Lettings (property manager Owen). Tomás Ruiz is moving to Madrid at the end of November; Aoife Byrne and I want to stay, and our friend Hana Mori wants his room from 1 December and can send references and ID this week.

Ich bin Jonas Weber und wohne zur Miete in der Karl-Heine-Straße 48, 2. OG links, 04229 Leipzig, unbefristeter Vertrag, gesetzliche Kündigungsfrist drei Monate. Für einen neuen Job in Hamburg will ich zum 31. Dezember raus; der unterschriebene Brief geht heute per Einschreiben an Frau Brandt von Mahler Immobilien. Besichtigungen gehen werktags ab 17 Uhr, Übergabe am liebsten Montag, 28. Dezember.

I asked my landlord Greg if I could end my lease on Nov 30 instead of March 31 because I'm moving to Denver for work. He replied 'A lease is a lease, you owe rent through March.' Rent is $1,850. I don't want a fight. I'd find a replacement tenant, keep paying rent until they move in, and handle the listing and showings.

I rent my spare room to a lodger, Kofi, who's been with us 18 months, rent paid monthly on the 1st. My mum is moving in with us so I need the room back. Our agreement says one month's notice; I want to give him more and be kind about it: he's been great to share the house with and I'll gladly be his reference. We're in the UK.

Soy Lucía Ortega y vivo de alquiler en la calle Embajadores 112, 3.º B, en Madrid, desde marzo de 2025, con un propietario particular, don Alfonso. La cláusula 4 del contrato pide 30 días de preaviso por escrito. Me mudo a Valencia por trabajo, quiero dejar el piso el 30 de noviembre y le mandaré también un burofax.
我在杭州有套两居室出租，租客小林住了三年，房租每次都按时交。合同12月31日到期，约定到期前一个月通知。我儿子明年结婚要住这里，不打算续租了。想先微信跟他说，再寄书面通知。我愿意按实际住的天数收租、交房当天退押金，也愿意给他写证明。

I'm Sam Nguyen, renting 3/41 Albert Street, Brunswick, Melbourne, on a periodic agreement that says 28 days' written notice. We want to leave Nov 30. I work night shifts and we have a 3-month-old, so I also want to ask the agent, Priya at Northside Realty, to keep viewings to Tuesdays and Saturdays, 11am to 1pm.
山田健太です。東京のメゾン中野302号室を借りていて、契約書第12条では解約は1ヶ月前までに書面で通知することになっています。転勤で11月30日に退去したいです。管理会社はさくら不動産の佐藤さんで、まずメールで連絡して所定の解約通知書を送ってもらいたいです。

I'm Daniel Ortiz. My lease for 1840 Riverside Dr, Apt 2214 in Austin ends Dec 31, and section 3 says it auto-renews month-to-month at $150 more unless I give written notice at least 60 days before. I submitted the notice-to-vacate form in the resident portal today and also want to email Tasha, the leasing manager at Cedar Point Residential. My forwarding address will be 522 Maple Lane, Round Rock, TX 78664.

I'm Ana Duarte and I run Rise & Crumb Bakery in Unit 7, Harbor Plaza. Section 22 of my 5-year commercial lease says it renews for another 5 years after January 31, 2027 unless I give 90 days' written notice by certified mail. We're moving to a bigger space. The landlord is Harbor Plaza LLC; the property manager is Glen Morris.

My dad, Robert Mackay, died on September 18. He rented 14 Hyndland Road, Flat 1/2 in Glasgow from a private landlord, Mrs Duncan, for 11 years. I'm Fiona, his executor, and want the flat cleared and the keys back by 31 October, but I don't know what notice applies.

I'm a landlord. My tenant Bea texted me on Monday Sept 28 that she's moving out on Oct 17. Our lease, clause 9, requires 30 days' written notice ending on the last day of a month, and rent is due on the 1st. I want to be clear about the dates without being harsh. I'm happy to start viewings now, and if a new tenant moves in earlier she only pays until the day before.

I'm Jenna Park, renting 3318 SE Taylor St, Apt 4 in Portland from Mr Hale on a month-to-month agreement that says 30 days' written notice. He's ignored my requests to fix the heating for six weeks and I've had enough, so I'm leaving on November 30. I'm furious, but I want the notice clean and my deposit back.

I'm Chloe. I'm Jo, a massage therapist. Gwen came in for a monthly back massage for two years, but her last visit was in June, and she hasn't rebooked or answered the one text I sent in August. From Monday 2 November I'm moving to a new studio on Elm Street, with Saturday morning slots for the first time.
我们公司做餐厅排队点餐系统，给一家连锁面馆的运营负责人孙总三家门店免费试用了30天，9月30日试用结束。试用期间每周发的数据报告他一次都没回，最后一周三家店的平均排队时间从18分钟降到了11分钟。正式版每店每月600元，试用账号10月9日关闭。

I'm Hugo and I run a two-person IT security consultancy. On 3 September I sent Ms Farah, practice manager at a 40-person accountancy firm, a £14,000 proposal for a security audit, and she said the partners would decide at their meeting on Thursday 24 September. I've heard nothing since, and I can start the audit the week of Monday 19 October.

I'm a freelance web developer and look after the website for Greenleaf Physio, owned by Dr Anika Shah. The clinic's web address is registered in her own account and expires on Tuesday 20 October; if it lapses, the website and the clinic's email addresses stop working. I emailed her on 21 and 28 September asking her to renew it or give me access, and heard nothing.

I'm Tasha, a real estate agent. Grace and Daniel Okafor viewed five houses with me in August, looking for a 3-bed under $520,000 near Westbrook Elementary, then stopped replying after Sept 12. A 3-bed at 41 Fern Lane, $509,000, two blocks from the school, lists on Monday, the first open house is Saturday, and I can show it to buyers before then.
我做室内软装设计。客户刘女士是好朋友阿梅介绍的，8月底量完房后我给她出了客厅和卧室的软装方案，报价2.6万。9月8日和9月22日我两次在微信上跟进，她都没回。我不想让阿梅夹在中间，想发最后一条就收尾。
我做跨境电商代运营。9月14日给一家家居品牌的市场总监方总发了提案，报价每月1.5万，用的是在线文档，我能看到他和同事这两周打开了十几次，但他一直没回我微信。我很想说一句“看到您团队一直在看”来推一下。

I'm Sven, a freelance app developer building a booking app for Kira's yoga studio on a fixed $12,000 contract, launching Friday 13 November. On Sept 18 she asked for a waitlist feature; on Sept 21 I quoted $1,400 and five extra working days, and she hasn't replied, though she's answered my other questions about the colour scheme. I need her answer by Friday 9 October to fit it in before launch; otherwise I could build it after launch.
Plumber was booked for 8am to fix our leaking water heater. I took the morning off, it's 10 now and nobody showed or called. The company is Apex Plumbing, the scheduler was Tina.
闺蜜最近三次约饭都是当天下午才说来不了，这周六又约了看展。我不想闹僵，但真的有点累了。

I completely forgot a 9am discovery call with a potential client, Amanda, who runs a group of dental clinics and wants her online booking page redone. She just emailed 'Did I have the wrong time?' I'm a freelance web designer.

I'm a private math tutor. A parent, Mrs. Alvarez, cancelled her son Mateo's session 2 hours before the start, second time this month. My policy, which she signed, is 24 hours' notice or the full $60 is charged. She just texted that charging for a cancellation is ridiculous.
朋友介绍的相亲，约了今晚7点在一家叫山海小馆的餐厅见面。现在7点25了，对方还没到，也没发消息。我不想显得很生气，也不想一直干等。
I'm meeting a new client, Victor, at his office at 2pm for a project kickoff. The Jubilee line is suspended and I'll be about 20 minutes late. It's 1:40 now.
Mon amie Claire arrive toujours avec 30 à 40 minutes de retard. On a réservé un resto vendredi 2 octobre à 20h. Je ne veux pas me fâcher, mais je ne veux plus attendre seule devant une carafe d'eau.

In August I told my friend Megan her last-minute cancelling was getting to me, and we agreed to try short weekday coffees. She's cancelled two of those since, the latest an hour before today's. I'm done booking ahead with her, but I don't want to end the friendship.

Sou personal trainer. O Felipe, aluno novo, tinha treino comigo hoje às 7h no Parque da Cidade e não apareceu nem avisou. Esperei até 7h30. Nosso contrato diz que falta sem aviso de 12 horas é cobrada, mas foi a primeira vez.

I was supposed to meet my sister Nadia at Central station on Sunday to help with her two suitcases after her trip. I overslept, she waited 40 minutes and ended up paying €35 for a taxi. I've been avoiding texting her because I feel terrible.

I told my friend Sam that three of our last four plans got cancelled on the day and suggested weekday coffees near her office instead. She replied 'wow, didn't realise you were keeping a tally.' I don't want a fight.
我是奶茶店店长。店员小李这两周9点开店的早班迟到了三次，9月17日、22日和今天，每次20分钟左右，开店时就我一个人手忙脚乱。他平时干活挺好的，想在微信上跟他说一下。

I own a café, Hearth Coffee, and had an interview booked with a barista candidate, Jordan, yesterday at 3pm. He didn't show or message. His CV is strong and we're short-staffed, so I'm open to one more try.

University group project, four of us, presenting on Thursday October 8. Our teammate Ravi missed both rehearsals this week, Monday and yesterday, without a message, and he has the market analysis slides. I want to message him directly, not in the group chat.
我在二手平台上卖一台婴儿车，买家约好今天下午3点来小区门口自提。我抱着孩子等到3点半，人没来，消息也没回。还有别人问过想要。
上周六（9月26日）上午10点约了摄影师阿杰在公园拍全家福，我们记错成周日，没去也没通知，他等了40分钟。合同写爽约不退300元定金。我想道歉并重新约。

I was meant to collect my daughter Isla from her friend Maya's house at 5 yesterday. My meeting ran over, I only texted Maya's mum, Priya, at 5:30 and got there at 5:50, and she had to miss her gym class.

Tengo un restaurante en Sevilla. Una reserva de 10 personas a nombre de Marta Gil para el sábado 26 de septiembre a las 21:00 no vino ni avisó; guardamos la mesa hasta las 21:30 y dijimos que no a otros clientes. Las condiciones que aceptó al reservar dicen que sin cancelar con 24 horas se cobran 15 € por persona a la tarjeta de garantía, y tengo mesa para 10 libre el sábado 10 de octubre a las 21:00.
离婚后儿子豆豆每周六上午10点由他爸爸接走过周末。最近三个周六，他分别是10点40、11点05和10点50才到，事先也没说，豆豆每次都趴在窗口等。我不想吵架，只想以后别这样。

I'm a manager and I completely missed my 2pm 1:1 today with Lin, who reports to me. I got pulled into a budget review and didn't message her, and last week she told me she was bringing her promotion case to this one.
我和同事小赵拼车上班，我开车。这个月我接她已经迟到了三次，9月14日、22日和29日，每次十几分钟，昨天还害她错过了9点的部门例会。我想好好道歉，并从明天起提前15分钟出门，8点05分到她楼下。

My daughter Ella has a 45-minute piano lesson with Mr Hughes every Thursday at 5pm, £30 a lesson. The last three, on 10, 17 and 24 September, started 15 to 20 minutes late but still ended at 5:45. Ella loves him and I don't want to switch teachers; I drop her off again tomorrow.

I volunteer Saturday mornings at a dog rescue, 9am to noon. Last Saturday, Sept 26, I completely forgot my shift, and the coordinator, Bev, had to walk 12 dogs with only one other volunteer. I'll be there this Saturday at 9 as usual and could stay until 2 if that helps.

I'm in Lisbon. Yesterday I had a video call booked with Mei Ling, a partner in Singapore, at 9am my time, 4pm hers. I mixed up the time zones, joined an hour late, and she'd already waited 20 minutes at the end of her day and left. I can do 9am Lisbon time on Tuesday 6 or Thursday 8 October.

My friend Dan and I are seeing Harbour Lights tonight: doors at 7, band on at 8:30. Both tickets are in my app, which lets me transfer one to him. We said we'd meet outside the main entrance at 7:30, it's now 7:50, and he isn't answering.

I open the bike shop at 9 today and my manager, Corinne, is off. I overslept, it's 8:40 and I'll be there at 9:25 at the earliest. The only booking before then is Mr Adeyemi's wheel repair at 9:15, and his number is in the booking app.
上周六约好朋友阿琪早上8点在山脚一起爬山，她睡过头没来，电话也没接，我在山脚等了一个小时。今天她微信道歉，说想请我吃饭赔罪。这是她第一次放我鸽子。

I'm Sophie. My uni friend Hattie RSVP'd yes for herself and her boyfriend Tom to our wedding last Saturday, 26 September, and neither of them came or messaged; we'd paid £85 a head for their meals. She hasn't said anything since, and I'm hurt but also worried something happened.
我妈中风后卧床，身边离不开人，家政公司安排护工张阿姨每天早上8点到家照顾她。今天到9点半人还没来，电话也没人接，我只好请假赶回家。对接的是公司的王经理，我希望明天起能确定有人8点到。

I'm Priya Nair. I had a final-round interview yesterday, Wednesday, at 11am with Helen Ortiz, head of design at Fernway Studio, and I'd written it down for Thursday. I only realised this morning when I saw her email saying 'We missed you today.' I'm free any time on Friday 2 or Monday 5 October.
我每周三晚上组织同事打羽毛球，场地两小时120元，四个人AA每人30。老周9月16日、23日和30日都在群里报了名，到点没来也没说一声，我们三个只能轮着打，场地费也是三个人分的。他人挺好的，我想私聊跟他说：以后报了名、当天下午5点前没说不来的，30块场地费照常AA。

Our regular babysitter, Ella, is 16 and our neighbour's daughter. She was booked for 6:30 last night so my husband Sam and I could go to his work dinner, but she didn't show or reply, and I ended up staying home. This morning she texted 'omg so sorry I totally forgot'; she's been great with the kids for a year, and our next booking is Saturday 10 October at 7pm.

I'm Tom, and I'm meeting my girlfriend Aisha's parents for the first time at Sunday lunch at their house at 1pm. My train is delayed and I'll arrive around 1:40. Aisha is already there, and I have her mum Farida's number; it's 12:45 now.

I run a monthly coding meetup. Darren, a volunteer speaker, was booked to give a 20-minute talk on testing at 7pm last night; he didn't turn up or reply to my two texts, and we filled the slot with lightning talks. I'd still like him to speak, and the next meetup is Thursday 5 November at 7pm.

I organised a beach clean for our neighbourhood WhatsApp group on Saturday 26 September. Fourteen people signed up and five came; I'd borrowed 14 litter pickers from the Shoreline Friends charity, and the five of us filled 11 bags. The next one is Saturday 24 October at 10am, and I want people to take their name off the list if they can't come, without making anyone feel bad.

I'm a junior analyst, and Grace, a director in another team, agreed in August to mentor me with a 30-minute call once a month. Today's call was at 3pm and she didn't join or message; I know she's swamped with the year-end audit. I want to rebook without making her feel bad, and I'm free any lunchtime next week.

I sell handmade leather wallets online. A customer bought one 5 weeks ago (my window is 30 days) and wants a refund because the stitching came loose on one side. $85. I'm happy to refund it in full, restitch it or send a new one, and to cover postage both ways with a prepaid label.

Vendo camisetas estampadas pela minha loja online. O Rafael comprou uma ontem à noite, R$ 89,90 no cartão, e hoje de manhã pediu para cancelar. O pedido ainda não foi enviado, e o estorno no cartão leva até 5 dias úteis.

Customer bought a $240 custom embroidered jacket from my shop, it matches the proof they approved on 12 September exactly, and now says they 'just don't like it' and will dispute the charge if I don't refund. I can offer a 40% refund or change the embroidery colour for free.
我在网上卖表格软件实用课程，199元，规定购买7天内可退。有位学员王女士买了18天，说公司裁员用不上了，想退款，她只看了两节课。我想给她退，但不想变成新规矩。退款1到3个工作日原路到账，退款后课程权限会关闭。

I run weekend pottery workshops, $140 a place. Liam just emailed that he's got COVID and can't make this Saturday's class, and asked for a refund. My policy is no refunds within 7 days, but I can move people to another date free of charge. The 17 October, 7 November and 5 December workshops still have space.

I run a meal-planning app. A customer, Derek, paid $120 for an annual plan in June and now, four months in, wants a full refund because he 'hasn't really used it'. Annual plans are refundable within 14 days only. He's been polite about it. I can switch off his auto-renew and pause his remaining eight months until he's ready.

Je vends du thé en ligne. Une cliente, Mme Roussel, a acheté un coffret à 45 € il y a six semaines (retours sous 14 jours), elle l'a ouvert et n'aime pas le goût. Elle exige un remboursement et menace de laisser un avis une étoile. Je peux lui proposer un avoir de 45 € ou trois échantillons gratuits d'autres mélanges.
我在微信上卖手工茶具。9月18号答应顾客周小姐，给她寄到时摔破的茶壶退168元，结果我忘了操作。她今天发消息问：“说好的退款呢？”我刚把168元退回她的微信零钱，一般几分钟到账，还想送她一张20元无门槛券。

I'm a wedding photographer. Nadia paid a $1,500 non-refundable deposit to hold June 12 next year. She's just emailed that the wedding is off and asked if she can have the deposit back. I turned away two other couples for that date. I can offer to refund $750 this week, or keep the full $1,500 as credit for any shoot in the next two years.
我在网店卖多肉。顾客陈女士买了4盆，一共132元，今天收到说其中一盆38元的桃蛋烂根了，发了照片，要求整单退款。另外三盆她说状态还行。我可以退这盆的38元，1到2天原路到账，或者明天重新挑一盆发快递，烂的那盆不用寄回。

I sell hand-poured candles in my online shop. A customer, Marisol, says her $38 order never arrived and asked for a refund, but tracking shows it delivered to her mailbox on Sept 24. She's polite and this is her third order, so I'm happy to refund it or send a replacement tomorrow morning.

I tutor maths. Jamal's parents, the Haddads, bought a 10-lesson bundle for $500 by card (single lessons are $60) and he's had 4. They're moving abroad next month and asked if they can get money back for the rest. The bundle terms don't mention refunds either way. I also teach online.
我开了家小理发店。顾客李先生昨天剪了个168元的造型，今天发照片说两边剪得太短，要求全额退款。头发已经剪了，我觉得全退不合适，但确实比他说的要短。我可以退一半84元，或者等两周后头发长一点，我亲自给他免费修型。

I sell art prints on my own site. A customer bought a $60 print, said the colours looked duller than on his screen, and I offered a full refund once it's returned or a free reprint on matte paper. He's now sent three messages calling me a scammer and swearing at me.

I sell handmade ceramics online. A woman, Priya, emailed that her aunt bought her a $90 serving bowl as a birthday gift, she already has one just like it, and she wants the money refunded to her own bank account. I can only refund to the card that paid. I can offer her a swap for anything in the shop with a free return label, or a $90 store credit in her name that never expires, and her aunt can ask for the refund from her order email.

I sell retro-style sneakers online, $120 a pair, with 30-day returns if unworn. A customer, Owen, sent a pair back inside the window for a full refund, but they arrived today with scuffed soles and creased toes, clearly worn outside. I'm willing to refund $60 or post them back at my cost.
我开网店卖羊绒大衣。老顾客孙小姐9月20日买了一件，899元，昨天店庆降到759元，她来问能不能退140元差价。店里没有保价的规定，衣服她已经穿过了。

I sell handmade soap and skincare online. A customer, Joanne, bought a $34 lavender face balm by card and says it gave her a red, itchy rash after two uses; she sent a photo and asked for a refund. The full ingredient list is on the jar and the listing.
我开了家烘焙工作室。张女士昨天订了388元的生日蛋糕，另付了30元配送费，约好下午5点送到，结果我们的配送车半路坏了，5点40才送到，孩子的生日会已经先切了备用的小蛋糕。蛋糕后来他们也吃了。张女士今天发微信要求全额退款。我打算退30元配送费和蛋糕钱的一半194元，今天下午原路退回。
京都で小さなゲストハウスをやっています。10月10日（土）から2泊、宿泊代3万6千円で予約している山本さんから、台風の予報が出ていて高齢のお母様を連れて行くのが不安なのでキャンセルしたい、とメールが来ました。規定では10日前からキャンセル料50%ですが、今回は全額返金か、11月以降の日程への無料変更か、どちらかを選んでもらうつもりです。

Ich betreibe ein kleines Yogastudio. Frau Becker schreibt per Mail, dass ihre 10er-Karte für 150 Euro zweimal abgebucht wurde. Im System sehe ich tatsächlich zwei Zahlungen vom 28. September, und eine Rückerstattung auf die Karte dauert bei uns 3 bis 5 Werktage.

I run guided sea kayak tours. We cancelled this Saturday's 9am tour because the forecast is for 30-knot winds, and offered everyone a free move to another date. One customer, Ben, paid $180 for two places and replied that they're only in town this week and would rather have the money back; refunds to card take 3 to 5 working days on our side.

I make small-batch jams and sell wholesale to a few cafés. Hannah at Corner Cup bought 40 jars of plum jam at $6 each in August and wants to send back the 15 unsold ones for a $90 refund. My wholesale terms say no returns on unopened stock, but I'd happily swap them for my new quince jam, which has sold out at two other cafés; my next delivery round is Tuesday 6 October.

I run a small climbing gym. Laura Becker emailed that her husband Tom, who climbed with us most mornings, died on 20 September. He paid $540 for a 12-month membership that started on 1 April, and she asked whether anything can be refunded. Memberships aren't refundable, but I want to refund the six unused months, $270, to the card he paid with, by Monday 5 October. We'll all miss him here.

I run a small online plant shop. A customer, Gemma, commented on our latest Instagram post that she's waited three weeks for a refund on a $45 order and 'nobody answers emails'. I checked: her refund request came in on Sept 9 and got missed, so I've just refunded the $45 to her card, which takes 3 to 5 working days to show, and I've sent her a DM.

I'm a freelance illustrator. Owen at Tidewell Books paid a $1,200 deposit, half of $2,400, for 12 chapter illustrations; I've delivered sketches for the first 4 chapters, 10 hours at my $60 hourly rate. Today he emailed that the book is cancelled and asked for the deposit back; our contract says the deposit covers work done up to cancellation and any unused part is refunded.

I sell digital wedding invitation templates, $18 each. A customer, Abby, downloaded one yesterday and says it won't open in the editing app on her phone; the listing says it needs a desktop editor. Downloads can't be returned, so I don't refund them, but I can make her a fillable PDF version that works on a phone in about ten minutes.
我开了一家小瑜伽工作室，老同学阿敏9月初买了10节私教课，1280元，上了2节。她今天说怀孕了，医生建议先别练高强度，想退款。课包规定不退但可以冻结，我愿意让她选：剩下8节按每节128元退1024元，或者冻结到产后一年内随时用。

I sold my old mirrorless camera with one lens on a local marketplace app for $420 to a buyer, Theo, who collected it in person on Saturday. Today he messaged that the autofocus hunts and won't lock in low light, and asked for his money back. I never noticed because I mostly shot outdoors; I'm willing to take it back if it comes back with the box and lens as it left, and refund him in cash or by bank transfer.

I run a small invoicing app. A customer, Ray, emailed this morning that his annual plan auto-renewed yesterday for $96, he forgot to cancel, and he hasn't logged in since March. Refunds to card take 3 to 5 working days on our side, and his saved invoices stay in his account if he cancels.

I run a small Thai restaurant, Lotus Lane. A customer, Mrs. Patel, emailed that her son gave her a $100 gift card for her birthday, but she's moving to another city on 31 October and asked for the money back. Our gift cards can't be exchanged for cash, but they can be used for takeaway and for our jars of curry paste, and they can be passed on to someone else.
我做定制实木家具。顾客赵先生9月20日定了一张实木餐桌，总价8800元，付了3000元定金。木料已经按他的尺寸开好，花了1800元；这批木料还可以改做一张小一号的餐桌，总价6200元。今天他说新房餐厅比预想的小，想取消订单退定金。

I run Pebblefoot Games, a two-person app studio. A dad, Mr. Okafor, emailed that his 8-year-old son spent $64 on gem packs in our app over the weekend using the saved card, without asking. Our terms say in-app purchases aren't refundable, but for a child buying without permission I'm happy to refund the full $64 as a one-off, which takes 3 to 5 working days, and the app has a parent PIN for purchases under Settings.
我在网店卖手工发簪。住在新加坡的顾客林小姐买了一支128元的珍珠发簪，今天收到后说颜色比图片暗很多，想退款。国际寄回的运费比发簪还贵。我愿意全额退款、不用寄回，退款1到3个工作日原路到账；或者免费给她补寄一支浅色款。

I run a small online IELTS prep course, three months for $450. A student, Mei, finished it, took the exam and got 6.0 overall instead of the 7.0 she was aiming for, with speaking her lowest band at 5.5; she wants a full refund. Our terms say refunds are only within 14 days of starting and there's no score guarantee. I'd like to offer her four free one-to-one speaking sessions before her retake on 14 November.

I run Oakhollow, a two-person furniture workshop. A customer, Diane, received her $1,400 oak sideboard yesterday and found a 4cm scratch on one side panel; she loves it otherwise, wants to keep it, and has asked for 30% back. I can refund $210 today, or send our finisher to repair the scratch at her home next week at no charge.

I'm Tessa, a Year 5 teacher, and I've just joined a running club's WhatsApp group, about 40 people, after coming to their Saturday runs for a month. I'm slow, about 6:40 per km, and training for my first half marathon, Brighton in March. Want to say hi.

I'm Rohan, taking over a client account from my colleague Beth, who left on Friday. I've run paid search for retail brands for four years and I've read all her campaign notes. I play cricket in Leyton on Sundays. Need to introduce myself by email to the client's marketing team.

I'm Kwame, a new PhD student in Professor Lindqvist's lab in Uppsala, just arrived from Accra, where my master's was on soil microbes under drought; here I'll move to root imaging on the confocal. I have to introduce myself at the lab's first group meeting, about 30 seconds, spoken.
我叫刘婧，是医院药剂师。儿子周子航刚转学到三年级二班，我们上个月从成都搬到杭州，他特别爱踢球。我被拉进了家长群，两百多人，想发个自我介绍，不想太长也不想像打广告。

I'm Nadia, starting Monday as engineering manager for a payments team of 7, after five years leading a checkout team at Larkfield. Their last manager left suddenly and one of them applied for my job. I'm resigning from my sales engineer job tomorrow, last day Friday Oct 30, and I look after six accounts. I'm going to a direct competitor and I'd rather not tell my manager Fiona where, at least until I've started. She taught me how to run a demo, and she will definitely ask.

I manage a team of five designers and my last day is Friday Oct 30. HR's exit form asks for honest feedback, and the main reason I'm leaving is that we've been two designers short since March and I've covered the gap with evenings. I want to say it without sounding bitter.

Comparto piso en Madrid con tres amigas desde hace dos años. Me voy a vivir con mi pareja, Dani, y el contrato dice que hay que avisar con un mes, así que quiero irme el 31 de octubre. Mi prima Lucía busca habitación y le encantaría quedarse con la mía.

Two friends, Ana and Priya, and I have run a weekend market stall selling our screen-printed tees for two years, and I do all the printing. I want to stop after the Christmas market on Dec 19 and I'm telling them in our group chat tonight. There's about £1,800 in the shared account, plus stock and the screens we paid for together.
我在李姐家做育儿嫂两年，带她女儿朵朵，朵朵现在4岁。我妈身体不好，我要回老家照顾她，想做到11月15日。李姐一家对我很好，我也很舍不得朵朵，打算今晚她下班后当面说。

I gave two weeks' notice, as my contract requires, and my last day is Friday Oct 16. My manager Ines now wants me to stay until Oct 30 to cover the year-end audit prep, but I start my new job on Monday Oct 19 and can't move it. My colleague Tom is taking over the audit, and I'd be fine doing two short evening calls the week after if he gets stuck.

I'm in the second year of a PhD with Professor Okafor, funded on her research grant. I've accepted an industry data science job starting Monday Jan 11, so I'm leaving the programme. I'll finish my draft of our shared dataset paper by Friday Dec 18 and document the cleaning code for whoever takes it over. I'm telling her in our meeting tomorrow and sending an email afterwards.

I'm quitting my job at a small design agency after 18 months, mainly because the founder, Mark, yells at people in meetings. I've accepted another role, my contract says four weeks' notice so my last day is Friday Oct 30, and I look after three client accounts. I'm telling him on a call tomorrow; he'll ask why and I don't want to get into it.

For two years I've walked my elderly neighbour Mr. Patel's dog, Bruno, every weekday lunchtime, just as a favour. I start an office job on Monday 2 November, so my last walk will be Friday 30 October. Aisha, the 15-year-old next door, has said she'd happily take it on for pocket money, and I'm telling Mr. Patel in person tomorrow.

I'm Pat. I've rented a chair at Maureen's salon for 26 years, ever since she gave me my first chair when I'd just qualified, and I'm retiring; my last day will be Saturday 19 December. About 40 regulars book with me, and my colleague Tasha has said she'd love to take on any who want her. I'm telling Maureen tomorrow before I tell any clients.

I'm Ellie. My manager, Jo, is also one of my closest friends from university, and she hired me two years ago. I've accepted a job at another firm; my contract says four weeks' notice, so my last day would be Friday 30 October. I own the client onboarding process and I'm telling her over coffee tomorrow without wanting it to wreck the friendship.
我在一家广告公司做了四年客户经理，8月底因为焦虑和失眠请了一个月病假，现在快到期了，我决定不回去了。合同写离职要提前30天书面通知；主管刘姐对我很好，去年手把手带我拿下了第一个年度大客户。我手上的三个客户已经由同事小吴临时接手，今天下午我先给刘姐打电话，再发书面通知，不想细说病情。
我和大学同学阿凯合开了一家宠物美容店，三年了，各占50%。我要回老家照顾爸妈，想年底退出，12月31日是最后一天；合伙协议里的退出条款约定由会计按账面评估股份，再由留下的一方回购。店里的进货和供应商一直是我在管，今晚当面跟他说了，想再发一条书面消息确认。

I'm Ravi, and for five years I've co-maintained an open-source date-parsing library with Jun. I'm burned out and want my evenings back, so I'm stepping down as a maintainer on 31 October; I told Jun on a call yesterday and he'll keep leading it. Before then I'll review the 12 open PRs tagged for the v3.2 release and hand my admin rights to Jun. I want to post it in the project's GitHub Discussions.

I've mentored Jayden, 15, through a youth mentoring programme for 18 months; we meet every other Saturday, he wants to study engineering, and I've really loved it. I'm moving to Glasgow for work in December, so our last session will be Saturday 28 November, and the coordinator, Sarah, will match him with a new mentor. I'm telling him in person at our session this Saturday.
我叫周宁，在一家检测公司做了三年工程师。去年部门经理赵总推荐我参加资格证培训，公司出了3万元，培训协议约定服务期两年，提前离职按未满月数比例返还，我还差8个月，算下来是1万元。我已经接了新offer，合同要求提前30天书面通知，今天上午当面跟赵总说了，最后工作日定在11月2日（周一），手上两个在测项目交给同事小孙，想发正式邮件。

Canto há oito anos no coro da paróquia, com ensaios às quintas, e foi o maestro, o Sr. Joaquim, que me ensinou a ler partituras. Deixei de frequentar a igreja e quero sair sem entrar em conversas sobre fé. Quero que a missa de Todos os Santos, domingo 1 de novembro, seja a última, e a Rita disse que pode ficar com a pasta das partituras de contralto; vou falar com ele depois do ensaio desta quinta.
我叫苏晴，在出版社做了六年编辑，下周五10月9日是最后一天，之后去读全日制研究生。部门今晚给我办欢送饭，主编陈老师让我说几句。六年前我连校样都不会看，是陈老师一页一页带我改出来的；手上的三本书已经交接给小林了。

I'm Jess, one of five bridesmaids for my friend Laura's wedding on 12 June 2027. I lost my job in August and can't afford the £600 for the dress, the hen weekend and travel. I want to step down as a bridesmaid but still come as a guest, and I'll still make the table plan I offered to do; I'm telling her on a call tonight.

I'm Hannah, a UX researcher, and I've resigned; my contract says one month's notice, so my last day is Friday 6 November. My manager Leo is on parental leave until January, so I told Sunita, his manager, who is covering, on a call this morning, and she's running the handover. Leo backed my diary study project last year, and I want to send him a short personal note so he doesn't hear it from someone else, without making him feel he has to do anything.
我叫阿琴，一年半来每个工作日早上开车顺路捎同事小刘和老马上班，他们每月各给我200元油费，10月的月初已经给了。我11月搬到城东，以后不顺路了，10月30日（周五）是最后一次。小区门口早上7点20分有一趟班车直达公司附近，想在我们三个人的微信小群里说一声。

Ich bin Miriam und seit fünf Jahren Key-Account-Managerin bei einem Softwarehaus. Heute habe ich gekündigt, weil ich zu einem Wettbewerber wechsle, und mein Chef hat mich sofort bis zum Ende der Kündigungsfrist freigestellt; Laptop und Zugänge musste ich gleich abgeben, verabschieden konnte ich mich nicht. Meine Übergabenotizen zu meinen Kunden liegen schon im Teamordner, und ich möchte meiner Kollegin Sandra, mit der ich drei Jahre eng zusammengearbeitet habe, privat per WhatsApp ein paar Zeilen schicken.

Soy Lucía y coordino el equipo de soporte, seis personas, desde hace dos años. Echo de menos el trabajo técnico, así que le pedí a mi directora, Elena, volver a un puesto técnico y ya está aprobado: el cambio es efectivo el 1 de diciembre, Andrés asumirá la coordinación y le pasaré las reuniones individuales y la planificación de turnos. Me quedo en el equipo y quiero anunciarlo por correo; con ellos aprendí muchísimo, sobre todo en la migración del sistema de tickets en primavera.
My brother and sister aren't speaking because of a fight over who hosts Christmas with our dad. Both keep calling me to vent. I want to help without being in the middle. My sister just called again.
My friend Leah is mad at me because I won't take her side against Chloe after their falling out over the bridesmaid thing. She says I'm being fake.
Team lead here. Two of my engineers, Omar and Beth, have been sniping at each other in code reviews. I've spoken to each privately; now I'm hosting a joint meeting tomorrow. How do I open it?
我跟阿杰、小雨三个人合租。他们俩因为打扫轮值和水电费闹翻了，一周没说话，两个人都跑来跟我吐槽。刚才小雨让我帮她跟阿杰说一声，下个月网费她不跟他平摊了。

My mom and my aunt haven't spoken since Grandma's funeral in June, over who gets her house. I offered to host a call between them and my aunt texted: 'Never. And if you keep pushing this I'll stop talking to you too.'

I chair our community garden committee. I got two members, Frank and Delia, together to sort out their fight over the shared tool shed, and 10 minutes in they're talking over each other and Frank just said 'this is pointless'. I need to stop it.

I manage a small sales team. Priya and Luke have been fighting over who owns the Harmon Foods account since the territory change. In our joint meeting today we agreed Priya owns it from Oct 1, Luke hands over his notes and contacts by Oct 2 and joins the next two calls, and disputes come to me instead of the team chat. I want it in writing to both.
我不是领导，只是组里的普通同事。小王和小李为了一个项目排期闹得很僵，两个人都私下跟我抱怨对方。今天小王又来找我，说：“你评评理，是不是他太过分了？”
大学四个室友的群里，阿敏和小月因为国庆去厦门的AA账吵起来了，越说越难听，其他人都不敢出声。钱是我统一垫付的，民宿和包车的单据都在我这儿。我想在群里说点什么。

My two closest friends, Jess and Mia, haven't spoken since a fight over a flat they were meant to share. My 30th is Saturday Oct 17 at my place and I want both there. I'd like to tell each of them before they see the other on the invite.

Nina and Jordan from my climbing group split up last month. Nina told me Jordan has turned up outside her flat three nights running and texted her that she'll 'regret this'. Jordan has now asked me to get the two of them together to 'talk it out', and I want to message Nina.

I'm a shift supervisor at a restaurant. A server, Jade, told me a line cook, Ryan, keeps commenting on her body and has brushed against her twice. She asked me to 'just sit you both down and sort it out' because she doesn't want it to be a big deal.
我妈从老家过来帮我们带刚满半岁的孩子，跟我老婆因为孩子穿多少、什么时候加辅食天天闹别扭，两个人都私下跟我抱怨对方。刚才我妈又拉着我说：“你得管管你媳妇，她根本不听我的。”

Three weeks ago I sat down with my neighbours Hal and Rosa, who'd been fighting for months over our shared driveway, and they agreed a parking schedule. It seems to be holding. I want to check in once with each of them without stirring it all up again.

At dinner on Saturday my best friend Sophie joked that my husband Tom 'finally found a job that sticks', and he's been fuming since. Sophie just texted asking if Tom is mad at her and whether I can smooth it over for her.
我和未婚夫阿哲下个月结婚。我爸妈离婚十年了，关系很僵，为了主桌怎么坐、我爸要不要带现在的妻子来，两个人都分别打电话给我，让我去跟对方说。刚才我妈又让我告诉我爸：“他要带那个人来，我就不去了。”

I'm one of three co-founders of a 9-person startup. Ana (CTO) and Ben (CEO) have been clashing for two weeks over whether to launch in November or January. Ben just DMed me: 'You were in Monday's meeting, just tell Ana she agreed to November.'
我是二年级班主任。课间乐乐和浩浩推搡，乐乐摔倒磕破了膝盖，校医已经处理过。晚上两家家长在班级群里吵起来，互相指责，乐乐妈妈和浩浩爸爸又分别私信我，让我主持公道。

I moderate a 2,000-member Discord server for a board game. Two long-time members, Kai and Rowan, have been sniping at each other in #general for a week over a tournament ruling. Kai just DMed me asking me to ban Rowan and 'back him up in public'.

My best friends Carol and Bea fell out over what Bea's hen do was going to cost. Last week Bea vented to me, including that she thinks Carol is 'tight with money'. Now Carol has messaged me: 'Be honest, what has Bea been saying about me?'

I own a small bakery with four staff. After weeks of friction over who cleans the ovens at close, my head baker Rita texted me tonight: 'Either Kev goes or I do.' Kev is our newest baker. I don't want to lose either of them.
我老伴上周中风住院了。女儿这周请了三天假在医院陪护，儿子说工作忙只来过一次，两个人为了陪护怎么排、护工钱怎么分吵翻了，都跑来跟我说对方的不是。刚才女儿打电话，让我去跟她哥说“别总拿工作忙当借口”。

My mum, Rosa, speaks only Spanish and my husband, Mark, speaks only English, so I translate whenever they talk. They've been clashing over whether our son's christening is at Mum's church in Seville or here in Leeds, and Mark just texted me: 'Tell your mum she's being controlling.' We're all on a video call with her on Sunday anyway.

My two teenagers, Maya (16) and Leo (14), have been fighting for weeks over the family laptop, which they both need for homework; last night it ended in shouting and a slammed door. Each has come to me separately saying the other hogs it. I want to talk to Maya first, then get the three of us to sit down on Sunday afternoon and agree a schedule.
我是做代账的会计，给一家咖啡馆记账三年。咖啡馆是阿峰和小芸合伙开的，有合伙协议，但利润分配写得很笼统，最近两人为今年的利润怎么分吵翻了，都单独打电话给我。刚才阿峰让我去跟小芸说按他的方案分才合理，还问小芸私下跟我说了什么。

I rent out a four-bedroom house by the room. One tenant, Priya, emailed that her housemate Sam games with his headset mic on until about 2am most nights, she hears him through the wall, and she asked me to 'have a word'. Every tenancy agreement includes a house rule of quiet hours from 11pm to 7am.

Meine Freunde Jonas und Lukas reden seit zwei Wochen nicht mehr miteinander, seit Jonas beim Junggesellenabschied einen blöden Witz über Lukas' Freundin gemacht hat. Jetzt schreibt Jonas mir: „Kannst du Lukas sagen, dass es mir leid tut?“ Ich mag beide und will nicht der Bote sein.
我孙子小宇读大三，想休学一年去打电竞，他爸（我儿子建军）坚决不同意，父子俩吵得一周没说话，都跑来跟我诉苦。刚才小宇打电话让我去劝劝他爸，说“爸只听你的”。这周日10月4日中午他们俩本来就要来我这儿吃饭。

Two friends from my running club, Dan and Ella, fell out after Dan pulled out of their relay team two days before the race. When Dan vented to me last week I said Ella was overreacting; he repeated it to her, and she's just messaged me: 'So you think I'm overreacting?' I want to own that and get back to being neutral.
我爸妈都六十多了，为了要不要卖掉老家的房子、搬到杭州离我近点，吵了一个月：我爸想搬，我妈舍不得老邻居。两人轮流给我打电话，刚才我爸说：“你劝劝你妈，她最听你的。”10月3日我回家过节。

I'm a project coordinator. My manager, Karen, and our senior designer, Tomas, have been clashing for weeks over deadlines on the Bramble app project. In our 1:1 today Karen asked me to 'keep an eye on Tomas and quietly tell you when he's slipping'. I already send a weekly status update on Fridays to the whole project team.

I'm hosting a coffee for my cousins Hannah and Grace, who fell out over visiting our grandma at her care home, and we agreed to talk only about a visiting rota; someone needs to go this Sunday. Twenty minutes in, Hannah has started bringing up Grace missing her wedding three years ago, and Grace is getting up to leave.

My friends Marta and Jo haven't spoken in two months since a fight about Jo's wedding guest list. This week each of them separately told me they miss the other but won't make the first move. Now Jo has texted me: 'Has Marta said anything about me?'

I'm in a four-person group for our marketing module, and the presentation is next Thursday. Two of the group, Kofi and Hannah, have been arguing in the group chat for days about Kofi missing two meetings and Hannah rewriting his slides without asking. Hannah has just messaged me privately asking me to back her up when she emails our tutor, Dr Reyes, to say Kofi isn't pulling his weight; I'm free for a call tomorrow evening.

I introduced my friend Zoe, a photographer, to my old colleague Martin, and he hired her to shoot the new menu for his café for £600. Zoe says she delivered the photos two weeks ago and hasn't been paid; Martin says half the shots weren't usable and he'll pay £300. Martin has just messaged me: 'You recommended her, so can you sort this out?'
我开了家小面馆，厨师阿强是我表弟，服务员小芳在店里干了两年。两个人为出餐慢、催单的事吵了好几次，昨晚当着客人的面吵起来了。阿强私下跟我说：“咱们是亲戚，你得向着我。”我想周一店休那天下午三个人坐下来，把出餐和催单的规矩定下来。

I'm Daniel Carter and my son Eli (8C) got a zero on his science project for being 'late', but Google Classroom shows he submitted it at 7:40pm on Sunday 20 September, before the Monday deadline; I have a screenshot. Teacher is Mr Barnes.
