I'm Grace Kim. I emailed my son Noah's 4th-grade teacher, Ms Rivera, on Sept 14 and Sept 21 about a kid shoving him in the bus line since early September, twice leaving a bruise on his arm. No reply either time, and it's still happening. I want to ask the assistant principal, Mr Grant, to meet this week.

I'm the dad of Nora (Grade 5, Ms. Kowalski's class), who was just diagnosed with ADHD. She says she can't focus in her seat by the window and keeps getting in trouble for unfinished work. At home we've started breaking homework into 15-minute blocks with short breaks, which helps. I'm free after 3:30 any day. I'd like to talk to the teacher before the November conferences.

I'm Emi Tanaka. My son Kai (10B) got a Saturday detention for 'defiance' after refusing to take his hoodie off in class on Monday. He has an eczema flare on his arms and was embarrassed. Head of year is Mr Okafor; detention is this Saturday, Oct 3. His GP can write a note, and I'm free any afternoon this week.

I emailed my daughter Mia's Grade 7 teacher, Mr. Hale, that she's spending 3 hours a night on homework. He replied the assignments are designed for 45 minutes and maybe she's distracted at home. I don't want a fight.
我是王乐乐的妈妈，儿子乐乐在四年级三班，10月15号、16号（周四周五）要回老家参加外婆八十大寿，得请两天假。班主任是李老师。想提前说一声，也问问落下的功课怎么补。

I'm Tom Reid (tom.reid@example.com). My ex and I separated over the summer and our son Sam (Year 3, Mr Doyle's class) now lives with me Monday to Wednesday; he seems to be coping well, and we keep homework and bedtimes the same in both homes. All the school emails and reading-record notes go only to his mum. I want to be copied in, and give the teacher a heads-up.

I'm Laura Kemp, free after 3:30 most days. My son Owen's teacher, Ms. Delgado (Grade 2), called and then emailed me yesterday: Owen pushed a classmate off the slide at recess and the boy scraped his knee. Owen says the other kid pushed him first, but agrees pushing is wrong and has written the boy a sorry note. I want to reply to her email without sounding defensive.

I'm Ava's mum and free any day after 4pm. My daughter Ava (Year 9, 9R) was moved from top set maths to set 2 this week. She's upset, mostly because nobody told her why. Her maths teacher is Mr Singh. I want to ask about it without sounding like I'm demanding she be moved back.

I'm Rachel Grant (07700 900 461). My daughter Maya Grant (Year 9), very distressed, showed me a class group chat where two classmates shared an edited photo of her with nasty captions. It started Sunday night and has been screenshotted into other chats. We've saved copies I can send today, reported the posts to the app, and she's left the chat for now. The school's safeguarding lead is Mrs Ellis.

I'm Ben Price, free after 4pm. My son Jonah (5C, Ms Carter's class) keeps saying he finishes his maths work early and then gets bored, and he's been told off twice this month for chatting. He loves the puzzle maths we do at weekends. I don't want to come across as the pushy 'my kid is gifted' parent.
我是陈浩的妈妈，儿子刚上一年级（2）班，对花生严重过敏，医生说一点点也可能引起严重反应，开了肾上腺素笔，放在他书包侧袋里，家里有医院证明和用法说明。班主任是周老师，听说下周学校组织秋游还会发零食，我可以单独给他备零食，也想当面教老师怎么用笔。
我是林朵朵的妈妈，女儿在五年级（3）班，学校下个月去杭州研学三天，费用1680元，这周五前要交。我最近失业了，一下子拿不出来，但不想让孩子知道，也不想在家长群里问。班主任是吴老师。

Je suis Claire Moreau, disponible tous les jours après 16 h 30. Ma fille Inès (CM1) m'a raconté que sa maîtresse, Mme Lefèvre, a dit devant toute la classe que son exposé était « nul ». Depuis, Inès ne veut plus aller à l'école le matin. Je veux en parler sans attaquer l'enseignante.

I'm Juliana Souza. We moved from Brazil to Leeds in September. Our son Davi (Year 6, Miss Hart's class) speaks only a little English and says he eats lunch alone most days. He loves football and drawing, and we read an English picture book with him every night.

I'm Samira Rahman. My son Yusuf (7L, form tutor Ms Lawson) will fast for Ramadan for the first time this coming February. He's proud and a bit nervous about it. He has PE on Tuesdays and Thursdays, and we're doing a few practice fasts at weekends so he knows how he feels. I want to ask early how the school handles it.

I'm Ben's mum. My dad died on Sunday, and I'm free to talk any day after school. My son Ben (Year 4, Mrs Patel's class) was really close to his grandad, who picked him up from school every Wednesday. The funeral is Thursday 8 October and Ben will be off that day. He's been quiet and teary at home, and we've been talking about Grandad at bedtime.
我是刘小雨的妈妈，女儿读三年级二班，上周五查出近视，大约200度，眼镜配了但要两周左右才能拿到。她说坐在第六排看不清黑板，这几天抄题老抄错。在家我们已经把她用平板的时间减到每天半小时。班主任是王老师。
我是周子墨的爸爸，儿子在一年级（4）班，班主任是赵老师。学校公众号上周发运动会推文，用了子墨一张正脸特写。我们家一直不在公开网络上发孩子正脸照片，班级群里发没关系，想请老师以后对外发布时帮忙避开他的正脸。

I'm Priya's mum, free after 4pm. My daughter Priya (Year 11) got a note from her English teacher, Ms Grant, saying her Macbeth essay 'appears AI-generated' and will get a zero unless she rewrites it. Priya wrote it herself over three evenings in Google Docs, and the version history shows every draft. I want to ask for a chance to show that without accusing the teacher.

我是老陈，在小区开了8年洗衣店，出于个人原因决定11月30日关店。不少老顾客会员卡里还有余额，12月15日前都可以全额退；附近靠谱的干洗店我也问好了。要在会员群里通知大家。

I'm Maya, a freelance video editor. I've done monthly work for a marketing agency, Northlight, at $450 a day for two years, and this is my first increase with them: from January 1 I'm moving to $520. My contact is Aaron, and the winter campaign I quoted at $450 runs through December.

I'm Marco and I run Green Crate, a small veg box delivery with about 180 weekly subscribers at $32, delivered Tuesdays from the same partner farms. From Monday Nov 2 it goes to $35 because those farms raised their prices; members of over two years, like Ruth, stay at $32 until the end of February.

I'm Leila from Loose Ends Hair; there are three of us. From Monday Nov 2 we'll be closed on Mondays, so we each get a proper weekend, and open until 8pm on Thursdays instead of 6. Prices and online booking stay the same. Emailing our client list, e.g. Grace; a few regulars always book Mondays.

I'm Maya and I make soap. We're discontinuing our best-selling Lavender Oat bar on Monday Nov 30 because the small mill that supplied our oats closed and I can't match the quality. We've made a final batch of 600 bars, which keep a year. Emailing our list of regulars, e.g. Sam.

I'm Rosa from Crumb & Co., a small bakery supplying croissants to 14 local cafés at $1.60 each. From Nov 2 the price goes to $1.85 because butter has gone up about 40% this year, and I won't switch to a cheaper one. Delivery times, minimum order and recipe stay the same. Emailing the café owners, like Tom; most order daily and set their own menu prices.
我是小满曲奇的阿琳，在网上卖手工曲奇礼盒，一盒12块卖88元。黄油和包装都涨了，11月1日起改成一盒10块，价格不变，配方、黄油和每块大小都不变，10月31日前下的单按12块发。想在客户群里直接说清楚，不想被人说偷偷减量。

I'm Priya, volunteer treasurer of our amateur football club, about 60 adult members. Subs go from £120 to £150 for the season starting 1 January, because the council raised pitch hire by about a third; pitches, Tuesday training and kit stay the same. Members can pay in three £50 instalments, or message me privately if it's a real problem. Posting in the members' WhatsApp group.
小麦堂というパン屋をやっている田中です。これまで近所への配達は無料でしたが、11月1日から3,000円未満の注文は配達料300円をいただきます。ガソリン代と配達スタッフの人件費が上がったためです。パンの値段と配達エリアは変わらず、店頭受け取りは無料です。LINEでお客さんに知らせたいです。
我是星星托管的周老师，托管班在明德小学对面，有32个孩子，两位老师。房东收回房子，11月2日起搬到步行十分钟的阳光花园小区会所二楼，我们去校门口接孩子；收费、作息、晚饭不变。不方便的11月15日前说，剩余费用按天退；10月31日上午10点新场地开放参观。要在家长群里发通知。

I'm Mei from Leaf & Kettle, a small online tea shop. Yesterday I emailed our 900 customers that 100g tins go from $14 to $18 on Nov 1 because of higher shipping costs from our growers, with the old price holding until Oct 31. The $18 was a typo for $16, and a few people, like Sam, have replied upset.
我是小林，开家庭宠物寄养，平时每晚80元。明年春节期间（2月1日到2月20日）阿姨上班要付三倍工资，所以这段时间改成每晚120元，节后恢复80元，照顾方式不变。10月31日前已经预订春节的老客户还按80元算。要在客户群里通知。

I'm Anna and I run a small neighbourhood bakery with about 60 weekly bread subscribers, like Tom, who pay week by week. We're closing for a kitchen renovation from Monday Oct 19 and reopening Monday Nov 9; subscriptions pause and nobody is charged for those weeks. Same bakers and recipes when we reopen.

I'm Jonas, the solo developer of Pantry Pal, a meal-planning app with about 3,000 free users, like Maya. From Monday Nov 2 the free plan ends and the app costs $3 a month, because my server costs have tripled this year. The app itself isn't changing and there are still no ads; anyone can export their recipes any time, subscribed or not; and current free users get their first three months at $1.50.
我教少儿英语，已经在家长群里通知：11月1日起课时费从每节150元涨到170元，10月31日前买的课时包按原价上完。家长王姐私信我：“我们家老带新介绍了三个孩子，给我还按150吧，别告诉别人。”

I'm Jen and I run a small farm shop on the edge of our village. Our cash box has been stolen twice since August, so from Monday Nov 2 we're going card only; prices aren't changing. Lots of our regulars are older and prefer cash, so anyone without a card can pay by bank transfer or have a monthly tab with me. Posting in the village Facebook group and on the shop door.
我叫周敏，开了一家小保洁公司叫洁雅保洁，给一家设计公司的写字楼做日常保洁，月费6000元，一直是固定的两位阿姨上门。合同第6条写了调价要提前60天书面通知。今年保洁员工资涨了，打算12月1日起涨到6500元，对接人是行政主管孙经理，我的电话是13800000007。

Soy Lucía y tengo una academia de baile en Valencia, Academia Compás, con unas 90 familias que pagan 45 € al mes por recibo bancario. A partir del 1 de enero quiero cobrar cada trimestre, 135 €, que es el mismo precio, porque el banco nos cobra una comisión por cada recibo. Quien prefiera seguir pagando cada mes puede hacerlo sin coste extra si me lo dice antes del 15 de diciembre. Lo voy a mandar al grupo de WhatsApp de familias.
我叫老周，在小区里开了个快递代收点，现在包裹放多久都免费，架子快放不下了。打算从11月1日起，包裹到站超过3天没取的，每件每天收1元，最多收5元。到站当天照常发取件短信；出差或不方便取的，提前在群里或私信说一声，可以免费多放几天。要在业主群里通知。

I'm Ellie and I own a small climbing gym. About 70 founding members have paid $45 a month since we opened in 2021, while everyone else pays $65. Because rent and insurance have gone up, from Monday 4 January 2027 their rate goes to $55, still $10 under standard, and anyone can freeze their membership for free by replying. I'm emailing them.

Sou a Renata, faço marmitas congeladas sozinha em Campinas, a Cozinha da Rê. A partir de segunda, 9 de novembro, vou parar de entregar em Sousas e Joaquim Egídio, porque fica a 25 km e cada entrega leva mais de uma hora; uns 15 clientes de lá pedem toda semana. Cardápio e preços não mudam. Eles podem retirar no Cambuí às quintas, das 17h às 20h, ou fazer pedidos de 10 marmitas ou mais, que eu entrego lá uma vez por mês.
我是阿梅，在大学城开了6年“阿梅面馆”。我想退休回老家，12月1日起把店交给跟了我4年的厨师小郑经营，店名、配方和价格都不变；储值卡余额小郑全部认，不想继续用的，11月30日前找我可以全额退。要在顾客微信群里通知。

I'm Omar and I run Fennel Box, a weekly meal-kit delivery. The box went from $60 to $66 on 1 September, announced by email on 1 August, but a customer, Clare, says the email went to her spam and the new charge surprised her. I've decided to refund her the $6 difference on September's four boxes, $24, and her next box, on Monday 5 October, will be $66 unless she pauses.

I'm Gloria and I clean houses on my own. Mr Patel, 82, has had me every Tuesday for six years and doesn't use email or texts, so I'll tell him by phone. From Tuesday 5 January my rate goes from $30 to $34 an hour because gas and supplies cost more; same day, same jobs, and if that's too much I could come every other week instead.
我是“麦田小坊”的店主小冉，做手工面包，一直在自己的无坚果厨房生产，详情页写着“无坚果车间”。原来的厨房租约到期，11月2日起要搬到和别的甜点店共用的中央厨房，那里也处理坚果，以后不能保证不含坚果痕迹，配方和价格都不变。不少客人是因为孩子坚果过敏才在我们家买；已经付款、11月2日起发货的预订都可以全额退。要在客户群里通知。

I'm Kofi and I run Sharp Corner, a two-chair barbershop. From Monday 2 November we're going appointments only, no walk-ins, because Saturday queues hit two hours and people kept leaving. Prices stay at $28; people can book on our site or by calling 555-0147, and we keep the 9am slot open every morning for same-day cuts booked by phone. It's going on Instagram and a sign in the window.
我是“晨光酸奶”的小周，手工酸奶一直用青禾牧场的有机奶，详情页写着“有机”。牧场停了有机奶线，11月1日起改用同一家牧场的普通鲜奶，不再是有机的，价格从每杯15元降到13元，配方和做法不变，详情页的“有机”字样同一天删掉。已经买了10次卡的老客户，剩余次数每次退2元差价，11月底前微信转回。要在客户群里通知。

I'm Hannah Moss, a counsellor in private practice. From Monday 4 January 2027 my session fee goes from $110 to $125, my first increase in four years, because rent and professional insurance went up; sessions themselves stay the same. I keep four reduced-fee places at $80 that existing clients can ask about in confidence, and anyone who decides to stop or move will get my help finding another counsellor. I'm emailing each current client, starting with Jordan.

I'm Gemma and I run Tidy Paws, a mobile dog grooming business with about 120 regular clients, like Rob, who pay by bank transfer after each groom. From Monday 2 November I'm moving the business account, so the bank details for payments will change; prices and grooms stay the same. The new details will only ever be on the printed invoice I hand over in person, I'll never send new bank details by email or text, and I want clients to call me on 555-0163 before paying anywhere new.

I'm Ravi and I run Tallyhook, a one-person invoicing app with about 1,200 customers on the $8 Basic plan, like Nadia. From Tuesday 1 December, recurring invoices move from Basic to the $14 Pro plan, because the automatic reminder emails behind them now cost more than Basic brings in for the customers who use them most. Everything else in Basic stays the same at $8, anyone already using recurring invoices on Basic keeps them until 1 June 2027, and people can switch plans or cancel any time from their account page.

Ich bin Katrin und habe die Fahrradwerkstatt Speiche in Freiburg. Ab Montag, 2. November, kostet ein Kostenvoranschlag 15 Euro, weil jede Prüfung etwa eine halbe Stunde Arbeit ist, die bisher unbezahlt blieb; wer die Reparatur dann bei uns machen lässt, bekommt die 15 Euro voll angerechnet. Die Reparaturpreise bleiben gleich, und ich schreibe es in den Newsletter und hänge es in der Werkstatt aus.

We run a small online candle shop. A label mix-up meant about 180 Fig & Cedar candles went out labelled Lavender between Sept 14 and 22. People are posting about it on Instagram. Labels are now checked against the batch sheet before every run. I'm the founder, Priya.
我们是一家火锅店。9月20日起为了控制成本换了新的底料供应商，也没提前告诉大家，很多老顾客在会员群和小红书上说味道变了。我们决定10月1日起换回原来的底料，9月20日到30日来吃过的会员下次到店送一份锅底，以后换主要原料前先请会员试吃。我是店长陈磊，想在会员群和小红书发一条说明。

We posted an apology after our meal-kit deliveries were two days late last week. The top comment says 'Words are cheap. Third time this year.' It's actually the second time. Everyone affected got a free box credited, and we've added a second courier for Thursday deliveries. I'm the founder.

I own a small yoga studio. This morning I sent our class schedule email from my personal email instead of our mailing tool and put all 212 members in the To line instead of BCC, so everyone's email addresses are visible. No other data. From now on every studio email goes through the mailing tool, which hides addresses. I want to email everyone.

Wir betreiben eine Kletterhalle in Leipzig. Am Samstag mussten wir wegen eines Wasserschadens schließen, haben das aber erst um 9 Uhr auf Instagram gepostet. Rund 60 Leute standen vor der Tür. Künftig melden wir Schließungen auch per E-Mail, SMS und auf der Startseite. Ich bin der Inhaber, Jonas.

Our bakery's Instagram posted a joke yesterday calling gluten-free customers 'crazy'. A coeliac customer called it out and it's been shared about 300 times. I'm the owner, Dana, and I wrote the post. It's deleted, and from today a second person on the team checks every post.
我们是一家线上咖啡豆小店。9月26日到28日发出的一批耶加雪菲（批次0926）烘焙过度，有明显焦苦味，一共92单，已经有客人在小红书上说了。我是店主林悦，想发一条给这批客人的消息，同时挂在店铺首页。以后每一锅出炉都会先杯测再装袋。

I run Ledgerly, a small invoicing app for about 4,000 freelancers. Yesterday, Monday, from 10am to 2:30pm nobody could send invoices because a database update failed, and about 900 invoices went out hours late. Delayed invoices kept their original date, and we now test every update on a copy of live data and roll back automatically after 10 minutes of errors. I'm the founder and want to post on LinkedIn and X.

We run Ridgeback Outdoor, a small online gear shop. From Sunday evening to Monday afternoon our site showed the Trailbase 3-person tent at $39 instead of $390, a typo in a bulk price update. 62 orders came in and we're honouring them, but people who saw the price jump mid-checkout are annoyed on Facebook. From now on a second person checks every bulk price change. I'm the owner, Sam.

We're a two-person studio making a card game, Tidepool. Our launch page and the printed boxes credit the reef card art to the wrong illustrator, and the real artist, Mara Lind, pointed it out publicly yesterday. The page is fixed, every copy will ship with a card crediting her, and credits are now checked against artist contracts before anything is published. I'm co-founder Leah and want to post an update to our 1,400 backers.

We run Marlow Books. At our author event on Saturday the step-free side door was locked and nobody was on it, so a wheelchair user, Dee, waited 25 minutes outside and missed the reading. She posted about it on Instagram and tagged us. I've DMed her offering a ticket refund and a signed copy of the book, and from this week the side door is unlocked and staffed from 30 minutes before every event. I'm the owner, Sophie.
我们是一家连锁瑜伽馆，会员都在小程序上续费。9月28日续费系统出错，大约310位月卡会员被重复扣了一次月费，每人299元。已经有会员在群里和小红书上问了。从今天起每次扣款前系统都会先核对重复订单。我是创始人周蔓，想发一条公告。

We run Butter & Rye, a bakery. Our 'nut-free' oat cookies sold on Saturday and Sunday (Sept 26 and 27) were baked on trays also used for almond biscotti, so they may contain traces of almond. About 70 were sold and nobody has reported a reaction yet. We've pulled the batch, nut-free bakes now have their own trays and go in the oven first, and anyone who bought them gets a full refund. I'm the owner, Grace (0117 496 0215), and want to post on Instagram, our website and a sign in the shop.

Two weeks ago our dog daycare's only van broke down and about 40 dogs got home up to three hours late. My apology post promised an update by Thursday 1 October on what we'd change. We now have a second van on standby and owners get a text if a drop-off runs over 20 minutes late. Everyone affected was refunded for that day. I'm the owner, Jade.
我们是一家奶茶店，发朋友圈和小红书说9月29日全天第二杯半价，结果下午2点原料就用完了，很多人白跑一趟，评论里有人说我们骗流量。以后做活动会写清限量多少杯，卖完马上在门口和线上通知。我是店主阿杰。

We run Smoke & Salt, a barbecue food truck. At the Riverside Park festival on Saturday 26 September our card payments failed from 1pm to 4pm because of an outage at our payment provider, and with no sign up, people queued up to 30 minutes before learning we were cash only. We now carry a backup card reader on a different network and put a cash-only sign up the moment payments fail, and anyone who queued gets a free plate at the Harbour Market on Saturday 10 October. I'm the owner, Marcus, and questions can go to marcus@example.com.

We run a weekly veg box scheme with about 2,300 subscribers. At 7am today a test email saying 'Your subscription has been cancelled' went to everyone by mistake. Nothing was actually cancelled or charged differently, and we've since set it up so test emails can only go to a staff-only list. I'm the owner, Owen.

I own Juniper Café. On Sunday one of our staff told a mum who was breastfeeding to cover up or leave, and she posted about it in the local community Facebook group, where it has 200 comments. I've apologised to her privately, spoken with the staff member, and briefed the whole team that breastfeeding is welcome anywhere in the café. People can email me at nina@example.com. I'm Nina.

I'm Ruth, licensee of The Copper Lantern pub. On Saturday 26 September a private birthday party in our beer garden ran loud until 12:40am, well past our 11pm garden closing, and three households on Elm Row came round to complain on Sunday. I want to put a letter through every door on Elm Row: from now on the garden closes at 10:30pm with a staff member checking it's empty, we've stopped taking garden bookings after 9pm, and people can reach me at ruth@example.com or at the bar.

I run Pedal & Pine, a bike rental shop. On 22 September I posted on Instagram that a booking-system glitch 'didn't charge anyone twice'. Yesterday our statements showed 48 customers were charged twice, $35 each; we refunded all 48 this morning, which should show within 10 business days, by 14 October. We now check each day's charges against bookings before closing. I'm the owner, Leo, and people can email leo@example.com.

I'm Tom, chef at Harvest Table, a supper club. We served 48 guests on Saturday 26 September and 11 have told us they've had vomiting and diarrhoea since. Environmental health inspected yesterday and we don't have results yet; we've paused all events, are refunding all 48 guests in full today, and our inbox is hello@example.com.

I'm Claire, manager of The Tamarind Room, a 300-capacity music venue. On Saturday 26 September a setup error in our ticketing sold 380 tickets, and we turned about 70 people away at the door because we can't go over capacity. Everyone turned away gets a full automatic refund by Friday 2 October plus free entry to any show before 31 December, which we'll email them how to claim; capacity is now locked in the ticket system and two of us check it before sales open, and people can reach me at claire@example.com.
我叫阿梅，开了一家手工辣酱小店。详情页和包装上一直写“全程手工制作”，有顾客在小红书发视频指出我们灌装用的是半自动机器：辣椒的剁和炒确实是手工，灌装和封口是机器。详情页今天已经改成“手工炒制，机器灌装”，11月起的新包装也换这句话；买过的顾客觉得被误导的，10月10日前私信店铺可以全额退款，不用退货；以后宣传文字发出前我会对照实际工序逐句核对。我的微信是 amei_lajiao。

I'm Dan, race director of the Riverside 10K, a community run with 640 finishers on Sunday 27 September. A turn point was set up in the wrong place, so the course was about 9.4km and the times can't count as personal bests or for club rankings. Results will go up marked as short course, everyone who entered gets free entry to our 5K on Sunday 15 November by an emailed code, and from now on two of us walk and measure the course the day before and every marshal gets a map with their exact spot. Questions to dan@example.com.
京都で和菓子のネットショップをしています。敬老の日（9月21日）に届くはずだった贈答用の詰め合わせ約120件が、こちらの出荷作業の遅れで9月23日の到着になりました。対象のお客様には送料を10月5日までに自動で全額返金し、今後は記念日ギフトの出荷を3日前倒しにします。店主の山田で、問い合わせはyamada@example.com で受けたいです。

I'm Helen Gray, director of Eastgate Food Share, a small charity. Our newsletter on Tuesday 29 September, emailed to about 1,800 supporters and posted on our website, included a photo of a family collecting food, and they had never agreed to it; a friend of theirs recognised them and complained on Facebook. I've taken the photo off the website and apologised to the family privately, and from now on no photo of anyone we support goes out without a signed consent form checked by a second person. Supporters can reach me at helen@example.com.

I'm Priya, owner of Lark & Loom, an online homeware shop. From 24 to 29 September the chat assistant on our website told about 35 customers that sale items could be returned for a full refund, but our policy is store credit only on sale items; we're honouring full refunds for anyone who asks before 31 October. The assistant now answers only from our written returns policy and hands every returns question to a person, and people can reach me at priya@example.com.

Soy Pilar, dueña de la librería La Hoja Suelta, en Sevilla. El lunes anunciamos en Instagram la ganadora del sorteo de un lote de 10 libros, pero el comentario elegido llegó después del cierre del domingo a las 23:59, así que la ganadora es otra persona. Ya le escribimos a la ganadora correcta, la persona anunciada el lunes también recibe un lote porque se lo prometimos, y desde ahora sorteamos sobre una captura de los comentarios hecha al cierre. Mi correo es pilar@example.com.
我是网店“青禾家纺”的店主苏晴。9月客服同事离职，我没及时安排人接手，大约430条售后留言等了5到12天才回复，有人在小红书上说我们“卖完就不管”。积压的留言现在已经全部回完；9月等过回复的客人，退换货运费由我们出，退款时一起退回，不用另外申请；从10月起我每天亲自看售后留言，48小时内回复。

I'm Sam Okoro, founder of Fernleaf, an online plant shop. A customer emailed yesterday that by changing the number in our order-tracking link she could see other customers' names, delivery addresses and phone numbers; it had been like that since a site update on 21 September, and about 2,600 orders were viewable. No payment details or passwords are on that page. We fixed it within an hour of her email, the tracking page now asks for the email address used on the order, and I want to email every affected customer; questions can go to sam@example.com.
我们是两人小团队“微光工作室”，去年在众筹平台上众筹一款木制台灯，承诺今年6月发货，共1260位支持者。因为低估了模具开发，到现在还没发货，7月之后也一直没更新进度，评论区很多人在骂。现在模具已经通过，11月20日前能全部发出；不想等的支持者10月31日前私信申请可全额退款；以后每月15日发一次进度更新。我是创始人何川。

I'm Leah, owner of Bloom Lane, a flower shop. In March we let customers opt out of Mother's Day emails, but the opt-out only covered emails sent in the weeks before Mother's Day, so on Thursday 1 October our 'Treat Mum' autumn promotion went to the 340 people who had opted out, and several replied hurt; some have lost their mothers. Opt-outs now cover every mum-themed email all year, and I want to email just those 340.
我是“山野小铺”的店主王岚，我们在网上卖家乡土特产。10月1日晚上直播时，主播模仿一位外地顾客的口音开玩笑，被截成视频在小红书上转了不少，很多人说看了不舒服。回放已经删了，我已私信向那位顾客道歉，也跟主播谈过；以后每场直播都会有第二个人在场，出现不合适的话当场纠正、当场道歉。

I'm Ines, founder of Hollowtree, a small online knitwear brand. From 7 to 28 September the size guide for our new Ridge jumper listed chest measurements one size too small, so about 150 customers ordered a size too big. Anyone who bought a Ridge in that window can exchange it with free postage both ways until 30 November, or return it for a full refund; the guide is fixed, every new size guide is now checked against a sample garment before it goes live, and questions can go to ines@example.com.

I'm Rosa, owner of Millbrook Bakehouse; we supply bread and pastries wholesale to 28 local cafés. On Monday we switched to a new delivery route we hadn't test-driven, and 11 cafés got their 7am delivery after 10am, after their breakfast rush. 我在小红书卖手工皮具，一个长钱包380元，不打折；买两个送两个同色钥匙扣，包邮，一般3天到，颜色都有现货。有人私信：'能便宜点吗？买两个呢'

I'm a florist. On Sunday a bride, Hannah, asked on WhatsApp about flowers for her wedding on October 17. I quoted $1,450 for her bouquet, 4 bridesmaid posies and 20 table centrepieces. Blue ticks, no reply. That's my last free Saturday in October.
我在成都开陶艺工作室，体验课每周六下午2点到5点，298元一位，含材料和烧制，最多6人，成品三周后到店取或包邮寄回；这周六10月3号还剩2个位置。有人在小红书私信：'你们的体验课是怎么上的？零基础可以吗'

I make hand-poured soy candles in 9 scents and sell them on Instagram for $32 each; wholesale is $16 a candle, 24-candle minimum mixed across scents, shipped within a week, and fig is my bestseller. A gift shop owner in Portland, Jenna, just DMed 'hi! do you do wholesale? love the fig one'.

I sell linen aprons on Instagram. Someone DMed 'hi! is the rust apron back in stock? it's for my mom's bday on oct 10'. The rust restock doesn't arrive until Oct 16; the terracotta, a shade lighter, is in stock, and orders by Monday Oct 5 arrive by the 10th.

I sell custom embroidered baby blankets on Instagram: $65 with a name, about 8 days to make plus 3 for shipping. Tara DMed 'is the cotton organic? want one for my nephew Theo'. My mill says it is, but I want to check their certificate first, which I can do by 8pm tonight.

Vendo luminárias de cerâmica feitas à mão pelo Instagram, aqui em Belo Horizonte, a R$ 290 cada; o frete para Portugal é R$ 180 por luminária, com rastreio, e leva 15 a 25 dias úteis. A Inês, de Lisboa, mandou DM: "Olá! Enviam para Portugal?"
我在朋友圈和小红书卖自己设计的连衣裙，一条459元；我的规则是收到7天内没穿过、吊牌在就能退或换码，换码来回运费我出。有人私信：“不合适能退吗？我在S和M之间，怕买错。”
我在小红书卖手工冷制皂，燕麦款58元一块，成分是橄榄油、椰子油、燕麦粉和乳木果油，无香精无色素，另有20克小样12元。有个宝妈私信：“宝宝8个月，有湿疹，这个能给他用吗？”

I'm a personal trainer: $70 an hour or $600 for ten, the first session starts with a movement check, and this week I have Friday 7am or Saturday 9am free. A guy named Ollie DMed me on Instagram last Friday: 'hey how much for 1 on 1 sessions? total beginner'. I only just saw it today, five days later.
我在小红书卖手工香薰蜡烛，128元一只，免费礼盒包装，可以写手写卡片。有人私信：“想送男朋友，雪松和白茶哪个好？他不喜欢甜的味道。”雪松是木质调偏沉稳，白茶清淡干净，两款都不甜。

I'm a hairdresser working from a home salon. Chloe DMed 'how much for balayage? shoulder length, currently box dyed dark brown'. My balayage is $180 for shoulder length, box dye usually needs a colour-removal step first for $60, and I do free 15-minute consults to check the hair.

I sell restored vintage road bikes on Instagram, sold in person in Portland for cash or bank transfer on collection. Someone DMed about a 1984 steel road bike listed at $420: 'I'll pay $500 if you hold it, I'll mail a cheque and my mover will collect'. I hold bikes only with a $50 deposit by bank transfer.
Instagramで革小物を販売しています。今日は9月30日（水）です。キーケース（4,800円）について佐藤さんからDM：「名入れってできますか？10月9日の金曜日までに欲しいです」。名入れは＋800円でローマ字8文字まで、注文から発送まで5営業日、佐藤さんは東京在住とのことで発送の翌日に届きます。

I make custom cookie gift boxes. Priya ordered 30 boxes for her team from me last December, and today she DMed on Instagram: 'hi again!! can we do the same as last year but 45 boxes, delivered Dec 11?' Dec 11 is free, my price is now $24 a box (it was $22), and I need orders confirmed by Nov 20.

I run a pottery studio in a converted shop. Grace DMed: 'is your studio wheelchair accessible? want to book my mum's birthday class on oct 17'. There's one small step at the door and we have a portable ramp, one wheel table fits a wheelchair, but the toilet is up a flight of stairs; the 2pm class that Saturday still has space.
我在杭州做上门喂猫，一般一天上门一次，每次60元，含喂粮、换水、铲屎和发视频，两只猫不加价。有人微信问：“国庆5号到8号出门，能上门喂两只猫吗？”这几天我都还有空。

J'ai une chambre d'hôtes en Dordogne : 85 € la nuit pour deux, petit-déjeuner compris, et les chiens sont acceptés pour 10 € la nuit ; le jardin est clos. Camille m'écrit sur Instagram : « Bonjour ! Vous avez de la place les nuits du vendredi 16 et du samedi 17 octobre pour 2 adultes et un chien ? Le petit-déj est compris ? » La chambre du jardin est libre ces deux nuits.
我在杭州做私人写真摄影，单人写真套餐1880元，含2小时拍摄和30张精修。有人在小红书私信：“这个套餐可以分期吗？一次拿不出这么多。”我的做法是先付500元定金锁档期，拍摄当天付清剩下的1380元，不做更多分期。
我在二手平台卖一台用了两年的微单相机，标价3200元，含两块原装电池和充电器。有买家私信：“有磕碰吗？快门多少？”机身底部有一处3毫米左右的掉漆，屏幕没有划痕，快门大约1.2万次；我可以拍细节图，同城能当面验货，外地包邮。

I tutor GCSE maths online for £40 an hour and do a free 20-minute first call. A mum, Karen, WhatsApped: 'How much? My son Josh is predicted a 3 and needs a 4 in his exams next June. Can you guarantee he'll pass?' I have Tuesdays and Thursdays at 5pm free.
我在上海做家庭烘焙，纸杯蛋糕一盒12个168元。顾客阿依古丽私信问：“你们的蛋糕是清真的吗？”我的配方不含明胶、酒精和猪油，用的是动物黄油，香草是无酒精的香草精，但我家厨房没有清真认证。

I'm selling my oak dining table with four chairs on Facebook Marketplace for $350, collection only from my place in Oakland, and it needs two people to lift. Three people messaged 'is this available?' within an hour; Dana was first. My rule is that it goes to whoever puts down a $50 deposit or comes to see it first.
我在南京开花店。有位顾客微信私信：“我爸周二走了，10月9日周五上午在殡仪馆告别，他生前最喜欢向日葵，能做一个向日葵为主的花篮吗？”我们的告别花篮480元起，向日葵现在有货，市区殡仪馆免费送到，下单需要逝者姓名和挽联落款。

I run a small tattoo studio. Our policy is 18 and over with photo ID, no exceptions, even with a parent's consent. A girl named Mia DMed: 'hi im 16, can i get a small moon on my wrist if my mum comes with me? how much?' A small wrist piece like that is $90, and we can save a design request until someone turns 18.

I sell refurbished film cameras on Instagram from my studio in Austin. The Canon AE-1 is $260 with a 90-day warranty, and payment only goes through the card checkout on my shop, never gift cards or crypto; local buyers can also pick up and pay at the studio on Saturdays, 10 to 2, and I'm happy to hold a camera until Saturday for them. Leo DMed: 'is this legit? got scammed on insta last month, lost $150'.
我在小红书开手冲咖啡器具小店。专业套装（电子秤、温控手冲壶、磨豆机、滤杯）899元；入门组合（滤杯、细口壶、100张滤纸）159元，可以先用买来的现磨咖啡粉。有人私信：“新手想试试手冲，一周就喝两三次，899那个套装值得买吗？”

I make hand-poured wedding favour candles: the 2oz tin is $3.80 each, the 4oz is $6.50, custom labels with names and date are free on orders of 40 or more, and wedding orders need 3 weeks. A bride, Priya, DMed 'hi! I have about $200 for favours for 50 guests, what can you do?'

I hand-knit cardigans and sell them on Instagram; ready-made sizes run XS to XL, and I knit any design to measurements for $40 extra, which takes about three weeks. Rosa DMed: 'love the Fern cardigan! do you go above XL? I'm usually a 3XL'. The Fern is $145, and I have a measuring guide I can send.

Ich habe eine kleine Fahrradwerkstatt in Köln. Lena schreibt mir auf Instagram: 'Hi, flickt ihr heute noch einen Platten? Hinterrad, brauche das Rad morgen früh für die Arbeit.' Ein neuer Schlauch hinten kostet bei uns 18 Euro inklusive Schlauch, bei Nabenschaltung 25 Euro; wer vor 16 Uhr kommt, kann in etwa 30 Minuten wieder fahren, und wir haben bis 18 Uhr offen.
我在微信上卖手工牛轧糖礼盒，一盒98元，50盒以上团购价每盒88元，可以免费印公司logo贴纸，要提前15天下单，春节前发货的最晚1月20日前下单。我是个体户，能开增值税普通发票，开不了专用发票。一家公司的行政私信：“我们过年想订80盒发给员工，能开发票吗？大概多少钱？”

I'm Nora Diaz and I run Slotwise, a scheduling tool for small clinics that cuts no-shows by about 30%. My old coworker Ben is friends with Laura Kim, the head of product at Canopy, whose clinic software would be a great integration partner. I'd like a 20-minute call with her. Ben and I are friendly but haven't talked in a year.
我想申请星澜科技商业化团队的数据分析岗，我做了三年电商数据分析，主要用SQL和Python做用户分层。我大学学长在那边做产品，关系还行但不算特别熟，也没一起工作过，想问问他能不能内推。

Ben introduced me to Laura at Canopy two weeks ago. We had a call last Tuesday and it went well, but there's no partnership yet: they're looking at partners again in Q1 and she asked me to check back in January. Should I tell Ben?

On 23 September I asked my former professor, Dr. Alvarez, if she'd introduce me to Kevin Tran, one of her old students who's now a hiring manager at a medical device company. I even wrote the blurb for her. No reply after eight days. Do I follow up?

I asked my friend Priya, who works at Larkfield Audio, to refer me for a product analyst role. She said she's not comfortable because we've never worked together and referrals are tracked against her. I'm a bit embarrassed, and we're still meant to get ramen on Thursday.

I'm Maya Chen, raising a pre-seed round for Shiftwell, my scheduling app for home-care nurses, with 14 agencies on a paid pilot. I met a founder, Olu Adeyemi, once at a meetup in June and we've swapped a few LinkedIn messages since. He's close with Rachel Stein, an angel who backed two home-care startups, including Carely. Is it too much to ask him for an intro?

I'm Daniel, newly self-employed as a sound engineer with simple books. My friend Priya's accountant, Helen Ward, isn't taking new clients, but Priya says she sometimes makes room for referrals. I want to ask Priya to pass on a note asking Helen for a 15-minute call.
我叫林悦，在市场部做了三年用户增长，今年牵头的会员拉新活动转化率比去年高40%，手上还有双十一项目。想转到产品部，领导周姐人很好，跟产品部的何总很熟，想请她帮我引荐聊半小时，但怕她觉得我是嫌弃现在的工作。

Three weeks ago my friend Hannah introduced me by email to Tom Reyes, a director at a solar company, for a chat about switching into the industry. I emailed Tom on Sept 9 and again last week, no reply. Meanwhile I've lined up a call with someone at SunPeak on Monday. Hannah just texted 'did you two ever talk?'
我叫小林，是做小程序的自由开发者，刚给一家烘焙店做完点单小程序，上线一个月线上订单占了三成，老板娘王姐很满意。听说她跟隔壁街豆子咖啡的周老板很熟，周老板最近在找人做会员系统。想请王姐帮我引荐。

I'm Jordan Lee, applying for PhDs in marine ecology this winter; my undergrad thesis with Dr. Chen was on urchin grazing in kelp beds. Chen did her postdoc with Prof. Adaeze Okafor, whose kelp forest recovery lab at Dalhousie is my first choice. I'd like Chen to introduce me so I can ask whether she's taking students for fall 2027 before I apply.
我叫林晓，做设计，11月从杭州调到成都工作，在那边一个人都不认识。大学室友小雅有个朋友阿楠，她在成都住了五年，也喜欢爬山。想请小雅介绍我们认识，主要想问问租房和生活。

I'm Priya, a freelance illustrator. Ruth, an art director at Brightwater Books and my biggest current client, mentioned that her former colleague Sofia Marsh now runs a picture-book imprint. I'd like an intro for a 15-minute call to show Sofia my portfolio, but I don't want Ruth to feel obliged because she pays me.

My nephew Aarav Mehta graduated in civil engineering in May; his senior project was a load study on a pedestrian bridge, and he's deciding between structural consultancies and the state DOT. My old college friend Dana Whitfield is a senior engineer at a bridge consultancy in Denver; we haven't talked in about two years. I want to ask if she'd talk to Aarav, not give him a job.

Ich bin Katrin Weber und suche eine technische Mitgründerin für Hofkiste, meine App, über die Hofläden Vorbestellungen annehmen; 23 Höfe im Raum Freiburg nutzen sie schon. Mein früherer Kollege Jonas hat erzählt, dass seine Freundin Lena Vogel, Backend-Entwicklerin, gerade gekündigt hat und etwas Eigenes sucht. Jonas und ich schreiben uns nur ab und zu auf WhatsApp.

I'm Leah Porter and I run a small nonprofit, Second Shift, that repairs donated laptops for school kids; we've given out 1,200 so far. My cousin Hannah used to work with Mark Ellis, the education reporter at our city paper. I'd like her to introduce me so I can tell him about our open day on Nov 14.
我是独立纪录片导演，在拍一部关于传统手艺人的片子。好朋友阿杰的舅舅认识景德镇一位做了四十年拉坯的陈师傅，我想请阿杰帮忙问问，11月去陈师傅作坊拍三天，按天付他误工费，成片先给他看，他不想用的镜头就删。
私は彩。大学からの友人の美咲の同僚、高橋さんに先月美咲の誕生日会で会って、二人とも山登りが好きだと分かって話が盛り上がった。高橋さんは今フリーらしい。美咲に紹介を頼みたいけど、職場の人だから気まずくさせたくない。

I asked my former colleague Rita to introduce me to Sam Okoro, a product director at a health-tech company, for a 20-minute chat about moving into product. Rita replied that she's only met Sam twice at conferences and doesn't feel she can make a formal intro, but I'm welcome to email him and mention her name.

I play keys in a jazz trio, the Low Tide Trio. My old bandmate Marcus plays The Blue Heron most months and knows the booker, Tanya. We want a Thursday night slot in November; we've played 30 gigs at smaller bars this year, usually pull 40 to 50 people, and have a live recording. Marcus and I text now and then.

My friend Nadia just emailed an intro to me and Grace Liu, a UX research lead, saying I'm moving into UX research after eight years teaching secondary science and would love 20 minutes of Grace's time. Grace hasn't replied yet. What do I write back?

I'm Leo and I make a hot sauce, Ember & Ash, selling about 200 bottles a month at local markets. I want to move to 500-bottle batches, and my friend Owen's aunt, Carol, runs a shared commercial kitchen that does small-batch bottling. I'd like a 20-minute call with her about pricing and minimum runs; Owen and I play five-a-side every week.
我叫林晓，在杭州办了一个公益读书会，每月一次，大概40人参加。想请作家沈岚11月来做一次一小时左右的分享，没有讲课费，但读书会承担往返高铁票和一晚住宿，时间按她方便来定。我的朋友小周是她新书的责任编辑。

Soy Inés y me mudo a Madrid en noviembre por trabajo. Mi amiga Carmen me contó que su tío Andrés alquila un estudio en Lavapiés que queda libre el 1 de noviembre. Quiero pedirle a Carmen que me presente: puedo pagar hasta 850 € al mes, tengo contrato indefinido y puedo enseñar mis últimas nóminas.
我叫陈悦，我爸68岁，医生建议他做膝关节置换，我们想手术前再听一次第二意见。好友小何的大学同学孙医生在一家三甲医院骨科看关节。想请小何问问能不能正常挂孙医生的号看一次，我们按流程挂号付费，不想让她私下看片子。
我叫小敏，女儿一岁半，明年3月起想请个白天带娃的育儿嫂，周一到周五早8点到晚6点，月薪6500元。同楼的刘姐家请的张阿姨口碑特别好，刘姐说她家孩子明年2月上幼儿园，张阿姨就不用再去她家了。想请刘姐帮我问问张阿姨，但又怕刘姐觉得我在抢她的阿姨。

I'm Grace Okafor and I've finished my first novel, The Salt Year, an 85,000-word literary novel; two of my short stories have appeared in literary magazines. My friend Tom, a published novelist, is represented by the agent Helen Brandt, who takes on literary fiction. Tom hasn't read the manuscript, and I don't want him to feel he has to vouch for a book he hasn't read.

I'm Ravi Shah. I finished a coding bootcamp in June and my capstone was a matchmaking service for a two-player puzzle game. I want an intro to Melissa Grant, an engineering manager at Tidepool Games, for 15 minutes about their junior backend role, and I'm thinking of posting in our bootcamp alumni Slack's referrals channel since I don't know who knows her.

I'm Amara Okeke, a pharmacist with eight years' experience in Lagos, and I moved to Toronto in July. My neighbour Joyce mentioned that her sister, Ruth Mensah, trained as a pharmacist abroad and got licensed here three years ago. I'd like Joyce to ask Ruth for a 20-minute call about the licensing exams and how she found her first job.

I'm Karen Liu. I was laid off from Ashgrove in August after 12 years running QA. Marcus reported to me there for four years and is now a team lead at Fernway, which has a senior QA manager opening. I'd like him to refer me, but I don't want him to feel he owes me because I used to be his boss.

Sou o Lucas Almeida, fotógrafo de casamentos em Porto Alegre há seis anos. Minha prima Fernanda topou me apresentar à Juliana Costa, dona do espaço de eventos Quinta das Videiras, e pediu um e-mail curto que ela possa só encaminhar. Quero pedir 20 minutos para mostrar meu portfólio e saber se posso entrar na lista de fornecedores indicados.

I'm Sara Klein and I run Crumbwell Bakeries, four bakeries with 30 staff. I'm hiring an operations manager, £48,000, hybrid. My friend Alice mentioned that her former colleague Dev Patel ran operations for a coffee chain and might be open to a move; I'd like Alice to ask Dev whether he'd be up for a 20-minute chat with no commitment.

I'm Hannah Moss. I was a payroll manager for nine years, then took three years out to care for my dad. My old friend Leila works in finance at Calder Homes, which runs a 12-week paid returnship for people coming back after a career break; applications close on Friday 23 October. We still text, but we've never worked together.

I'm Tomás Rivera, a data engineer. My former manager Beth knows Ifeoma Bello, who organises the DataHarbor Summit in March. The call for speakers has closed, but Beth says Ifeoma sometimes adds lightning talks; mine would be a 5-minute talk on how we cut our cloud bill by 38% by switching off idle test environments. I'd like Beth to ask whether Ifeoma would read a one-paragraph proposal.
我叫苏晴，28岁，上个月确诊了1型糖尿病，还在适应每天打胰岛素。闺蜜小雨说她表姐阿珍也是1型，已经二十年了，还跑过半马。想请小雨介绍我们加个微信，聊二十分钟平时怎么安排饮食和运动，不是请她给医疗建议。

I'm Kemi Adeyemi, volunteer coach of the under-11s at Westfield Rovers, a community football club. We need £600 for new kits for our 18 players, and a sponsor gets their logo on the shirts for two seasons. Martin, whose son Jayden plays in the team, golfs every week with Paul Hendry, who owns Hendry's Hardware on the high street, and I'd like Martin to ask Paul for a 15-minute chat.

Broke up 3 weeks ago. I still have my ex Jordan's guitar, bike helmet and a box of books. I can leave them at my building's front desk Thursday after 5, or he can pick them up Saturday 10 to 12. Want to hand it all back without a big conversation.
分手半年了，前男友突然发了一大段话，说他变了，想复合。我不想，但也不想伤人。
My college ex Mateo texted after 4 years saying he's moving back to Chicago and would love to catch up. I'm open to being friends, nothing more.

I've been with Nico for five months. Yesterday he admitted he's been seeing someone else, and he's away at a conference until Sunday. I want to end it now by text, without a big scene; he has my spare key, and his jacket is here, so he can collect it from my porch and leave the key in my letterbox.
My ex Priya and I broke up in July after three years. She just texted asking if we can 'be friends like before' before Dani's wedding on Oct 24, where we'll both be. I'm not ready for that.

My ex, Callum, and I split up in August after a year. We're on the same product team with standups every day. He messaged asking to 'grab a drink after work Friday and properly talk things through'. I don't want to.

Last week I told my ex Dylan I'm not in a place to be in touch. He's sent four long messages since, saying I never gave him a fair chance, listing things he's changed, and asking me to at least meet once to talk.
和前女友小雅分手两个月了，是和平分手。我们在同一个羽毛球群里，每周六上午一起打球，她问我能不能继续做朋友，至少打球的时候别互相躲着。我也愿意，但不想又走得太近。

My ex Marcus cheated on me and we broke up last October. Tonight he sent a long, honest-sounding apology, saying he's in therapy and just wants me to know he's sorry. He isn't asking for anything. I don't want to reopen things, but I don't want to ignore it either.

I met my ex Hana for coffee on Saturday as friends, a year after we broke up, and it was nice. Since then she's texted every night, said 'I miss us' last night, and wants dinner just the two of us on Friday. I'm not looking to get back together.
分手一年多的前男友突然微信找我，说创业资金周转不开，想借两万块，说下个月就还。我们分手时还算和平，但我不想借，也不想再有牵扯。

Lo dejé con Álvaro en junio después de cuatro años. Su madre, Maribel, con la que me llevaba muy bien, me ha escrito por WhatsApp invitándome a comer el domingo 'como siempre'. Le tengo cariño, pero no quiero seguir yendo a las comidas familiares.

My ex Jamie and I broke up in May after four years. I kept our dog, Biscuit, and Jamie just texted asking if they could see her sometime because they miss her. We both live near Victoria Park. I'm okay with that, but I don't want it turning into us hanging out.

My ex Nadia and I broke up in January, mostly because she moved to Denver for work. She's moving back on 7 November and texted that she'd like to try again. I'm open to it, but I want to go slowly and talk properly first.
今天是我生日，分手快一年的前男友阿凯发微信祝我生日快乐，还说“有空一起吃个饭”。我现在有男朋友了，不想再和他单独见面，但也不想显得太冷。

My ex Leo and I broke up in June after two years. At 2am last night he texted 'I miss you so much, can I come over?' and he was clearly drunk. I don't want to get back together, and I'm replying this morning.
一个月前是我提的分手，原因是我想回成都生活，她想留在上海发展。前女友小敏昨晚发微信问：“能不能告诉我到底哪里做得不好，我想知道真正的原因。”我说的就是真话，不想再列一堆她的问题。

My ex Ryan was controlling: he went through my phone and turned up at my work uninvited. We split in May and I blocked him. Today he messaged from a new number saying he's 'done a lot of work on himself' and just wants one coffee to talk.

I gave a 30-minute talk on accessibility testing at a local developer meetup last night. The organiser, Nadia, forwarded feedback: several people said it was too basic, and I ran 15 minutes over. The overrun is on me, but the event listing called the talk 'beginner friendly', so I pitched it that way.

My friend Jordan DM'd me that my Instagram story joking 'I'm so ADHD today lol' after losing my keys was hurtful, because she was diagnosed last year and people already don't take it seriously. I didn't mean anything by it, but I get it. I've just deleted the story.
我在北京工作，爸妈在老家，平时主要是弟弟照顾。弟弟昨天微信说我“什么都不管，就知道打钱”，上个月爸住院他一个人在医院陪了五天，我在出差没回去。每个月我都给家里打三千，每周也跟爸妈视频。爸11月中旬要去复查。

Divido apartamento com a Carla há um ano. Ela me mandou no WhatsApp que eu deixo louça na pia por dias e que ela sempre acaba lavando, e que eu 'nunca ajudo em nada'. A louça é verdade nas últimas três semanas, estou no turno da noite; mas sou eu que pago as contas online e faço as compras do mês.

Marta, a senior engineer, commented on my pull request: 'This is overengineered, three new classes for what should be a 20-line function.' She's right about the config builder and the formatter. The third class, the retry wrapper, is there because our logs show the payment API timing out on about 1 in 50 calls.

My son Daniel, 28, told me on the phone last night that growing up he felt nothing he did was ever good enough for me, and he brought up me calling his B+ in chemistry 'not good enough'. I did say that, though I don't think I was as harsh overall as he remembers. I want to text him today.

I play in a Sunday league netball team. Our captain, Bex, posted in the team WhatsApp that 'some people' keep skipping Wednesday training and still expect to start on Sundays, and everyone knows she means me. I've missed three of the last four sessions because my night shift rota changed in September, and I never told anyone. My shifts change back in November and I'll be able to make every Wednesday.

I was best man at my brother Owen's wedding on Saturday. Today his wife Rhiannon told me my speech hurt her: I told the story about Owen's ex turning up at his 30th, with her parents sitting right there. That story was a mistake, but I don't agree the whole speech was 'about me', since most of it was about the two of them. I want to text her.

I'm a postdoc writing our response to reviewers. Reviewer 2 called our sample of 24 participants 'woefully inadequate' and said the conclusions 'overreach'. The overreach point is fair: our discussion claims the findings generalise to older adults, but we only tested 18 to 30 year olds. The sample size was set by our preregistered power analysis for a large effect, which the Methods section didn't mention. We've now removed the generalisation claim, added it as a limitation, and stated the power analysis in Methods.
我在小红书做美食博主，昨天发了一篇本帮红烧肉的做法。有个网友在评论区说：“糖放这么多，根本不是正宗本帮红烧肉，误人子弟。”我回去一看，配料表里冰糖写成了50克，其实视频里用的是30克，是我打错了，笔记已经改成30克；不过本帮红烧肉本来就偏甜，这是我外婆教我的做法。

I run a weekly beginners' running club as a volunteer, Wednesdays at 6pm. A runner, Sarah, emailed that she's been left behind on the last three runs and is thinking of quitting. She's right: the faster runners set the pace, and in week one I promised nobody would get left behind.
我和大学同学阿峰合伙开了家咖啡馆，一人一半股份。他昨晚微信说我“什么都自己拍板，把他当摆设”，起因是我上周没跟他商量就花八千块换了磨豆机。磨豆机这事确实该先问他；但说我什么都自己拍板，我不同意，菜单和装修都是我们一起定的。店里周日休息。

I moved in with my mum, who's 81, after her fall in July. This morning she snapped that I treat her like a child, because I took over her pill organiser without asking and I hover whenever she cooks. The pills part is fair, but she left the gas on twice in August, which is why I watch the cooking.
我们课程小组作业周五交，组长小陈在微信群里说我负责的文献综述“像凑字数，引用格式也乱七八糟”。引用格式确实乱，我混用了两种格式，今晚可以统一成老师要求的那种；但篇幅是按老师要求的3000字写的，内容我觉得不算凑数。

My friend Tamsin sent me a voice note saying my replies in our friends' group chat feel dismissive: I react with a thumbs-up to everything, including when she shared that she got her PhD place last week. She's right about the PhD news. For plans and logistics I think a thumbs-up is fine, and I'd like to take her out for a celebration dinner.

I stayed at Mrs Kowalski's holiday flat in Porto last weekend. She messaged that we left it 'filthy': we did leave dishes in the sink and the bins full, but the red wine stain on the sofa was there when we arrived, and I have a photo from check-in on Friday at 4pm. I'm happy to pay the €25 extra cleaning she mentioned.
婆婆来帮我们带了一周孩子，乐乐这周跟奶奶玩得特别开心。她走前在微信上说：“你们太惯着乐乐了，吃饭还给他看平板，三岁了还天天抱着哄睡。”吃饭看平板她说得对，我们也想改；抱着哄睡是我和建军商量好的，打算明年他上幼儿园再慢慢改。

Comparto coche para ir al trabajo con Rocío y Javier. Rocío me ha escrito por WhatsApp que conduzco demasiado rápido, que le da miedo y que además siempre llego tarde a recogerlos. Lo de la velocidad es verdad: el martes pasado fui a 140 por la autovía para no llegar tarde; pero tarde solo llegué ese día, por unas obras. A partir del lunes voy a salir diez minutos antes.
我在一个业余乐队打鼓。排练完主唱阿乐私信我，说我“每次副歌都拖拍，整首歌都被我拖垮了”。我回去听了排练录音，第二段副歌确实拖了，但第一段没问题；桥段放慢是上周大家一起定的。下周六还要排练。

My climbing partner Ade told me after Tuesday's session at the wall that I'm a careless belayer: I was chatting to someone while he was near the top, and he had to shout 'take' twice when he slipped. Tuesday is true. But he also said I 'never' check his knot, and I do a partner check before every climb; we're climbing again on Thursday.

My coworker Sam told me privately over DM that she's been diagnosed with MS and will have a lot of appointments. Same team, not super close; she runs our Thursday client check-ins, and I could cover them when she's out.
我妈刚打电话说体检查出甲状腺结节，要做穿刺，她语气挺害怕的。我在外地工作，已经请好假，下周三能回家，穿刺那天可以陪她去。想挂了电话再给她发条微信。
My friend told me she has breast cancer and I blurted out that my aunt died of it. I'd already offered to bring dinner on Thursday. I feel awful and want to fix it.

My friend Hannah has long COVID and just cancelled our dinner for the third time. She texted 'I'm so sorry, I feel like the worst friend, my body just won't cooperate.' I'm not upset, I want her to know that, and I'm free on Saturday.

Mi amigo Javi me escribió por WhatsApp: 'Me han encontrado un tumor, casi seguro benigno, me operan el 14 de octubre. Lo bueno es que ya tengo excusa para no ir a la cena de empresa.' Quiero contestarle bien, y puedo llevarle al hospital ese día y recogerle.
我带的组员小何私聊我，说确诊了中度抑郁，医生建议休息两周，想从下周一开始请假。她不想让组里其他人知道原因。

My brother-in-law Dan told the family in August he has stage 3 colon cancer and started chemo. Everyone texted that first week, now it's gone quiet. He hasn't answered my last two messages. I live a few streets away and can drop food round on Saturday.

My friend Priya had a mastectomy two weeks ago. I've texted a few times and she just replied: 'Thank you, I love you, but I need to go quiet for a while and not talk about it.' I don't want to disappear, but I want to respect it.

My friend Kelly posted on Facebook that her son Noah (6) was just diagnosed with type 1 diabetes and they're in the children's hospital until Friday learning to manage it. Her daughter Ava is in 4th grade with my daughter, and I could take Ava to and from school with mine for the rest of the week. I want to message her.
听共同朋友阿丽说，好朋友小敏的老公上周五突然中风，现在还在ICU。小敏自己没跟我说，阿丽说她不想到处讲。我想私信她，又不想让她觉得被议论；这周六中午我可以给她送饭到医院。
我跟我爸五六年没怎么联系了，他再婚后关系一直很淡。今天他突然发微信说查出肺癌，下个月在成都做手术，就这一句。我不知道怎么回，但不想装没看见。

My manager, Karen, emailed our team of eight that she's been diagnosed with breast cancer, starts treatment next week and will be on reduced hours through December. I usually back her up on the Monday team meeting and vendor calls. I want to reply to her privately, not reply-all.

My close friend Owen texted that he's checking into a 28-day residential program for his drinking on Monday. He said only his sister and I know, and asked me not to tell anyone. We've been friends since school, he lives alone with his dog, Rufus, and I could have Rufus or walk him while he's away.

I'm a freelance web designer. Ruth, a client of three years who runs a small pottery studio, emailed that she's been diagnosed with a heart condition, has surgery on Oct 14, and wants to pause her website project for 'a month or two'.

My friend Sofia, 30 weeks pregnant, texted that she's been diagnosed with pre-eclampsia and is in hospital on bed rest until the baby comes. She asked me to tell our running club she's out for a while, without saying why. I'm free any evening this week to visit or bring her things from home.
好友小雯去年做了乳腺癌手术和化疗，今天复查结果出来一切正常。她发微信说：“结果挺好的，可我还是天天担心复发，是不是很没出息？”
大学室友小雅骑车摔断了腿，住院一周，今天在朋友圈发了张病床照片，说“要躺一阵了”。她一个人住，养了只猫，我有她家备用钥匙。想发微信给她，又怕打扰她休息。

Graham, 72, was my late dad's best friend and like an uncle to me. He emailed that his cancer has spread, he's stopped treatment and is having palliative care at home, and he'd welcome visitors 'while I'm still decent company'. I still have the photos of him and Dad on their Lake District trips.
我在德国工作。我哥在家族群里说，爸爸上周确诊了早期阿尔茨海默病，这几个月都是他一个人带爸去看医生。他说得很平静，但我知道他扛得很累。爸不在这个群里。我12月有两周假可以回国，也可以从这周六开始每周六晚上跟爸视频。
女儿在英国读研，今天微信告诉我她确诊了1型糖尿病，住了三天院，已经学会自己打胰岛素。她语气挺平静，说“别担心，先别告诉奶奶”，还说我不用飞过去。我特别想马上订机票。

Over coffee today my friend Marcus told me he's HIV positive. He was diagnosed in August, he's on treatment and doing well, and he said he was nervous to tell me. We go climbing together most Thursdays. I want to text him tonight.
大学で講師をしている高橋です。ゼミ生の佐藤さんから、先週てんかんと診断されたので10月8日（木）の中間発表を休ませてほしいとメールが来ました。発表は10月22日（木）に回せますし、ゼミの他の学生に理由を言うつもりはありません。

I'm Sarah. My neighbour Mrs Albright, 81, told me over the fence this morning that she's been diagnosed with macular degeneration and isn't allowed to drive any more. She sounded brisk about it but I could tell she was upset. She does her shopping on Tuesdays, and I drive to the supermarket every Tuesday morning anyway. I want to put a note through her door.

Our WhatsApp group of eight uni friends had been quiet for months. Last night Tom posted that he's been diagnosed with testicular cancer and has surgery on Tuesday 6 October. People are replying with questions about the stage and stories about relatives; I want to reply in the group, and I live ten minutes from him.

My friend Leah, 34, texted that she tested positive for the BRCA1 gene and her doctors have raised a preventive double mastectomy. She asked me straight out: 'What would you do?' I don't think it's my place to tell her, and we usually walk together on Saturday mornings.
男朋友阿哲在深圳工作，我在北京。他今晚发微信说确诊了强直性脊柱炎，是慢性病，要长期吃药，还说“以后可能会拖累你，你要想清楚”。我没想过要走。这周五下班我可以飞过去陪他过周末。

Ines and I have been in the same online book club on Discord for four years; she's in Lisbon, I'm in Leeds, and we've never met. She just messaged me privately that she's been diagnosed with lupus and will step back from hosting our Sunday reading sessions for a while. I can host the Sunday sessions through November.

My friend Claire and I haven't spoken since an argument in May about her wedding plans. Today she texted that she has Hodgkin lymphoma, starts chemo on 12 October, and 'didn't want you to hear it from someone else'. I want to put the argument aside, and I live ten minutes from the hospital where she's being treated.

My close friend Mia texted that her third IVF round has failed and the clinic told her and her wife that more rounds are unlikely to work. I'm 22 weeks pregnant and she knows; I don't want my pregnancy to make this harder for her. We usually walk our dogs together on Sunday mornings.

My little brother Ollie, 19, is at uni about two hours from me. He just texted that he spent last week in a psychiatric unit, has been diagnosed with bipolar disorder, is out now and on medication, and asked me not to tell our parents yet. He sounded flat rather than panicked, and I'm free to drive down on Saturday 10 October.
好朋友阿宁今天告诉我，她确诊了神经性厌食症，在医院门诊治疗，让我先别告诉别人。我们以前几乎每周都约火锅。她最近很喜欢看展，这周日下午市美术馆有个她一直想看的插画展。
我是理发师阿琪。老顾客周姐给我发微信，说确诊了乳腺癌，下个月开始化疗，医生说头发会掉，问我能不能先帮她把头发剪短。我们店周一休息，10月5日周一我可以单独给她开门，这次不收钱。

My friend Jess texted that her doctor found a lump in her breast; she had a biopsy yesterday and won't get the results until next Thursday. She wrote 'trying not to spiral but the waiting is awful.' I work from home on Thursdays.

My friend Raj texted that tests have confirmed progressive hearing loss in both ears; he gets hearing aids next month, and phone calls are already hard for him. We've talked on the phone every Sunday evening for years. I'm happy to switch to video with captions or to texting, whichever he prefers.

My dad, 67, texted me at 11pm: 'Had a funny turn this evening, left arm went numb and my words came out wrong for a few minutes. Fine now, don't want to make a fuss.' Mum is away at her sister's this week, and I live 40 minutes from him.
我和女朋友小婧谈了两年。今天去她家吃饭，她妈妈在饭桌上说自己确诊了帕金森，语气挺平静，说“不影响生活，你们别担心”。我跟阿姨不算很熟，想晚上私下发条微信，不想太生分也不想越界；小婧说下周六要陪阿姨去复诊，我可以开车接送。

Got rejected after 4 rounds and a case study for a product designer role at a fintech; I really enjoyed the portfolio review with the team. The hiring manager, Lauren, was great throughout. I want to ask for feedback without sounding bitter.

Tenho uma pequena agência em Lisboa. Fizemos proposta para o rebranding de uma rede de padarias e escolheram outra agência. O contacto era o Rui, diretor de marketing, que nos deu um briefing muito claro.
Final interview for an ops manager role at Larkfield General Hospital on Sept 10. Recruiter Dev said I'd hear by the 18th. Nothing. I sent a check-in on the 23rd, still nothing.
公司内部竞聘组长，我进了最后一轮但没选上，选了同组的小周。部门领导李总昨天花了半小时当面跟我说的结果，面试时他问得很细。我以后还要天天跟他们一起工作。

Rejected for a senior PM role at Tidewell. I asked the hiring manager, Omar, for one thing that would have changed it. He said my product sense was strong but my answers on metrics were vague, and they needed someone who sets targets up front. It stings, but it's fair.
想申请明年的直博，给北大环境学院的周教授发邮件自荐，他看了我附的材料，很快回复说今年名额已经满了，建议我考虑其他老师。我还是很想跟他做土壤修复方向。

J'ai passé une journée d'évaluation pour un poste de commercial chez un distributeur de matériel médical à Lyon. La recruteuse, Camille, m'écrit que je ne suis pas retenu et me propose un appel de 15 minutes pour un retour. Je suis libre mardi 6 ou mercredi 7 octobre en fin de matinée.

I'm a freelance journalist. I pitched a feature on rural bus cuts to Dana, features editor at Northline Magazine. She replied the same day: 'Not quite right for us, but thanks for thinking of us.' I'd really like to write for them eventually.
9月15号在一家新能源车企面了产品运营岗位的最后一轮，HR王女士说9月22号前给结果，到今天一直没消息。想问一下，又怕显得太着急。

Founder here. Kara, a partner at Northfield Ventures, passed on our seed round after two meetings; her question about repeat purchase rates changed how we track our pilot. We'll have three months of paying customers by January, and she's raising a new fund. Her email said 'too early for us, love the team.' I'd like her to invest later without sounding desperate.

My friend Nadia referred me for an analyst role at her company, Brightline. I got rejected after the second round yesterday, though I liked the team a lot. I want to thank her without making her feel bad or like she has to find out why.

I interviewed for Marketing Manager at Fernhill Foods and had a great conversation with the hiring manager about their spring launches. The hiring manager, Grace, emailed that they went with someone with more team management experience, but suggested I apply for a Senior Marketing Specialist role opening next month. I'm deflated, but I'd consider it.

I submitted a talk proposal to DevNorth, a regional developer conference, on how we split our monolith into services. The program chair, Elena, emailed that it wasn't selected this year out of 240 submissions. The conference is in March and I'm attending anyway; I'd really like to speak there one day.

I did a paid trial shift as a line cook at Harbour Street Kitchen last Friday. Head chef Tom texted today: 'Thanks for coming in, we've gone with someone with more pastry experience.' I learned a lot watching him run the pass on that busy Friday. It's a small restaurant scene here and I'll probably cross paths with him again.
面了一家咨询公司的项目经理，HR林小姐今天打电话说我是第二人选，第一人选已经接了offer，如果有变化会再联系我。挺可惜的，我还是很想去。
上周HR陈女士电话口头给了我数据分析师的offer，说这周发正式offer。今天她又打电话说公司冻结招聘，offer撤回了。我还没跟现公司提离职，挺失落的，想回条微信保持好印象。

Me rechazaron para unas prácticas de verano en un estudio de arquitectura en Valencia. La entrevista fue con la arquitecta Lucía Ferrer y estuvimos 20 minutos repasando mi portafolio, pero el rechazo llegó en un correo automático de RR. HH. sin nombre. Quiero escribirle a Lucía por LinkedIn para pedirle un consejo sobre el portafolio.

I run a small IT support firm. We've looked after Hollins & Reed, a 40-person accounting firm, for three years, and their operations director Mark just emailed that after a tender they're moving to a larger provider from January 1. Our best moment was moving their whole office to a new building last year without a day of downtime, and we're on contract until December 31.

I applied to be a trustee at Eastside Food Bank, the local charity where I've volunteered on Saturdays for two years. The chair, Margaret, emailed that the board chose someone with an accounting background because they need a treasurer. I'm disappointed, but I'd like to keep volunteering and be considered next time.
面了一家互联网公司的产品经理，最后一轮前做了笔试作业，花了整个周末写了12页的方案，交给面试官陈经理。今天HR赵女士发邮件说没通过，没说原因。这几周都是赵女士帮我协调面试时间，我挺想知道方案哪里不行。

I just finished a 12-week summer internship on the data team at Corvel Health, where I built the churn dashboard. My manager Ben told me on a call today there's no return offer because of headcount, not my performance, and said he'd happily be a reference. I want to thank him and take him up on that.
面了一家物流公司的运营专员，面试官王经理跟我聊了一个小时，挺投机。今天HR刘女士打电话说，我的经验比岗位要求高太多，怕我待不久，所以没录用，还提到他们明年可能会招运营主管。其实我是真心想换行业从基层做起，但不想跟她争。

My former manager Rachel, who I worked under for three years at Copperline, is now a director at Quill Health and interviewed me for a team lead role. She called today to say they went with an internal candidate. We still get coffee every couple of months and I don't want this to make things awkward.
我写了一部二十万字的悬疑小说，投给一家出版社，编辑周老师读完了全稿，还跟我通了半小时电话，她提的修改建议我觉得很有用。今天她发邮件说选题会没通过，说这类题材今年做得比较多。我在写下一本，也是悬疑，想以后还能投给她。
我是一家做乡村图书角的公益组织的项目负责人小田。我们申请了一家基金会的年度资助，项目官员何女士发邮件说没获批，今年只资助了8个项目，我们排第11。下一轮明年3月开放，我想以后还能申请。

Aldergate Foods turned me down for a supply chain analyst role after three interviews, which the recruiter, Hannah, had rescheduled twice to fit around my notice period. Last night I replied 'I'm surprised, I thought it went really well and I have more experience than most applicants.' I regret it and want to repair it.
我叫赵磊。上周二面了一家咨询公司的分析师岗位，今天HR张小姐发邮件说没通过。整个流程挺顺的，案例面试前她还提前把题目背景发给我准备。想回一封邮件，问问能不能给一句反馈，以后有合适的岗位还想再投。
我叫何佳。上个月面试了一家咨询公司的分析师岗位，一直走到终面，今天HR赵女士邮件通知我没通过。整个流程她安排得很周到，每轮结束都当天通知我结果。我想回复她，顺便问能不能给一句反馈。
地方の食品メーカーの営業職で最終面接まで進みましたが、今日、人事の佐藤さんから不採用のメールが届きました。最終面接では工場見学までさせてもらい、とても印象に残っています。理由は聞かずに、お礼と、また募集があれば応募したいことだけ伝えたいです。私は田中です。

I interviewed for a senior UX designer role at Brightfield. The hiring manager, Sophie, emailed that they're hiring someone with more research leadership for the senior role, but she'd like to talk to me about a mid-level designer role on the same team that opens in November. I enjoyed the design critique session with her team and I'm open to it, but I'd want to know the scope and pay band before deciding.

Ich heiße Miriam und habe beim Vorsingen für den Kammerchor Vox Nova gesungen; das gemeinsame Einsingen mit der Gruppe hat mir sehr gefallen. Die Chorleiterin, Frau Keller, schreibt, dass es diesmal nicht geklappt hat, weil der Alt voll besetzt ist, und dass das nächste Vorsingen im März ist. Da will ich unbedingt wieder antreten.

I'm Arjun, on a graduate visa that ends in June. I interviewed for a junior data engineer role at Pellow Systems and really enjoyed the pairing exercise with their engineer, Kim. The recruiter, Laura, emailed that they liked me but can't sponsor the work visa I'd need from June; I'd like to hear if that ever changes.

我叫阿禾，开了一家卖手工陶瓷杯的淘宝店。有个买家晒图给了差评，说杯子寄到时碎了，“包装太敷衍”。外箱是被快递压扁的，但我们的包装确实只有一层气泡膜。新杯子今天已经给她补寄，这周起所有杯子改成双层气泡膜加纸格固定。

I'm Sophie and I own a bookshop, Lark Books; my email is sophie@example.com. 2-star Google review from 'Tom R.': he uses a wheelchair, couldn't get over our front step, and the staff member at the till didn't know we had a portable ramp. I'm Karen, manager of Maple Court, a 30-bed care home. 'Linda H.' left a 2-star Google review saying her mum's clothes keep going missing in the laundry and 'nobody here cares'. 我叫阿楠，在成都开陶艺体验馆，两小时拉坯课198元。顾客“小鹿”在大众点评给了两星，说“198只能玩两小时，作品烧制还要另加30块，太坑了”。烧制费我们确实只写在页面最下面的小字里；现在套餐标题已经写明，从10月5日起烧制费直接包含在课程价格里。我的邮箱是anan@example.com。

I'm Sam Reyes, a solo wedding photographer. 'Hannah & Luke' left a 2-star review on a wedding directory saying their photos took 11 weeks when my contract says 6, and my emails were slow. 我叫美和，在京都开一家小民宿。一位中国客人在订房平台上给了两星，说房间比照片小很多，隔音也差，晚上能听到隔壁说话。房间面积页面上一直写着12平米，隔音差是真的；现在每间房都放了耳塞，页面上写明了“木造老屋，隔音一般”，照片旁边也加了面积说明。客人可以在平台上私信我。

Je m'appelle Claire et je tiens Kayak du Lac, une petite location de kayaks à Annecy. I'm Dr. Anna Kerr, owner of Riverside Vet Clinic. I'm Grace Lin and I run a small maths tutoring service. My email is grace@example.com.

I'm Ellie and I make soy candles; my shop is called Wick & Wild. I'm Lan, owner of Pho Lan Kitchen. 我叫阿芳，在长沙开火锅店。顾客“小米”在大众点评给了一星，说排号等了一个半小时，叫号还被跳过了。昨晚我老公直接回复“自己没听到叫号还怪我们”，我已经把那条删了，想换一条。以前叫号确实只喊一次，现在已经改成短信叫号、过号保留10分钟，我的电话是138 0000 2468。

I'm Priya Nair and I sell an online spreadsheet course for small business owners. My email is priya@example.com.

I'm Callum, manager of The Drover's Arms; my email is callum@example.com. I'm Joe and I own Spoke & Chain, a bike repair shop; my email is joe@example.com. I'm Ana and I run Fernleaf Refill, a refill shop; my email is ana@example.com. Ich bin Jonas und habe eine kleine Bäckerei, die Backstube Lindner; meine Adresse ist jonas@example.com. Gestern hat 'M. Becker' bei Google einen Stern gegeben, nur mit dem Text 'Nie wieder.' Wir wissen nicht, um welchen Besuch es geht, und finden in unseren Bestellungen keinen Namen dazu.

I'm Ruth, adoption coordinator at Paws Harbor Rescue, a small animal rescue; my email is adopt@example.com. We decline when a dog's needs don't match a home, but that email gave no reason; from now on everyone we decline gets a phone call from me explaining why and suggesting animals that might suit them better.
My mother-in-law said 'must be nice to order takeout every night' while visiting. It has been a hectic month, and my son Luca loves her chicken soup. It's a one-off dig and I don't want a thing.
室友在群里说“我就自己倒垃圾吧，反正也没人管”。确实最近几次都是她倒的。
Since I got engaged, my best friend keeps making little digs ('some of us still pay rent alone'). I asked once and she said she's fine. It just happened again.
项目会上大家定了换新的物流供应商，会后同事小林在工作群里回了一句“行，你们定就好，反正我的意见也不重要”。她平时不这样说话，我也不确定她具体是对哪一点不满。

Nicole from another team emailed me about the onboarding checklist and CC'd my manager Priya: 'Looping in Priya for visibility, as this is the third time I've asked.' I replied to both earlier emails, on 18 and 25 September, saying it's ready except the headcount section, which needs her team's final numbers. I still don't have them.

Freelance designer. Client Mark emailed 'As I've already said twice, the logo needs to be bigger. Not sure how else to put it.' I did make it bigger in v2 and he approved v2 on Friday. Now we're on v3.

I joined standup 5 minutes late this morning because a call with our customer Brightwater ran over. Right after, my manager Colleen posted in the team channel: 'Friendly reminder that standup starts at 9:30, for those who forgot.' Obviously aimed at me. First time I've been late in months.
我妈在家族群里发：“现在都是大忙人了，一个月也想不起来给妈打个电话。” 明显是说我，确实最近加班很少打电话。女儿朵朵最近学了支新舞。不想在群里接这个话。

Rob in finance emailed me: 'Per my last email, I still need the Q3 vendor invoices. Not sure how else to ask.' I checked, and he did email me on Sept 21 and I missed it. I have all 14 invoices ready, plus two credit notes from Halden.

We had friends over Saturday and it ran late. This morning there's a note on our door from the downstairs neighbour: 'Hope the party was fun! Some of us have to work in the morning :)' I'm Dan in 3B and I've never met her properly; my mobile is 07700 900312. I want to reply without starting a feud.

I'm a team lead. At 3pm on Friday I asked my report Jamal to update the client deck for Monday at 10, because the client had just moved the meeting up. He replied in Slack: 'Sure, I'll just cancel my weekend then 🙂'. Honestly, it is a lot to drop on him.
下周我要去成都出差四天，跟老婆说了以后，她回了一句：“去吧去吧，反正家里两个孩子我一个人弄惯了。”这个月我确实已经出差三次了。

My ex Greg and I co-parent. I asked to swap weekends because of a work trip and he texted 'Sure, I'll rearrange my life around your job again.' I asked if he was annoyed and he said 'I'm not annoyed.' The swap is Friday Oct 9 to Sunday Oct 11, for our kids Maya and Theo, with the usual handovers at 5:30 Friday and 6 Sunday.

Six of us have a friends' group chat. I posted photos from a hiking weekend and Chris replied 'Nice to see some people have time for trips but not for Dave's birthday 🙃'. I did miss Dave's birthday last week, because I had flu.

I posted on LinkedIn that I've been promoted to engineering manager. A former teammate, Greg, who applied for the same role before he left, commented publicly: 'Congrats! Funny how things work out for people who are in the right meetings 😉'.
前回の提案書は締め切りに2日遅れました。今回は期限どおりに出したら、課長に皆の前で「へえ、今回はちゃんと期限守れたんだね。やればできるじゃない」と言われました。言い返したくはありません。
我在上海工作，爸在老家住，这半年他去医院复查了四次，都是我哥请假陪的。刚才我私聊问爸的情况，我哥回：“你在上海过得挺好吧，爸这边反正有我，你放心。”我想以后复查跟他轮流陪，国庆1号到5号我回家，这几天爸的事可以都交给我。

La profesora de mi hija Lucía, la señora Ortega, escribió en el grupo de WhatsApp de padres: 'Recuerdo que los deberes no son opcionales, aunque algunas familias parecen pensar lo contrario.' Lucía no ha entregado dos fichas de matemáticas este mes porque estuvo una semana con gripe, y las terminará este fin de semana. Soy Marta y no quiero contestar en el grupo.

I'm planning dinner for my three-month anniversary with my girlfriend Sam on Saturday. I said no to her first two restaurant ideas because they're both over an hour's drive, and she texted back: 'Fine. Whatever you want, it's your call apparently.' Honestly, I'd do the drive if it matters to her.

Ich bin nach sechs Monaten Elternzeit zurück im Büro. Mein Kollege Stefan, der in der Zeit das Kundenprojekt Weber übernommen hat, schrieb mir heute im Team-Chat: 'Na, auch mal wieder da? Muss schön sein, ein halbes Jahr frei.' Es ist das erste Mal, und ich will mich weder rechtfertigen noch streiten.

I'm an ops lead and I post process updates in our team Slack. My peer Dana has replied to the last three with things like 'Great, another process change 🙄' and 'Love finding out about this in the channel'. I didn't run any of those changes past her team first. I want to message her privately.
周六上午10点，部门领导张总在工作群里问月报什么时候能交，我在陪女儿参加钢琴比赛，没看到。下午他又在群里说：“有些同事周末消息都不回啊，看来工作不太着急。”月报我周一上午10点前能交。不想在群里解释。

I promised my daughter Maya, 16, I'd be at her volleyball final on Tuesday, and I missed it because a work meeting ran over. Tonight she texted 'Don't worry, I know work comes first 🙂'. She's in her room upstairs, and honestly she's right to be upset.

For my 30th last Saturday I had a tiny dinner at home for six: mostly family plus my two oldest friends. My friend Bella, who I see at our monthly book club, saw the photos and texted 'Looks like a lovely party, guess my invite got lost in the post 🙃'. Book club is next Thursday, and I'd genuinely like to have a birthday drink with her.
房东王姐今天微信说：“这个月房租又晚了两天哈，没关系，反正我的房贷是我自己会还的。”这个月和上个月确实都晚了两天，因为公司发工资改到了每月5号，我也没提前跟她说。这个月的房租今天上午已经转过去了，我想把交租日改成每月6号，再设成自动转账。

Almost every day when I leave at 4:30, my coworker Phil says 'Half day today?' loud enough for the whole office. I start at 7:30 and my manager Ines approved those hours. It's happened four times this week, and I want to message him privately.

Four of us are writing a group report for our marketing module, due Friday 9 October. In our group chat Leah just wrote 'Great, so I'll just rewrite everyone's sections again like last time 🙂'. My section, the competitor analysis, has been in the shared doc since Tuesday, about 1,400 words, and nobody has commented on it.

I'm getting married on 14 November and we capped the wedding at 60 guests, so only partners who live together are invited as couples. My cousin Tara RSVP'd yes and added 'Guess single people don't get plus-ones, noted 🙃'. She'll be on the cousins' table with Jake and Mia, and I really want her there.
我住3栋。昨晚遛狗回来，我家柯基豆豆在电梯里尿了一点，我当时没注意。今早业主群里有人发了照片，说“3栋电梯里又是狗尿，某些人养狗真有素质哈”。我已经用消毒水把电梯擦干净了，想在群里回一句。

For my sister Hannah's birthday I gave her an $80 gift card for a running shop, because she's said twice she wants to choose her own trail shoes. She texted back 'A gift card, wow, so personal 🙃'. She's running a half marathon on Sunday 18 October, and I don't want to make a thing of it.

My best friend Ruby lives in Melbourne and I'm in London. I started a new job three weeks ago and missed our last two video calls, and she just texted 'Don't worry, I know I'm not a priority anymore 🙂'. She's right to be hurt, and I'm free to call on Sunday morning my time, which is her Sunday evening.
我跟分管副总王总说，10月16日上线前加不了新的用量看板，除非砍掉CSV导出功能：要么看板10月30日再上，要么导出功能挪到10月30日。他邮件回了一句：“知道了，我会跟董事会说研发交付不了。”我不想顶回去，但要让董事会看到真实的选项。

My friend Zoe asked me to help her move flats on Saturday. I said I couldn't because I'm at my nephew's christening all day, and offered to bring pizza round to her new place on Sunday evening instead. She replied 'No worries, I'll ask people who actually show up for their friends 🙂'.

I have a plot at our community garden and missed Saturday's clean-up day because I was working a shift. The committee chair, Bernard, emailed all plot holders: 'Huge thanks to the eight of us who bothered to turn up. I'm sure the rest of you had more important things on.' I'm Priya, and I'm free to do two hours of weeding on Sunday afternoon.
