Ma belle-soeur Camille organise le déjeuner de famille dimanche. Je lui ai demandé s'il y aurait un plat végétarien, et elle m'a répondu : « Ah oui, j'oublie toujours que Madame ne mange plus comme tout le monde 🙃 ». Je suis végétarienne depuis un an, je ne veux pas en faire une histoire, et je peux apporter un gratin de lentilles pour tout le monde.
Recruiter wants a call about a Staff Engineer role but won't give the salary range, just 'it's very competitive, let's discuss on a call'. My floor is $190k base.
猎头在脉脉上找我，说一个大厂的高级产品经理岗位。我刚跳槽4个月，不想动，但这个猎头挺专业的，想保持联系。
Told a recruiter twice I'm not interested in contract roles. He's messaged me three more times this week with contract gigs.
A recruiter, Nadia, emailed that before she passes me to the hiring manager she needs my current salary. I make $128k and I'm targeting $150k base. I'm interested in the role.

Gestern hatte ich ein Erstgespräch mit Frau Keller, Recruiterin bei einer Unternehmensberatung, für eine Senior-Consultant-Stelle. Klang gut, aber die Rolle hat 60 Prozent Reisetätigkeit und das passt mit meinen zwei kleinen Kindern nicht. Ich heiße Jana Hoffmann und will höflich absagen.
去年10月猎头周小姐找过我一个高级数据分析岗位，我当时婉拒了，说保持联系。现在公司在裁员，我想主动找她，想找上海电商或金融公司的数据团队负责人，年薪期望55万左右，但不想显得很急。
Recruiter Maya from a fintech shared the band for a Senior Data Engineer role: $140k to $155k base. I'm on $160k now and wouldn't move for under $175k. The role itself sounds good.

Recruiter Sam wants to put me forward for an operations manager role at Keystone Logistics and asked if I'm interviewing anywhere else. I'm in final rounds with one other company and don't want to name it, and I don't know Keystone's range yet. I'm free for a call Tuesday 6 October or Wednesday 7 October in the morning.

An in-house recruiter at a health-tech company, Marcus, messaged me on LinkedIn about a senior QA lead role. I'm happy where I am, but my former colleague Tanvi Rao, who led QA on our mobile apps for three years, is job hunting and would be great for it. Later on I'd consider engineering management roles.
ビズリーチ経由で、エージェントの田中さんから物流系SaaS企業のプロダクトマネージャー職のスカウトが来た。自分は山本。興味はあるけど、自分はPM歴5年で今は3人のチームのリード。募集要項を見るとメンバークラスっぽいので、面談の前にレベル感と年収レンジを確認したい。
一个猎头在脉脉上联系我，是深圳一家互联网公司的高级前端岗位，方向我挺感兴趣。但我听说他们是大小周，我现在不考虑大小周。想在约电话前先问清楚。

An agency recruiter, Liam, messaged that he'd 'love to put me forward' for a product analyst role at Harbor Health. Before I replied, Harbor Health's HR emailed saying they'd received my CV from his agency. I never agreed, and I might have wanted to apply directly.

An agency recruiter, Owen, called my desk phone at work this morning with my manager sitting right next to me. I said I couldn't talk and he emailed my personal address after. I'd actually like to hear more, just not on that line.

A recruiter, Kelly, says her client is about to offer me a project manager role and wants me to confirm now that I'll accept if it's $120k base. That's in my range, but I haven't seen the benefits or met the manager I'd report to. I could meet the manager Monday 5 October or Tuesday 6 October.

A recruiter, Hannah, messaged me on LinkedIn about a senior backend role at a fintech in Amsterdam. I'm Canadian, based in Toronto, and would need visa sponsorship and help relocating. I'm genuinely interested.

A recruiter, Priya, messaged me on LinkedIn about a senior UX researcher role at a healthcare company. I'm on parental leave until January 8 and can't start before February 1, but I'm genuinely interested. I'd rather not interview until December.

A recruiter, Tom, messaged me on LinkedIn about a data scientist role at Calloway Insurance. I interviewed there in March and was turned down after the final round because I lacked experience with pricing models. I've spent the six months since building pricing models in my current job, and I'm interested.
猎头陈先生在领英上联系我，推荐一家“头部物流公司”的供应链数据经理岗位，从描述看就是我现在的公司，很可能就是我们组正在招的岗位。我不打算动，但他挺专业，以后想保持联系。

Recruiter Aaron messaged me on LinkedIn about a regional sales director role at Norvale, a direct competitor of my current employer. I'm interested, but my contract has a six-month non-compete clause for competitors. I want to know if that's a dealbreaker before a call, without sending him my contract; I'm free Thursday or Friday afternoon.

An agency recruiter, Rachel, emailed about a finance manager role at a manufacturing company that sounds right for me. Before she'll submit me she wants names and numbers for three references, including my current manager, who doesn't know I'm looking. I can send my CV today and talk Thursday afternoon.

Recruiter Jess from Halden Analytics, where I was laid off in June, messaged me on LinkedIn about a senior analyst role on my old team. I'd consider going back, but only if it's a permanent, funded headcount and the base is at least my old $118k.

A recruiter, Erin, emailed about a senior product designer role at a home-goods retailer. Before any call she wants me to complete a design challenge that 'takes about 6 hours'. I'm interested, but I won't do a 6-hour task before knowing the range or talking to the team; after a first call I'd do an exercise of around 2 hours, or walk them through a project from my portfolio.
猎头赵先生在领英上联系我，推荐上海一家医疗器械公司的市场经理岗位。巧的是我上周五已经在他们官网直接投了这个岗位，HR还没回复。我不想被重复推荐，但这个猎头挺靠谱，想保持联系。

My old teammate Ellie moved into recruiting last year and just messaged me on WhatsApp about a product manager role at a retail startup she's hiring for. I'm happy in my job and not looking, but I don't want it to be weird: we get dinner every couple of months and the next one is Friday 9 October.

A recruiter, Daniel, messaged me on LinkedIn about a senior engineer role. I told him I'm not looking, and he replied asking if I could give him the names of strong engineers on my current team. I'm not comfortable doing that, but I'd consider engineering manager roles from next spring.

A recruiter, Grace, called about an office manager role and then emailed asking my age and whether I'm planning to have children soon, because 'the client likes to know'. I'm interested in the role but won't answer those. I'm free for a call Thursday afternoon.
我是自由职业的UI设计师，现在只接每周最多三天、全远程的工作。猎头刘女士在微信上联系我，推荐广州一家游戏公司的全职资深UI设计岗位，我对这家公司的项目挺感兴趣。下周二或周三下午我可以通电话。
猎头孙女士在微信上给我推荐杭州一家电商公司的运营总监岗位，我挺感兴趣。她发来一份“独家委托协议”让我签字，签了之后三个月内只能通过她们公司投递简历。我不想签独家，但可以接受每个岗位推荐前先经我同意。

Holly, an in-house recruiter at my own company, Brookfield Labs, messaged me on Slack about a senior analyst opening on the pricing team. I'm interested, but my manager Paul doesn't know I'd consider moving, and I'd want to tell him myself before anything formal. I'm free Tuesday 6 October after 2pm.

Fiz a entrevista final para a vaga de analista de dados sênior com a recrutadora Camila no dia 22 de setembro, e ela disse que me daria um retorno até sexta, 25 de setembro. Desde então, nenhuma notícia. Sou o Rafael e quero perguntar sem parecer desesperado.
猎头吴先生在微信上给我推荐一家做工业软件的创业公司，技术负责人岗位，base 40万，比我现在低，但他说有期权。我对岗位挺感兴趣，约电话前想先知道期权数量、行权价、归属期，以及公司最近一轮融资的情况。10月8日（周四）或10月9日（周五）晚上8点后我都可以通话。

A recruiter, Marco, messaged me on LinkedIn about a six-month contract-to-hire QA engineer role at Brindle Software. I'm in a permanent job with benefits now, so I'd only consider it at $75 an hour or more and with the conversion terms in writing. I'm free Wednesday 7 October after 4pm.

A recruiter, Ben, messaged me on LinkedIn about a head of payments role at Luckstone, an online betting company. The pay sounds great, but I don't want to work in gambling, and I don't want to lecture him about it. I'd be open to payments roles in fintech or e-commerce.

Une recruteuse, Mme Girard, m'a contactée sur LinkedIn pour un poste de cheffe de projet logistique, et le poste m'intéresse. Avant de me présenter au client, elle me demande d'expliquer le trou de trois ans sur mon CV : de 2022 à 2025, je me suis occupée de ma mère malade, je suis aujourd'hui disponible à temps plein et je ne veux pas entrer dans les détails. Je suis Claire Morel, disponible pour un appel mardi ou jeudi après 14 h.

A recruiter, Kevin, messaged me on LinkedIn calling me 'Sarah' (I'm Sara) about a senior Java developer role. I'm a technical writer, and it looks like a mass message. I'd be open to hearing about documentation or technical writing roles.
猎头李小姐推荐我去一家新能源公司做采购经理，二面过了，她帮我约了下周三的终面。昨天我接受了另一家公司的offer，不打算说是哪家。想告诉她退出这个流程，她一直挺用心的，以后还想保持联系。

My mother-in-law keeps telling me at every family dinner that I should quit my job and stay home with the baby. I'm going back to work in January and it's decided. She's helped a lot with the baby these first months and I like her otherwise.
每次过年回家，我姑都要当着一桌亲戚说我吃素没营养，还往我碗里夹肉。我吃素五年了，不想吵，也不想解释。她儿子今年刚参加完高考。

A coworker saw me eating a sandwich and started telling me all about his keto diet and how bread is 'basically poison'. Second time this week. His name's Nate, we sit near each other, and he just ran a demo for the Brightwell account.

I told my dad I'm leaving my accounting job in March to open a bakery. He's sent me three articles about small business failure rates. I told him I'd thought it through and he replied 'I'm only trying to help, I don't want you to lose everything.'
跟男朋友吵了一架，找闺蜜小雨吐槽了几句，她就一直劝我分手，说'这种男的你还留着干嘛'。我只是想发泄一下，并没打算分。

My retired neighbour Gary gives me lawn tips every time I'm out front on a Saturday (aerate, overseed, mow higher). He's sweet and proud of his tomatoes, and I'm happy with a low-effort lawn, dandelions and all; I just don't want a 20 minute lecture every weekend.

Mein Schwiegervater Klaus hat mir beim Sonntagsessen ungefragt gesagt, ich solle meinen Stromvertrag wechseln, ich würde viel zu viel zahlen. Ich habe abgewinkt, aber zu Hause nachgerechnet: Er hat recht, ich spare rund 280 Euro im Jahr, und ich habe heute gewechselt. Ich will ihm kurz schreiben.

My sister-in-law Brooke keeps texting me photos of barn venues and telling me we'll 'regret' having a courthouse wedding on Friday December 11 with 12 guests. It's booked, with a lunch afterwards, and we're happy with it. She sent another one this morning.

I'm five months pregnant. Brenda, a coworker from another team I barely know (her team just moved to the new floor), saw my latte in the office kitchen and said 'you really shouldn't be having caffeine, it's bad for the baby'. My midwife said one coffee a day is fine.

I posted a photo of my 8-month-old son napping in the carrier on Instagram and Kerry, a woman I went to school with, commented publicly that babies should only nap in a cot and I'm 'creating bad habits'. About 200 people follow me, mostly friends and family.
我今年63岁，刚退休，刚花8万块钱报了一个半年的老年大学游学团，去云南和欧洲。女儿知道后天天发消息劝我把钱存定期，说“这钱要留着养老”。钱是我自己攒的，退休金也够花。

My friend Dev made a lot of money on crypto this year and every time we meet he tells me I'm 'an idiot' for keeping my savings in a normal savings account. I've thought about it and I'm not interested. He means well, and we play five-a-side together on Thursdays.
宝宝乐乐8个月了，婆婆一直说该在米糊里加点糖、喝点果汁。我说医生建议先不加糖，当时语气有点冲，她就说“好好好，以后我什么都不说了”，这两天都不太理我。她带大了两个孩子。我不想改决定，但想缓和一下。

At my bouldering gym there's a regular, Phil, maybe 60, who shouts moves at me while I'm on the wall ('left foot higher! use the crimp!'). He's friendly, but I like working problems out myself, and it's happened three sessions in a row.
我养了12年的狗豆豆两周前走了。以前我常带它去江边散步。好朋友阿琪每次聊天都劝我赶紧再养一只，说“养只新的就不难受了”，还给我发领养信息。我现在完全没这个心思。

My skip-level manager Helen told me after a client meeting that I should 'smile more and soften my tone' on client calls. It's the second time she's said it. My client satisfaction scores are the highest on the team, and no client has raised a complaint with me.
在地铁上，我3岁的儿子哭闹着要下车，旁边一位不认识的阿姨一直说“孩子哭就给他颗糖嘛”“你这当妈的心也太狠了”。我想说一句让她别再说了，但不想在车厢里吵起来。

I'm halfway through chemo for breast cancer. My aunt Rosa keeps sending me articles saying juice cleanses cure cancer and that I should stop chemo. I love her, I'm sticking with my oncology team's plan, I'm too tired to debate it, and my next session is Tuesday Oct 6.

I own a small café. A regular, Martin, comes in most mornings and keeps telling me I should open on Sundays, add avocado toast and get on TikTok. He's lovely, always orders a flat white and spends good money here, but I've decided Sundays stay closed because it's my one day off, and I'm tired of hearing it every morning.
儿子上三年级。家长群里的刘妈妈私聊我好几次，说不报奥数班以后小升初要吃亏，还把她家报的班推给我。我们家商量过了，周末让孩子踢球，不报奥数。她人挺热心的，两家孩子也是好朋友。

I'm running my first marathon on Sunday Oct 18 and following the training plan from my running club's coach. My friend Julien, who's run three marathons, sends me WhatsApp tips almost every day about carb-loading, my taper and gels. It's kind, but it's making me second-guess the plan.
我拿驾照半年。老公每次坐副驾都一直指点“刹车早点”“变道打灯”，他越说我越紧张。这周日我们要开车回他爸妈家，我想今晚先跟他说好。

My brother Mark lives in Singapore and calls every Sunday with advice on how I should care for our mum, who has dementia and lives with me: a stricter routine, a different diet, a supplement he read about. I do the daily care, her doctor is happy with the plan we have, and last Sunday he said 'I'm just saying what anyone would see.'

Me mudo a Berlín el 15 de noviembre por un trabajo de ingeniera. Mi abuela Pilar me llama cada domingo para decirme que allí hace mucho frío, que estaré sola y que debería buscar algo en Valencia. La quiero muchísimo, ya está decidido, y su cocido es lo que más voy a echar de menos.

I've been going to the same hairdresser, Tasha, for four years. At every appointment she tells me I'd suit a short bob, and last time she said I'm 'hiding behind all that hair'. I'm keeping it long, and I'm texting her now to book a trim for Saturday 10 October.

I lead a team of 6 engineers. Kai joined three weeks ago and in every standup suggests we change the format, like going async or adding a demo slot. I like that he's engaged, but we're keeping standup as it is this quarter and the suggestions are eating the meeting. We have our 1:1 on Tuesday 6 October.

Our newborn daughter is named Wren, with Margaret, after my late grandmother, as her middle name, and it's all on the birth certificate. My mum keeps saying Wren is 'a bird, not a name' and that Margaret should be her first name, and she texted about it again this morning. I love my mum and want her close to the baby.

I moved to Lyon in June and I'm learning French. My colleague Mathieu corrects my grammar mid-sentence in every lunch conversation, in front of the others, and I lose my train of thought. He means well, and we already do a language exchange on Fridays, where I'd actually welcome his corrections.
我68岁，老伴走了两年。最近在公园跳广场舞认识了老李，常一起吃饭散步。儿子知道后天天打电话说“妈，您这把年纪了，别让人笑话”。我心里有数，日子过得挺开心。这周日儿子要带孙子回来吃饭，他最爱吃我做的红烧肉。
我是自由摄影师，专拍电商产品图，挺喜欢这个方向。合作两年的客户周总每次拍完都劝我改拍婚礼，说“那才赚钱”，今天又在微信上说了一遍。他下个月还有一批秋冬新品要拍。

I'm 17 and applying to art school, which my parents fully support. Every time I visit, my grandpa Walter tells me I should do engineering 'so you have a real job', even though he's the one who taught me to draw when I was little. I'm visiting him on Sunday and want to text him first.

I've used a wheelchair since a spinal injury eight years ago. Joan from my Thursday book club keeps telling me about a supplement and a 'healer' her cousin swears by so I could 'walk again', and last week she brought me a leaflet. I'm happy with my life and my care as they are, and this month we're reading a mystery Joan picked.
我养了只领养的狗叫可乐，召回还没练好，训犬师让我遛的时候一直牵绳。同楼的王大爷每次在小区碰到都说“老拴着太可怜了，解开让它跑跑”。王大爷人挺好，他家养了只柯基叫团团。

I told my oldest friend Sophie that my boyfriend Callum and I are moving in together next month, after four months of dating. She's said twice it's too soon, and when I told her we'd decided, she replied 'Fine, but don't come crying to me when it goes wrong.' I want to keep things warm, and we have brunch booked for Sunday.

At my cousin's engagement party, her fiancé's aunt Denise, who I'd met ten minutes earlier, told me I'd be 'so pretty if I lost a bit of weight' and recommended her diet group. She'd just told me she flew in from Denver for the party. I don't want to make a scene or discuss my body.

I have two job offers, one in Leeds and one in Bristol, and I have to decide by Friday. My older sister Nina texts me several times a day about why Bristol is obviously the right choice. I haven't decided yet and want to think it through on my own first, then talk it over with her on Thursday evening.
A guy from another department asked me to dinner. He's nice but I'm not interested, and we'll keep running into each other at the coffee machine.
相亲认识的男生，见了三次面，人挺好，聊天也挺舒服，但我没感觉。他约我周末去看展。
Après deux rendez-vous avec un gars rencontré sur une appli, je lui ai dit que je ne voulais pas continuer. Il m'envoie des messages pour avoir une autre chance.
My friend Theo from our Thursday climbing group texted last night that he has feelings for me. I don't feel the same, but I really like him as a friend and want to keep climbing together.
Been seeing Marcus for about 10 weeks. He's lovely but I'm just not feeling it. We have dinner booked Thursday and I don't want to do it there, so I'm calling him tonight. What do I actually say?

Matched with Sam on Hinge, we've been texting for five days, mostly about his sourdough disasters, and he just asked to meet for a drink Saturday. I've realised I'm not into it and we've never actually met.

Mi amiga Carla me presentó a su compañero de piso, Diego. El sábado hicimos una ruta de vermut por Malasaña y hoy me ha escrito para quedar otra vez. Es majo, pero no siento nada, y nos vamos a seguir viendo en los planes del grupo.
相亲认识的男生，见了两次面，上周我跟他说没感觉，不继续了。今天他发微信问：'能告诉我到底哪里不好吗？我可以改。'

Went on one date with Priya two weeks ago; she told me all about her Hanoi trip. When she asked about a second one I said 'maybe after my exams, things are crazy', which wasn't really true, I'm just not into it. Now she's texted that exams must be done and asked about Saturday.

Second date with Jonah last Friday and we kissed at the end of the night. Since then I've realised I'm not into him, and today he texted 'Friday was great, same time next week?'. I don't want the kiss to make my no confusing.

I've been seeing Leo casually for about six weeks, maybe eight dates, mostly Sunday mornings at the market. Last night he asked if we could be exclusive. I like him, but I don't see it becoming a relationship, and since he wants more I'd rather end it. We're meeting for coffee Saturday.
我妈的同事王阿姨给我介绍了个男生小刘，加了微信也见了一次面，他人很有礼貌，那天聊得也挺愉快，但我没感觉。现在王阿姨发微信问我：“觉得小刘怎么样？他对你印象挺好的。”我不想让王阿姨难做，也不想拖着。

A coworker, Ryan, asked me out in March and I said no. At last night's team drinks he asked again, saying 'maybe now you've got to know me better.' I'm still not interested and we sit two desks apart. I want to message him privately today.
在交友软件上认识一个男生，见过一次面。昨天我礼貌地跟他说没感觉、不继续了，他今天连发了好几条，说我“浪费他时间”“装什么清高”，越说越难听。

Went on a first date with Tom on Saturday: tacos, and he told me about his bike trip. It was fine but there was no spark. He's already texted that he bought two tickets for a gig on October 17 and wants to take me.

I've been on two dates with Ben. On the second one last night he told me he'd been laid off on Monday and seemed really low. I'd already decided I'm not feeling it, and now he's asked about Sunday. The timing makes me feel awful.

Sou personal trainer no Porto. Um aluno, o Rui, que treina comigo às terças e quintas há três meses, convidou-me ontem para jantar no fim do treino. Não tenho interesse, tenho como regra não sair com alunos e quero continuar a treiná-lo, por isso vou responder por mensagem.
同事介绍的男生，约会了四次，上周我跟他说没感觉，不继续了。他回复说理解，然后问：“那我们还能做朋友吗？”我对他没什么意见，但不想做常联系的朋友。

On holiday in Lisbon I met Sofia; we spent the last three evenings together and kissed on the final night. For me it was a lovely holiday thing, nothing more. She's back home in Madrid and just texted that she's looking at flights to visit me in London the weekend of Saturday November 14.

I'm Mia, a barista. Owen, a regular who comes in most mornings, left his number on a napkin with 'Dinner sometime?'. I'm not interested, but I'd like him to keep feeling welcome as a customer, and I'd rather text than say it across the counter.

Our daughters are best friends in Year 2, and their dad, Chris, asked me at pickup yesterday if I'd like to go for dinner sometime. I'm not interested, but the girls have a playdate at his house every other Saturday and I don't want that to stop. I'd rather text than answer at the school gate.

I'm Joan, 68, and I've been widowed for three years. Gerald from our Tuesday walking group left a card in my letterbox asking me to dinner. I'm not interested in dating anyone again, I'm happy as I am, but I enjoy the walks and want things to stay easy with him there.

Ich hatte vor drei Wochen zwei Dates mit Jonas, beide Abende waren nett, aber danach habe ich einfach nicht mehr geantwortet. Heute schreibt er: 'Hab ich was falsch gemacht? Würde es gern wissen.' Ich habe kein Interesse, will mich aber für das Schweigen entschuldigen.
大学同班的男生阿航昨晚在宿舍楼下跟我表白，还塞给我一副新耳机，大概1200块。我对他没有那种感觉，也不想收这么贵的礼物。我们俩在同一个小组做课程项目，要做到12月。
先週の合コンで知り合った佐藤さんから、LINEで「今度二人で食事に行きませんか」と誘われました。話は楽しかったけれど、恋愛感情はありません。「忙しくて」と濁すと期待させてしまいそうなので、失礼のないように、でもはっきり断りたいです。

My landlord, Martin, lives in the flat downstairs and texted last night asking if I'd like to go for dinner with him on Saturday. I'm not interested at all, and I'm a bit uneasy because my lease runs until next June. I want to say no clearly and keep things strictly about the flat.
我在游戏群里认识阿凯两年，一直只在网上组队，从没见过面。上周他表白，我已经明确拒绝了。今天他说买了周六来杭州的火车票，要“当面谈谈”，还说知道我在哪个学校。我不想见他。

I'm Ava. Last night Jake from my running club commented publicly under my race photo on Instagram: 'Great run! Dinner with me to celebrate? 😊'. About 30 club members follow me, and we run together every Wednesday. I'm not interested and want to say no privately without leaving his comment hanging.

I've been on three dates with Alex, the last one on Saturday. This morning he texted 'I think I'm falling for you, I've never felt like this so fast.' I like him as a person, but I'm not feeling a romantic connection and I want to end it kindly by text.

Nina from my Monday pottery class asked me out for a drink after class last night. I'm straight, so it's a no, but I like her, and we share a table every week until December. I'd rather text than make it a thing in class.

At my friend Kemal's birthday on Saturday, Daniel asked me to dinner and I said yes, for Thursday 8 October. I'd had a few drinks and got carried away, and now I've realised I'm not interested. I want to cancel by text well before Thursday.
上周六朋友生日聚会后，我和同学院的学长周航一起过了一夜。他今天发微信说想跟我正式在一起，问我周末要不要去看电影。那晚对我来说只是一次，我对他没有恋爱的感觉，以后在学院还会经常碰到。

Ollie, who I met at a board game café a month ago and have played at the same Sunday table with twice, messaged asking me on a date this Friday. I started seeing someone a few weeks ago, and even if I hadn't, I'm not interested in him that way. I'd like the Sunday games to stay normal.
我是部门主管。组里入职两个月、直接向我汇报的同事小何，昨晚发微信说对我有好感，约我周末单独去看电影。我对他没有那种感觉，而且我不会和自己的下属约会。想今天私下回他，让他别有负担，工作照常。
我是自由译者，给一家公司翻译产品手册，对接人陈经理合作了半年。上个项目刚交付，他微信约我周六单独吃饭，说“不谈工作”。我对他没有那种感觉，但下个月他们还有一批说明书要找我翻。

At my friend Hannah's wedding last Saturday I chatted with Sam, a friend of the groom, for most of the evening. He's just messaged on WhatsApp asking me out for dinner and said he's married but in an open marriage and his wife is fine with it. I'm not interested in dating someone who's married, open or not, and I'll probably see him at Hannah's parties.
Roommate Tyler hasn't paid his half of September's internet and electric, $87. I paid the whole thing on the 5th. We get along fine otherwise.
合租室友的男朋友阿杰最近一周要住四五天，早上洗澡要排队，水电费也涨了。我和室友关系还不错，不想弄僵。
I asked my roommate about the dishes piling up and she snapped 'I do loads, you just don't notice'. I don't want a fight, I just want a clean kitchen.

I live in a house with three others. I've just started early shifts at the hospital, my alarm is at 5am, and there's often music and gaming until 1am on weeknights. I want to raise it in our house group chat, not single anyone out.
我和两个室友合租，10月31日要搬走，押金是三个人一起交给房东的。想在群里说一声，顺便把房间交接和最后的水电费说清楚，别到时候扯皮。

My roommate Jess texted that my boyfriend keeps using her oat milk and leaving his shoes in the hallway, and it's 'getting a bit much'. She's right, he's over about four nights a week. I want to reply without getting defensive.

Comparto piso en Madrid con Irene y Paula. El invierno pasado Irene tenía la calefacción a 25 grados todo el día, incluso sin nadie en casa, y en enero la factura de gas llegó a 186 euros. Ya empieza el frío y quiero proponer algo en el grupo del piso sin señalarla.

My roommate Kayla owes me $214 for utilities, $102 for August and $112 for September. I reminded her in the house chat on Sept 8 and by text on Sept 20, and both times she said 'yeah will send'. We're both on the lease with Marsh Property. I want to be firm without blowing up the flat.

My flatmate Leo keeps eating my food from the fridge. Last week it was my leftover lasagne and half a block of cheese, this week my yoghurts. We get on well and it's probably just different habits, but it's adding up.

My flatmate Chloe's friend from Australia, Jess, has been sleeping on our living room sofa for 12 nights, and Chloe just mentioned she's staying 'another couple of weeks'. I work from home in the living room. Nobody asked me.

My roommate Sophie went through a bad breakup last month. Our rota gives her the bathroom this fortnight and it hasn't been cleaned, and the bins are the quickest job on it. I want to be kind and not add to her stress.
合租室友小周晚上回来经常不反锁大门，这周有两次早上起来发现门只是虚掩着。我们住一楼，我有点担心安全。我们俩平时关系挺好。

My housemate Priya just asked in our flat chat if she can adopt a rescue cat next month. I'm properly allergic to cats, streaming eyes within an hour. I like her and don't want to be the villain, and my lease runs until June.

My flatmate Ben just told me he's moving in with his girlfriend at the end of October. We're both on a joint lease with Parkside Lettings until April at £1,400 a month, £700 each, and I can't cover the full rent on my own.
合租室友阿凯在自己房间里抽烟，这周我发现他把房间的烟雾报警器拆下来放在桌上了。我们住六楼，我担心万一着火没人察觉。我们平时处得还行，他人不坏。

Am Samstag, 3. Oktober, zieht Mia in unsere Dreier-WG ein. Bei uns gibt es einen Putzplan am Kühlschrank, der jede Woche rotiert, und Strom plus Internet kosten zusammen 90 Euro im Monat, die wir durch drei teilen und am Monatsersten an Jonas überweisen. Ich will ihr das vorab freundlich schreiben, bevor es später Missverständnisse gibt.
我和小雨、阿杰三个人合租，只有一个卫生间。早上7点到8点大家都要用，我8点15分要出门赶地铁，这周已经连续三天差点迟到。想在合租群里提一下，大家关系都挺好的。

My housemate Callum has been letting out his room on a short-stay rental site while he travels for work. Three different strangers have stayed this month, and one left the front door unlocked overnight. We're on a joint tenancy with Oakley Lettings, and nobody asked me.

My dorm roommate Wei calls his family in Chengdu most nights from 11pm to midnight, which is their morning. I try to sleep by 11 because I have 8am labs, and we share one room. There's a study lounge down the hall that's open 24 hours, and he's really considerate otherwise.
我和小林、阿俊合租三个月了，卫生纸、洗洁精、垃圾袋一直是我顺手买的，三个月大概花了210元。我不想算旧账，只想以后有个办法，打算提议每人每月往群里转20元当公用基金。

Four of us share a house: Megan, Josh, Aled and me. I suggested in the house chat that we get a cleaner every other Friday for the kitchen and bathroom, £60 a visit, so £15 each. Megan and Josh are keen, but Aled replied that he can't stretch to it right now, and I don't want him to feel priced out or singled out.

Three of us, Priya, Tom and me, are signing a lease on Monday for a flat at £2,100 a month. Priya's room has the en-suite and is about twice the size of mine, and Tom's is in between. Splitting it £700 each feels off, so I want to suggest £800, £700 and £600 in our group chat before we sign.

I'm Muslim and keep halal. My new flatmate Ollie has started frying bacon in the shared frying pan and cooked pork sausages in the big pot I brought. He's friendly and probably has no idea. I'm going to buy my own frying pan and pot and keep them on the top shelf.

I share a flat with Dom. This week I found mouse droppings behind the toaster, and Dom tends to leave open cereal boxes and takeaway containers on the counter overnight. I've already bought sealed tubs for the dry food, and our tenancy is with Greenway Lettings.
合租室友小雅养了只猫叫团团，猫砂盆放在我们共用的卫生间里，她两三天才铲一次，卫生间一直有味道。我不讨厌猫，也挺喜欢小雅的，想提议每天铲一次，或者把猫砂盆挪到她房间的阳台。
合租室友佳佳上个月开始做直播卖衣服，每天晚上8点到11点在客厅播，架着灯和手机，我回家想在客厅吃饭、看电视都得躲回房间。我挺支持她搞副业的，想提议她一周在客厅播三晚，其他时间去她房间播。

My housemate Nadia just told our house chat she's throwing a party at ours on Saturday 10 October and has invited about 30 people. I'm fine with a party, but I'm on a 9am shift on Sunday and my bedroom is right next to the living room. I'd like the music down by 1am and guests kept out of the bedrooms.

Hamza, Elise and I moved out of our flat on Ash Road last week; we each put £500 into the £1,500 deposit. The landlord kept £240, £150 for oven cleaning and £90 for a stain on Hamza's bedroom carpet, and returned the other £1,260 to me as lead tenant. I think the oven is on all of us and the carpet is Hamza's, and I want to suggest the split in our group chat before transferring anything.

My younger brother Kieran moved into my two-bed flat in July after his breakup, 'just for a few weeks'. He started a full-time job in September and I'm happy for him to stay, but he hasn't paid towards anything; the bills come to about £180 a month. I'd like him to pay £60 a month, on the 1st, starting this month.
去年我和室友阿哲合买了一台冰箱，1600元，一人出800。他11月15日搬走，说让我转他800，冰箱就归我。冰箱用了一年，我想按一半算，转他400；或者他带走也行，我再自己买一台。
我在家远程办公，工作日每天上午10点有视频会，最近老是卡。合租室友小陈白天经常下载大游戏、看4K视频，宽带是100M，每月100元两人平摊。我想提议工作日9点到18点大文件下载放到晚上，或者升级到500M，每月多出的50元我出30、他出20。

Je partage un appart à Lyon avec Camille. Elle emprunte mes vêtements sans demander : mon manteau beige la semaine dernière, et ma robe verte est revenue avec une tache de vin. On s'entend bien et je veux bien lui prêter si elle me demande avant par message ; j'aimerais qu'elle fasse nettoyer la robe avant le samedi 10 octobre, je la porte à un mariage.
我和阿琳、大刘合租，家里只有一个卫生间。女朋友下周五从成都来看我，想在我房间住6晚，下周四走。我想先在合租群里问一下大家，这几天水电我多出50元，她早上用卫生间会错开大家7点到8点的高峰。

My housemate Ruth just tested positive for covid. Three of us share one bathroom and a small kitchen, and I'm visiting my 82-year-old gran on Sunday, so I really want to avoid catching it. I'd like to suggest Ruth uses the kitchen after 8pm once we're done, and I'm happy to do her grocery run and leave things outside her door.

My flatmate Arjun borrowed my stand mixer last weekend, and when I went to use it the bowl had a crack down the side. A replacement bowl costs £35. He hasn't mentioned it and might not have noticed; we get on well.
我和室友小吴共用一台洗衣机。她经常把洗好的衣服在洗衣机里放一整天才拿出来，这周有两次我想洗衣服都只能干等。我们关系挺好，我想提议洗完两小时内拿出来，超过了另一个人可以帮忙放进对方门口的洗衣篮，我可以买两个洗衣篮。

I run a small bakery. A regular customer asked if I can make a 4-tier wedding cake for 150 people. I only have one oven and do 2-tier max. She's lovely and I don't want to lose her. I could do a 2-tier display cake plus sheet cakes in the same flavour to serve 150, or refer her to Marisol at Crumb & Co, who does big tiered cakes.

Hago bolsos de cuero a mano en Valencia y los vendo por Instagram. Carla, una cuenta con 8.000 seguidoras, me pide un bolso de 120 euros gratis a cambio de una publicación. Cada bolso me lleva un día entero de trabajo; no regalo producto por publicaciones, pero puedo dejárselo con un 20% de descuento y darle un código del 10% para sus seguidoras.

Customer of my SaaS app, Martin, wants his team of five to share his single-user login. I said no, since each seat is one person, and offered our Team plan for five at $60 a month with the rest of this month free. He replied saying he'll leave a 1-star review everywhere.
我在杭州开民宿。有位客人10月3日周六入住，想上午十点就进房间，但前一组客人十二点才退房，保洁要两个小时。她是回头客，不想让她扫兴。最早下午两点能进房，可以先寄存行李，房间好了我微信通知她，前一组提前退房也会告诉她。

I own a small climbing gym. Hannah, a member for 6 years, asked to freeze her membership for 3 months while she recovers from shoulder surgery. Our max freeze is 1 month because memberships are capped and there's a waitlist, but after six years I've decided to make an exception: frozen 1 October to 31 December at no charge.

Sou personal trainer. Uma aluna, a Renata, pediu para trazer uma amiga às duas aulas particulares por semana, sem custo extra. Não dá: a aula particular é montada para uma pessoa, e com duas eu não consigo corrigir a execução de cada uma com segurança. Tenho aula em dupla às quartas às 19h, por R$ 70 por pessoa, e posso dar uma aula experimental grátis para a amiga.

I sell hand-poured candles online. A customer, Olivia, emailed that her code FALL15 didn't work. It expired Sunday night (Sept 27), she placed the $64 order at full price today anyway, and she's asking if I can still apply the 15%. Her parcel ships Thursday and I can add a free wick trimmer, and my next newsletter code goes out on Thursday 15 October.

I sell leather wallets on Etsy. A customer, Derek, asked me to emboss his initials, D.M.K., on the bifold he bought and I told him I don't personalise that model. He just sent a screenshot of my own listing saying 'personalisation available'. It's old text I forgot to update, and I've now corrected it. I'll do the embossing at no charge. The wallet was due to ship Friday 2 October; embossing would push that to Monday 5 October.
我们做一款给小餐馆用的收银小程序。老客户李老板开了三家面馆，要我们加一个按门店分开的会员积分功能。今年开发全年都排在外卖平台对接上，而且这个功能只有很少客户需要，不打算做。现在可以给三家店各设一个会员标签、按标签导出积分明细，我明天下午能远程帮他设置，大概20分钟。

I own a tattoo studio in Bristol. A mum messaged asking if we'll do her daughter's first tattoo, a small moon on the wrist, and says she'll sign consent. The daughter is 17 and turns 18 on November 20. UK law doesn't allow tattooing under-18s, even with a parent's consent. We can design it with her now and book her in for the day after her birthday.
我在南京做手作蛋糕，只送主城区15公里以内。有位客人订了10月3日（周六）的生日蛋糕，想让我送到溧水，大概60公里。来回要三个小时，我一个人做一个人送，那天还有别的单。店里有保温箱和冰袋，她可以当天下午2点后到店自提，或者约个跑腿，我打包好交给师傅。
我做上门家电清洗，空调清洗一台150元。有位客户家里5台，要我打到100一台，说别家就这个价。我们每台都拆面板、高压冲洗蒸发器，一台要四十分钟左右，100一台我连人工都不够。5台一起我最多能给到每台130。

I run a small auto body shop. A repeat customer, Greg, paid $850 for a bumper repair and asked me to write $1,200 on the invoice so his insurance pays out more. He's a nice guy and I don't want to lose him. I can have a fully itemised invoice with parts, labour hours and before-and-after photos ready tomorrow afternoon.
我在成都开了个小摄影工作室，婚纱照套餐是精修60张。客人刘小姐拍完后想要全部1,200张原片，说“反正都是拍我的”。我们一直不给全部原片，套餐外加精修每张30元，可以把全部照片做成带小水印的预览图给她挑。

I run a solo dog-walking business. Mrs. Ferreira, a client for two years, asked me to add her new rescue, Bruno, to her lab Daisy's group walks. At our meet-and-greet on Monday Bruno lunged at two other dogs, and I don't take reactive dogs in groups. My solo 30-minute walks are $22, and I'd try a group intro later if he gets more comfortable.

I sell hand-knit baby blankets from home in Ohio, $45 each, and only ship within the US. A customer, Megan, asked in a public comment under my latest post on my shop account whether I'll ship to Australia, and a few other people liked her comment. Shipping one blanket there would cost about $58; I'm happy to ship gift-wrapped to someone in the US for her.

I run a small coffee roastery supplying cafés. A new client, Luca at Stanza Café, is taking 20kg a week from his first delivery on Monday 5 October and asked for 60-day payment terms. We do 14 days for everyone because we pay our green-bean importers upfront. I'm happy to give him 30 days on his first two orders while he opens.
我开了一家小钢琴教室。学生家长陈妈妈想要另一位学生乐乐妈妈的手机号，说两个孩子都是周六上午的课，想约着拼车接送。我们从不把家长的联系方式给别人，但可以把她的微信转告乐乐妈妈。
我在家开美甲工作室，单色一套99元，一个人做，一套要两个小时。大学室友小敏说“咱俩谁跟谁”，想以后每个月来免费做一次。免费做不了，但我愿意给她老朋友价79元，她生日那个月请她做一套。

I'm a freelance illustrator. Imogen at Wren & Co, a tea shop that's commissioned three packaging designs from me this year, asked me to agree not to work for any other tea brand for two years. Tea brands are about 40% of my work. I'd be willing to not work for other tea shops in Leeds for 12 months, and I never reuse a client's designs anyway.

I run a small bakery. A mum, Rachel, wants a birthday cake for her son Max, who's turning 5 and has a severe peanut allergy, and asked me to promise it will be completely nut-free. We bake with peanuts and almonds in the same kitchen, so I can't rule out traces. Little Oak Bakes across town is a dedicated nut-free bakery.

I'm Lena, a private English tutor. Mr. Okafor, whose son Daniel I've tutored for a year, asked me to write Daniel's college personal statement, due October 15, and offered an extra $300. I won't write it, but I can do two 90-minute coaching sessions on it at my usual $60 an hour, and I'm free Saturday and Tuesday evenings.
我在小红书卖古着，每件只有一件。买家小陈看中一件380元的羊毛大衣，问能不能不付定金帮她留两周，等发工资再买。以前这样留过几次，最后对方都没买，别人也错过了。我可以免费留到这周日晚上，或者付50元定金留两周，定金抵货款。

I run a two-chair hair salon that closes at 7pm. Joanne, a client for years, asked to come in at 6pm on Friday 9 October for a full colour, which takes about two and a half hours, because she has a wedding at 3pm on Saturday. My stylist Bea leaves at 7 to collect her kids; I could open at 8am on Saturday, or fit her in at 9am on Friday.

I run a 40-cover bistro. Laura has booked a table for 14 on Saturday 10 October and asked if we can do 14 separate bills. On Saturday nights we don't split bills for tables over 8, because splitting 14 ways ties up our only till for about 20 minutes while other tables wait; we can split one bill evenly on the card machine, or do our group menu at £38 a head.
京都で着物レンタル店をやっています。10月10日（土）にご予約の山本さまから、夜に料亭で食事があるので着物を翌日返却にできないかとメールが来ました。当店は当日18時返却で、夜のうちにお手入れして翌朝のお客様にお出ししているため翌日返却はできませんが、1,000円で19時30分まで延長はできます。

Je tiens un petit atelier de réparation de vélos à Nantes. Un client, M. Lefèvre, veut que je monte sur son vélo de route des freins qu'il a achetés en ligne. Je ne monte pas de pièces apportées par les clients, parce que je ne peux pas garantir leur compatibilité ni leur qualité, mais je peux lui commander des freins compatibles pour 140 € pose comprise, livrés le jeudi 8 octobre.

I run a small flower shop, Petal & Stem. A man called Kieran wants us to deliver a dozen roses with an unsigned card to a woman at her workplace, and when I asked, he said she has blocked him everywhere since they broke up and he just wants her to know he's thinking of her. We don't deliver to someone who has cut off contact with the sender, and he's asking me to make an exception.
我在昆明开私房菜馆。熟客老周自己上山采了一袋野生菌，想让我们帮他加工，周六晚上和朋友一桌吃。我们只做从固定供应商进的、能确认品种的菌子，客人自带的没法确认，万一混进毒菌就出大事。周六我们有新到的牛肝菌，菜单价一份98元。

I own a small café with one big six-seat table. A regular, Sam, who works remotely, DM'd on Instagram asking if he can reserve that table every weekday from 9 to 5 for himself and two colleagues. We don't reserve tables during the day because the big table is where groups sit at lunch; they're welcome at it any morning until 11:30, and the three window seats by the sockets are free all day.

Ich bin Goldschmiedin in Hamburg. Frau Brandt hat auf Instagram den Verlobungsring gesehen, den ich für ein anderes Paar gemacht habe, und möchte eine genaue Kopie. Jedem Paar verspreche ich ein Einzelstück, aber ich kann ihr einen Ring im selben Stil entwerfen, mit gewellter Fassung und Saphir, und ein kostenloses Entwurfsgespräch von 30 Minuten am Dienstag, 6. Oktober, oder Donnerstag, 8. Oktober, anbieten.
我在网上开手工皂小店。桂花款去年停产了：原来的桂花精油供应商停货，换了几家香味都不稳定。老顾客王姐问能不能再做20块桂花皂送同事。现在香味最接近的是茉莉款，38元一块，我可以随单送她两块小样先闻闻。

I'm a one-person shop selling refurbished laptops online. A buyer, Kwame, wants a $480 laptop and asked me to ship it first so he can pay when it arrives, because a seller scammed him before. I only ship after payment through my shop's checkout, since one unpaid laptop would wipe out a month's profit; every laptop has my 30-day return for a full refund, and buyers can also try one and pay in person at my workshop on Saturday mornings.

I run a small yoga studio, Saltmarsh Yoga. A member, Jade, who's building a YouTube channel, asked if she can film herself during our Thursday 7pm class. We don't allow filming in group classes because the other students haven't agreed to be on camera; she can film in the empty studio for 15 minutes after the class at no charge, or book a private session at £45 and film the whole hour.
我开儿童游泳馆，独立小班课要求满4岁，因为小班是一个教练带6个孩子，家长不下水。有位家长想让3岁半的女儿进小班，因为她的好朋友在那个班。我们有周六上午10点的亲子课，每节120元，家长陪着下水；她明年3月满4岁，到时候我可以优先给她留小班名额。

I run a small tearoom, The Copper Kettle. A customer, Nadia, messaged asking if she can bring her dog, Pepper, inside on Sunday for her mum's birthday afternoon tea for four. We don't have dogs inside because our kitchen is open to the room and some of our regulars are allergic, but our covered garden terrace has heaters, takes dogs, and I can reserve the big table there for 3pm.

I'm a web developer. Client Karen wants the new booking feature live by Monday for a promo. It's a 7-day job and I have another launch due Thursday; I could have a simple booking request form that emails her each request live by Monday, and the full calendar booking by Wednesday 21 October.
我做品牌logo设计，合同里两轮修改已经用完了，客户王总又要改颜色和字体。不想无限免费改下去：这次我愿意免费改一次，之后每轮按800元收。

Client says adding a blog section is 'a tiny change, the last agency threw that stuff in.' I quoted $1,800 for it: a new template, the CMS setup and moving their 40 existing posts across, about five days of work. The agreed build also includes a careers page.

I run social media for a restaurant group on a $1,500/month retainer that covers 12 posts a month. The owner, Luca, now wants me to also answer all their Instagram DMs and Google reviews every day. I'd add community management for $600 a month from November, or drop to 8 posts and cover the inbox within the $1,500.

I'm a freelance photographer. A friend of a friend, Priya, wants product photos for her candle shop and asked for 'mates rates', half my usual $900 day rate, since we know people in common. I could offer a half day for $500 covering her 10 bestsellers on a white background.

I'm Meera, and I've done bookkeeping for a small landscaping company for 18 months at $600 a month. The owner, Gary, has paid late five of the last six months, August's invoice is still unpaid, and he keeps adding payroll questions that aren't in our agreement. I want to end it, and I know a bookkeeper, Dana Whitfield, who does bookkeeping and payroll together.
朋友小周介绍了一个做高端茶叶的客户林总，想让我做他们的抖音短视频代运营。我专做小红书图文，短视频不擅长，不想硬接。我认识两位专做茶饮和食品短视频的朋友。

I'm a freelance bookkeeper for a dental practice, $800 a month for the monthly books. The practice manager, Lisa, messaged 'quick favour, can you pull together a cash flow forecast for our bank meeting next Wednesday?' A proper 12-month forecast is a good six hours of work, which I'd bill at $450.

I'm a freelance web developer on a $2,000/month maintenance retainer with an online furniture store. The owner, Mark, has started texting me at 10pm and on Sundays and expects a reply within the hour. Our agreement says support is weekdays 9 to 6; for real emergencies he can call me on 555-0134, and I'd add weekend cover for Black Friday at $300 a weekend.
我做插画，给一家茶饮品牌画了一套包装插画，报价12000元，合同写的是交付PNG和PDF成品，不含源文件。现在对方市场部的陈经理说要AI和PSD源文件，方便他们以后自己改。源文件我按3600元另收，含分层整理和修改的商用授权，付款后两个工作日内交付。
フリーランスで英日の技術翻訳をしている山本です。見込み客の医療機器メーカーの鈴木さんから、取扱説明書10ページを無料でトライアル翻訳してほしいと言われました。通常は1ページ4,000円、無料トライアルは1ページ（約300語）までで、10ページなら半額の2万円の有償トライアルにして、本発注時に全額差し引くつもりです。

I'm Nina, a freelance brand designer in final review of the approved logo route for a coffee chain. The contract, signed 12 May, covers two concept routes and two revision rounds, both used. Their new CMO, Derek, joined today's final call with my contact, Sarah, and wants a completely new direction; I'd quote a third route at $3,200, about three weeks, or finish now and revisit the look in the new year.
我做室内设计，新客户赵先生看完方案很满意，说“合同走流程要两周，你先把施工图画起来，别耽误工期”。我们约定的是签约并付30%定金后才开工，设计费总价45000元。
我是独立摄影师。一个新客户何老板想拍一组餐厅宣传照，要我先免费拍一版“看看效果”，满意了再谈价格，还说尾款要等宣传效果出来再付。聊了两次，感觉不对劲，想直接推掉。

Je suis Léa, rédactrice freelance : une agence immobilière lyonnaise me paie 900 € par mois pour 4 articles de blog. Hier au téléphone, leur directeur, M. Garnier, m'a demandé « en passant » d'écrire aussi leur newsletter mensuelle ; je lui ai seulement dit que je lui répondrais par écrit. Je facturerais 250 € par newsletter.

I'm a developer at a small web agency. The client's product lead, Jordan, messaged me directly in our shared Slack asking me to 'just quickly add' a second payment provider to checkout this sprint. It's not in the signed statement of work, and only our account manager, Beth, can quote or approve changes.
我做一对一英语家教，每周六上午给初三的乐乐上课，一小时300元。家长张妈妈说：“反正你都来了，顺便把他妹妹也带上，一起上。”妹妹才五年级，两个孩子程度差太多，一起上两边都顾不好；我可以周六下午给妹妹单独排一小时，也是300元。

I'm a wedding photographer. My contract with Emma and James covers 8 hours ending at 10pm, with extra time at £200 an hour. At 9:40pm the bride's mother, Susan, asked me to stay until midnight for the after-party, and I'm answering her in person.

I'm a freelance web developer building an online shop for Hana's skincare brand, launching Friday Oct 16. She asked me to 'just write the privacy policy and terms, you can copy them from another site'. That's not in our scope and I'm not qualified to write legal text; I'm happy to add pages she provides at no extra cost if I get the text by Monday Oct 12.

I'm a commercial photographer. Last month I shot the new menu for a bistro, Fig & Thistle, for $1,800, and our contract licenses the photos for their website and social media only. The owner, Claire, now wants to use three of the shots on a billboard and bus shelters for six months. My extended licence for that would be $950.
我是自由开发者，给一家连锁洗衣店做会员小程序，合同写的是远程开发、每周五线上同步一次。老板吴总现在要我每周二、周四去他们公司当面开会，单程一个半小时。如果要上门，我想按每次800元收费。

I manage online ads for a yoga studio owner, Bea, for $600 a month, and our agreement says the ad spend is paid directly from her own account. She wants to double next month's budget to $5,000 and has asked me to put it on my card and invoice her after, because her card limit is too low. She could add another card or payment method to the ad account, or start at her current limit.

I'm a freelance copywriter writing 10 product pages for Noah's outdoor gear shop at $250 a page, $2,500 total, per our 3 September contract, and I've delivered 4. Noah just emailed that his budget was cut and asked if I can finish all 10 for $1,800. I'd rather scale the work than the rate.
我是自由开发者，给一家烘焙店做的官网7月上线，合同约定上线后30天内免费修bug，之后的修改按每小时300元收费。现在店长孙姐说网站“有点小问题”，要把首页轮播图换成视频、再加一个预约页面。这两项都不是bug，大概要6小时。

I'm a freelance SEO consultant on a six-month contract with an online furniture shop, $1,200 a month for audits and monthly reports, ending in December. Their marketing lead, Owen, just hired a junior, Tess, and asked me to 'show her the ropes' in weekly calls so she can take over SEO when I finish. Training isn't in the contract; I'd quote a four-session handover programme for $800.

I'm a freelance UX designer. Phase one of a startup's app is done and paid; phase two is quoted at $6,000. The founder, Raj, now asks if I'd take 0.5% equity instead of cash for phase two because their funding round is delayed. I only work for cash, but I could do a smaller $3,000 phase covering just the onboarding flow, or start the full phase once the round closes.
我是自由平面设计师，在给一家茶馆设计宣传册，合同只包括这本宣传册，报价6000元。老板娘许姐说“顺便把菜单也改改，就是去年别人做的那份，改几个地方就行”，但我还没看过原文件，不知道是小改还是要重做。
我是自由网页设计师，给一家瑜伽馆做官网。合同约定客户9月14日前交齐文案和照片，10月15日上线。馆主孙老师上周才交齐，晚了两周，现在还是要10月15日（周四）上线。按正常排期最早10月29日（周四）能上线；如果非要15日，我可以先上首页、课程表和联系页三个页面，其余29日补齐。

I'm a freelance copywriter on a $900/month retainer with a dental clinic, covering four blog posts a month. The owner, Dr. Hale, asked me to write 20 five-star Google reviews under made-up patient names to 'balance out' two bad ones. I won't do that, but I could write a short follow-up email and a front-desk card asking real patients for reviews, as a one-off $150 add-on.

I'm a freelance app developer building the iOS app for Mara's dog-walking startup, launching Thursday 22 October; the contract covers iOS only. Mara just asked if I could 'do the Android version too while we're at it' before launch. I'd quote Android as a phase two: $9,000, about six weeks, starting Monday 2 November.

I'm a freelance video editor. Halden Outdoor has been my biggest client for three years, about 40% of my income, on a $2,400 monthly retainer for four edited videos. Their marketing director, Priya, now wants four vertical social cutdowns of every video, 16 a month, at no extra cost, and added 'if that's a problem we may need to look at other editors.' I'd charge $75 per cutdown, or do three full videos plus four cutdowns of each within the $2,400.

I'm Hana, a freelance designer. My contract with Brightfield Books for their autumn catalogue covers print-ready files only, and I delivered them on Monday. Their marketing lead, Tom, now asks me to 'just handle the printer': get quotes, check the proofs and sort delivery. I'd do print management for a flat $350, or if they run it themselves, the printer can email me technical questions about the files.

Soy Lucía, fotógrafa de bodas en Sevilla. Mi contrato con Marta y Álvaro para su boda del sábado 17 de octubre es solo de fotografía, y ahora me piden que grabe también un vídeo corto para redes «ya que estás ahí». No hago vídeo, y grabar a la vez empeoraría las fotos; puedo preparar un montaje de 60 segundos con las fotos por 150 €, o pasarles el contacto de Marcos, un videógrafo con quien trabajo.
我是自由文案，给一家茶饮品牌写秋季新品推文，合同约定10月12日（周一）交稿，稿费3000元。今天国庆假期，客户市场部的周经理发微信要求提前到10月8日（周四）交，还说“放假你反正有空”。我1号到5号陪家人回老家，6号、7号可以赶稿，加急费按原价的50%算，即1500元。

I'm Ruth, a freelance grant writer. Helen, director of a small food bank, wants me to write a £40,000 application to the Larkspur Fund and pay my £1,200 fee only if the grant is awarded. I don't work on success fees because the funder's decision is out of my hands, but I could review and edit a draft her team writes for £600.

I'm Gareth, a self-employed decorator. My fixed quote to the Okafors is £1,450 to paint their living room and hallway, starting Monday. Mrs Okafor asked if I could 'just do the landing and stairs too while the dust sheets are down'; that's about two extra days, which I'd price at £520, and I could carry straight on and finish by Thursday 15 October.
My manager Jordan messages me on the work chat on weekends with 'quick questions'. I want to stop answering until Monday without it hurting my review. A phone call for a real emergency is fine.
我妈每周六来我家帮忙，每次都把我的衣柜和厨房重新整理一遍，上周还扔了我囤的一些东西，我找了好几天。我很欢迎她每周来，但柜子和厨房我想自己管。以后她来，我想跟她一起去买菜做饭。

Told my best friend I can't do 1am phone calls about her ex anymore and offered to call her on Saturday mornings instead. She replied 'wow, I thought you were my best friend, after everything I've done for you.'

Ma petite sœur Léa me demande de l'argent pour la troisième fois cette année, cette fois 400 euros pour son loyer. Je l'aime mais je ne veux plus prêter, les deux premières fois ne sont jamais revenues. Je suis prête à regarder son budget avec elle ce week-end.

My mother-in-law, Linda, has a spare key and lets herself into our house 'just to drop things off', sometimes while we're still in bed. My husband agrees it has to stop. From now on we'll keep the door latched from the inside when we're home; she can text first or leave things on the porch bench, and she stays our emergency key holder. I want to text her kindly.
我是儿科医生。表嫂经常半夜在微信上发孩子的照片问我该吃什么药，这周已经问了三次。我想以后不在微信上看病了，但不想得罪亲戚。不知道去哪家医院、挂哪个号，我还是愿意帮她推荐。

My boyfriend Josh and I moved in together in August. He wants to do something together every single evening and I'm running on empty; I want to keep Mondays and Wednesdays for myself. Nothing is wrong between us.

My dad keeps posting photos of my kids, 4 and 7, on his public social media profile, sometimes with their school uniform showing. He gets them from the photos I share in our family group chat. I've mentioned it twice casually and nothing changed. We've decided we don't want their photos online, so I'll stop posting them in the group and send them to him directly. I want him to take down the ones already up.
表弟小凯在北京实习，这半年已经来我家住了三次，每次一住就是一个多星期。我家一室一厅，我和女朋友住，很不方便。他说下个月还要来。我想以后不留他过夜，可以帮他在附近找家快捷酒店，第一天请他吃烤鸭。

Two weeks ago I told my mom I'm not hosting Christmas this year, after doing it five years running. Now my brother Mark has texted: 'Mom's really hurt, would it kill you to host one more time?' I'll still be there all day wherever it's held, bring dessert and help plan the menu.
我今年刚退休。女儿女婿都上班，想让我从下个月开始周一到周五全天去她家带两岁的外孙小满。我愿意帮忙，但天天全天带实在吃不消，我还报了老年大学周二周四的书法课。我能每周一、三、五白天带，周末也可以送来，周二周四可以一起看看托班或钟点工。

A senior colleague, Greg, greets me with a hug most mornings and sometimes puts his hand on my shoulder in meetings. It feels friendly, not creepy, but I don't like being touched at work. I want to say something that sticks without making it a big deal; a wave or a handshake is fine with me.

My ex-husband Dan and I share custody of our daughter Mia, who's 9. Lately he texts me late at night about his new job, his dating life and 'how we used to be'. I want to stay friendly for Mia's sake but only reply about her: school, pickups, health and plans, and he can call any time if something about her is urgent.
我刚入职三个月，下周五部门聚餐。上次聚餐领导一桌桌劝酒，说“不喝就是不给面子”，我喝多了，第二天很难受。以后我不想喝酒了，想提前私下跟直属领导王姐说一声。

Minha amiga Carla sempre chega uns 40 minutos atrasada, e às vezes desmarca meia hora antes. No último sábado fiquei sozinha no restaurante esperando por 50 minutos. Gosto muito dela e quero continuar saindo com ela. Decidi que, se ela atrasar mais de 20 minutos sem avisar, eu peço e começo sem ela, ou vou embora.

My coworker Tanya comments on my lunch almost every day ('salad again?', 'you've lost so much weight, what's your secret?'), sometimes in front of others. I don't want to discuss my food or my body at work at all. We otherwise get on well, and she's in the middle of renovating her kitchen.

I'm a graphic designer. My friend Rob keeps asking for 'quick' free logo tweaks for his side business, and this is the fourth time this year. I want to keep the friendship, but from now on I'll quote for design work, and I'm happy to give him 20% off my usual rate.
我是药剂师。舅舅每天在家族微信群里转发养生文章，还经常@我问“专家说的”对不对。上次我指出一篇是谣言，他在群里说我“读了几年书就瞧不起长辈”。我不想再在群里争了，但他真有用药问题我还是愿意帮。
大学同学小林做保健品代理半年了，每周都私信给我推产品，上周又把我拉进了她的卖货群。我之前买过一次398元的，其实我本来就不吃保健品，以后不想再买了，但还想跟她做朋友，周末约她吃饭。那个卖货群我打算退了。

I'm a freelance bookkeeper. My client Sandra, who owns a hair salon, has started sending WhatsApp voice notes at 10 or 11pm and then again at 7am asking if I've seen them. I like working with her, and starting Monday 5 October I'm only answering client messages weekdays 9am to 5pm, within one working day.
我正在办离婚，家里只告诉了我姐。结果她转头就跟我妈和小姨都说了，上周末小姨打电话来问我房子怎么分。我姐是我最亲的人，我不想跟她闹翻，但以后这件事告诉谁、说多少，我想自己决定，亲戚那边我自己去说。
好朋友阿雯做探店博主，每次约我吃饭都会拍我，从来不问。上周她把我素颜吃饭的视频发了出去，已经两万播放。我还想跟她一起探店，但不想再出现在她的视频里，也想让她把那条里有我的部分删掉。
男朋友阿哲跟我在一起一年了，最近总趁我洗澡翻我手机里的微信聊天记录，昨天还追问我跟同事小王聊了什么。我没做任何对不起他的事，也不想分手，但不想再被翻手机。我已经把手机换了新密码。

My son Liam is 26 and lives across town. He keeps borrowing my car at short notice, three times last month, and twice it came back nearly empty. I need it on weekdays for work. From now on I'll lend it on Sundays if he asks by Friday, and I want it back with a full tank.

At our Sunday family dinners my dad keeps making jokes about my wife Ana's Brazilian accent, imitating how she says certain words. Ana laughs it off at the table but has told me privately it hurts. I've decided that if it happens again, we'll leave early, and I want to tell him by text before this Sunday.
婆婆住在老家，每天晚上8点准时打微信视频要看孙子豆豆，可豆豆3岁，8点正是洗澡准备睡觉的时候，一视频就兴奋到十点才睡。老公也同意要改。我打算以后每周三、周六晚上7点主动打给她，其他晚上8点后不接视频，白天给她发照片和小视频。

My family WhatsApp group (my parents, my two sisters and their partners) sends 80 or more messages a day, and my sister Kate gets annoyed when I don't reply fast. I'm a nurse on 12-hour shifts. From now on I'm muting the group on shift days and catching up in the evening; if something's urgent, they can call me.

Since I moved back to my home town in August, my mum asks me every week to come to church with her on Sundays, and she leaves church leaflets in my car. I'm not religious and I'm not going to go weekly. I'm happy to go to the Christmas Eve service with her, and to keep our Sunday lunches after church.

My dad Ray picks up my kids, 6 and 9, from school on Fridays and drives them to his place. Last Friday I smelled alcohol on him when he dropped them back, and it happened once before in July. I love him and want the kids to keep seeing him, so from now on I'll do the school run myself and he's welcome at ours for Friday tea with them.
我今年开始看心理咨询，每两周一次，状态在慢慢变好。我妈每次打电话都追问咨询师跟我聊了什么，上周还说要找咨询师的电话亲自问问。我不想跟她说咨询的内容，也不会给她咨询师的电话，但愿意跟她聊我最近的生活。这周日我回家吃饭。

Mein Freund Jonas erzählt seiner Mutter Heike von unseren Streits, und beim Sonntagskaffee spricht sie mich dann darauf an, zuletzt auf unseren Streit wegen des Urlaubs. Ich liebe ihn und mag Heike, aber über unsere Beziehung will ich mit ihr nicht mehr reden. Wenn ihn etwas stört, möchte ich es zuerst von ihm hören.

I'm 22 and in my final year at uni in another city. My mum has had my location shared to her phone since I was 16, and she texts when she sees me somewhere unexpected, like 'why are you at a bar on a Tuesday?'. I'm turning location sharing off this weekend; I'll text her whenever I'm travelling home, and we'll keep our Sunday calls.

I've been sober for eight months. My brother Sam hosts a family barbecue next Saturday, and at the last two he kept offering me a beer, saying 'just one won't hurt'. I love him and want to go; I'll bring my own drinks, and if the offers keep coming I'll head home early.

My uncle Pete sends me political videos on WhatsApp most days and starts debates about the election at family dinners. We vote differently and I'm tired of arguing. From now on I won't reply to political messages or discuss politics at dinner, but I love fishing with him and we've got a trip planned for Saturday 17 October.

Since my breakup with Tom in June, my best friend Aisha keeps telling me news about him and sending me screenshots of his posts with his new girlfriend. I asked her lightly once to stop and it's still happening. From now on I won't open anything about Tom and I'll change the subject if he comes up, but I love our Friday wine nights.

Hago voluntariado en el banco de alimentos de mi barrio los sábados por la mañana. La coordinadora, Marta, me pide casi cada semana que cubra turnos extra entre semana, y este mes ya he dicho que sí cuatro veces aunque trabajo a jornada completa. Quiero seguir con mis sábados y dejar de cubrir turnos entre semana; puedo ofrecerme a formar a los voluntarios nuevos un sábado al mes.

I just got into a PhD program in Edinburgh, starting in January, so I'm moving from Toronto. My best friend Zoe and I have lived 10 minutes apart for 8 years. I'm thrilled, and already sad to leave her. I want to tell her before I post anything.
我和老公阿杰决定离婚了，已经和平协商好，我还好，就是需要点时间适应。想在大学室友的四人群里说一声，免得她们以后问起尴尬，但不想被追问细节。
I'm pregnant (due in April) and want to tell my close friend Hana, who's been doing IVF for two years. I don't want her to find out from the group chat, where I'll share it next week.

I'm leaving my accounting job at Hartwell & Finch on Oct 30 to run my bakery full time; I've saved eight months of expenses and my Saturday market stall already covers its costs. My parents sacrificed a lot for my degree and they'll worry. We have our usual call Sunday but I want to text first so it's not an ambush.
我是产品经理，昨天和组里大概三分之一的人一起被裁了。我还行，就是有点懵，下周开始找新工作。想在五个好朋友的微信群里说一声，最想要的是大家帮我留意合适的产品岗位，不需要安慰。

I've been diagnosed with breast cancer, caught early. Surgery is Oct 14 and I'll be off about six weeks, with Rohan covering my projects. My manager knows; I want to email my team of 5 myself but I don't want lots of questions.

Last week I told my close friends' group chat that I'd been laid off. Most were lovely, but Jake replied 'lol enjoy the paid vacation, wish that was me'. It stung because I'm genuinely worried about money. He's a good friend, just clumsy. Should I say something?

I had a miscarriage last week at 11 weeks; physically I'm recovering fine. I'd told my three closest friends, who are in my book club with me (next meeting Thursday), about the pregnancy a couple of weeks ago, so they need to know. I don't want to talk about it much yet and I don't want them to be weird around me.
我和女朋友小林上周领证结婚了，决定不办婚礼，两个人去云南旅行就算了。爸妈提前知道，也支持。春节回老家想给长辈敬酒。现在想在家族群里说一声，怕长辈们觉得没被尊重。

I'm Sarah. My dad Dave died peacefully on Sunday after a short illness. He bowled in a Thursday-night league for 20 years and I'm in their WhatsApp group because I set it up for him. The funeral is Friday Oct 9 at 11am at St Mary's in Harrow. I need to tell them, and I'll pass on their messages to Mum.

I'm gay, I've known for a while and I'm happy about it. I'm planning to come out to my parents in person at Thanksgiving. I want to tell my older sister Megan first, by text tonight since she lives in Denver, and ask her not to say anything to Mom and Dad yet.
