Last week everyone sat there with cameras on in total silence. All I know is the tutor said people are joining from London, Lagos and Toronto; I'm in London.

Ich gebe eine Einweihungsparty. Meine Kollegin Anke und mein Nachbar Jürgen stehen seit ein paar Minuten schweigend nebeneinander am Buffet. Anke ist gerade vom Wandern in Portugal zurück, und Jürgen will nächstes Jahr den Jakobsweg in Portugal gehen.

I'm Claire, a partner at an architecture firm. At our intern welcome drinks tonight, one of the new interns, Ben, is standing alone near me looking nervous. All I know is he's from Glasgow and his portfolio had a library project with a reading room lit from the north.
坐高铁从北京去上海，要五个多小时。邻座是个三十岁左右的女生，在看迟子建的《额尔古纳河右岸》，这本我去年读过，特别喜欢。想聊两句，又怕打扰她看书。
公司团建烧烤，我和财务部的小周聊了十几分钟，一直是我问她答，感觉像在面试她。她刚说最近周末在学手冲咖啡，老是冲得太酸。我自己每天早上就喝速溶。
健身房认识的刘哥，每次练完都在休息区聊几句。今天他突然问：“你们做程序员的，一个月得三四万吧？”我不想聊工资，但也不想冷场。他上周说在准备11月的半程马拉松。

We're hosting a 16-year-old exchange student, Haruto, from Osaka for three weeks, and he arrives tonight. His English is basic, and his profile says he loves baseball and his mum's okonomiyaki. I know nothing about baseball, and I want an easy first thing to say at dinner that doesn't feel like a quiz.

I'm Leah, in the London finance team. Our company's Slack bot has paired me for a 'virtual coffee' with Tomás from the Madrid sales team, whom I've never met. His Slack status is a surfboard emoji and his profile says 'learning to surf, badly', I'm free most afternoons this week for the 20-minute call, and I want to send the first message so it doesn't feel like a form.

I've signed up with a befriending scheme, and tomorrow is my first Tuesday visit to Evelyn, 91, at her care home. The coordinator told me she was a primary school teacher for 40 years, and there's a framed photo of a little sailing boat on her windowsill. I'm Josh and I'm worried we'll just sit in silence.

Entrei para o coral do bairro aqui em Porto Alegre há duas semanas e, no intervalo do ensaio, acabo ficando sozinha num canto. A senhora que canta ao meu lado, Dona Célia, está no coral há 20 anos e hoje trouxe um bolo de fubá para todo mundo. Quero puxar conversa com ela no intervalo de hoje.

Last month I asked my neighbour Frank to cut back his hedge because it was blocking our shared path. He did it within a week, but since then we just nod stiffly at each other. He's out most Saturday mornings polishing his old green convertible, and I'd like to break the ice this Saturday.

I'm Priya, at a local product managers' meetup where I don't know anyone. Three people by the drinks are debating whether AI note-takers in meetings are worth it, and I've just started trialling one at work. I want to join without barging in.

I'm at a local tech meetup and have been chatting with Derek for 25 minutes about his home brewing; it was fun, and he's got me curious about trying a stout. I want to catch tonight's speaker, Amara, before she leaves, and I'd like to stay in touch with Derek.

For two months I've chatted with another mum at the poolside during our kids' Saturday swim lessons, and we've never swapped names; I only know her son is Arlo. Last week she said she was starting a pottery course on Wednesday evenings. I'm Hannah, and it feels too late to ask her name, but I want to.
每周日晚上跟老家的爸爸视频，他总是“都挺好”“吃了”，三分钟就说挂了吧。妈妈偷偷告诉我，他今年在阳台种了一排辣椒，最近结果了，天天去看。我在上海，一盆植物都没养活过。

My friend Priya's Instagram has been posting stories all morning about making $8,000 with a crypto 'mentor' and tagging people to DM him. Priya would never post that, and her phone number is saved in my contacts.
我爸最近总跟我说他在一个'理财群'里跟着'老师'炒股赚了不少，还说老师让他加大投入、别跟家里人说。我很担心，但他很好面子。我这周六回家。
My neighbour Gary (retired, 70s) just told me he clicked a parcel delivery text link yesterday and paid a £1.99 redelivery fee with his card. Now he's worried. I'm home all afternoon.

I do the accounts at a small architecture firm. Got an email that looks like it's from our print supplier Linden Press saying they've changed banks and we should pay their $6,420 invoice to a new account by Thursday. The address looks right but it feels off. Our contact there is Marcus, whose details we have on file, and my direct line is 555 0148.
我姑姑昨天接到一个电话，声音特别像我表弟，说在外地出了车祸要她马上转3万，还不让告诉别人。幸好她打了表弟本人电话。想在家族群里提醒长辈们，但不想让姑姑难堪。

My mom (68) has been chatting for 3 months with a man on Facebook called Richard who says he's an engineer on an oil rig. Now he wants $2,500 from her for a 'customs fee' to ship his things. She gets defensive when I bring it up. I can go over on Saturday.

Someone texted pretending to be WhatsApp support and I gave them my 6-digit code. Now I'm locked out and my account is messaging my contacts asking for money. I've reported it to WhatsApp. What do I post on Instagram and text to my family?

Soy Lucía Romero. Me ha llegado un WhatsApp de un número que no conozco diciendo que son de Recursos Humanos de Hogar Sur, la cadena de tiendas, y que me ofrecen trabajar desde casa dando 'me gusta' a vídeos por 350 euros al día. Me piden que conteste SÍ. En su web oficial, que he buscado yo, aparece empleo@example.com. Me huele raro, pero estoy buscando trabajo de verdad.

Just got a text from a number I don't know, 415 555 0192: 'Hi it's Dana, stuck in a board meeting, need you to buy five $100 gift cards for a client and text me photos of the codes, I'll pay you back today.' Dana is my manager and I only started two weeks ago, and we talk on Slack every day. I don't want to look stupid by checking.
我在闲鱼上卖一台二手平板电脑，标价2300。有个买家说要走'担保交易'，让我加他微信，再点他发的链接'开通商家保证金'，还说不开通的话货款会被冻结。

I'm moving to Lisbon and found a one-bed on Facebook for €750 a month, well below other listings. The 'landlord', Mark, says he's working in Dubai, can't do viewings, and wants a €1,500 deposit by bank transfer today to hold it, then he'll post the keys. I'll be in Lisbon this weekend.

Text from an unknown number: 'Hi Mum, dropped my phone in the sink, this is my new number. Can you pay a £480 bill for me today? My banking app won't work on this phone.' My son Jamie is 23 and his number is still saved in my phone. I want to check with him without replying to the new one.

For the last hour my phone keeps showing sign-in approval requests for my work account that I didn't start, about ten so far, and I haven't approved any. Now someone called 'IT Helpdesk - Tom' has messaged me on Teams from an outside account telling me to approve the next one so he can 'fix a sync problem'. Our real IT service desk is extension 4400 and servicedesk@example.com.

J'ai reçu ce matin un SMS « des impôts » qui m'annonce un remboursement de 312 euros, avec un lien pour saisir ma carte bancaire. Je n'ai pas cliqué. Je veux demander à ma comptable, Hélène Martin, à qui j'écris d'habitude par mail, si un remboursement est vraiment prévu.
我是林小雨的妈妈，她在三年级二班，班主任是王老师。今晚班级家长群里有个和王老师同名同头像的账号发了收款二维码，说每位家长交380元资料费，晚上8点前截止。我手机里存着王老师开学时给的电话。
我妈今天上午电脑弹出一个窗口，说电脑中了病毒，让她打上面的“技术支持”电话。她打了，对方让她装了一个远程控制软件，还让她登录网银“检查账户安全”。她刚在微信上跟我说了，我在公司，下午6点下班。

Ich heiße Sabine Koch. Gerade hat mich jemand angerufen, angeblich von der Betrugsabteilung meiner Bank, die angezeigte Nummer sah aus wie die echte: Mein Konto sei gehackt, ich solle meine 8.400 Euro Ersparnisse heute auf ein „sicheres Konto“ überweisen. Ich habe aufgelegt, nichts überwiesen und keine Daten genannt, und rufe jetzt selbst die Nummer auf meiner Karte an.

In August I lost $3,200 to a fake crypto trading site and reported it to the police; my case reference is 26-08814 and the officer is Detective Sergeant Ruiz, ds.ruiz@example.com. Today a 'Funds Recovery Bureau' emailed saying they've traced my money and can get it back for a $450 release fee, and they quoted my case number. I haven't replied.

My son Leo, 15, just told me, shaking, that someone he met in a gaming chat got him to send a private photo and is now demanding $500 in gift cards by midnight or they'll send it to his friends and his school. He hasn't paid or replied. He said he's so ashamed he wishes he was dead.
中学からの友達の美咲のLINEアカウントから「写真コンテストに出てるから投票して！」とリンクが届き、続けて「本人確認のためにSMSに届いた6桁のコードを送って」と来た。リンクは押していない。美咲の電話番号は前から登録してある。

I run a small bakery, Rye & Crumb, and our real Instagram is @ryeandcrumb. Since yesterday a fake account, @ryeandcrumb.giveaway, using our logo has been DMing our followers saying they've won a hamper and need to pay $9.99 shipping through a link. Two customers have messaged us asking if it's real, and one of them has already paid.
大学室友阿伟（认识八年了）今晚在微信上找我，说他在做“跑分”兼职，想借我的银行卡帮他收几笔“货款”，每收1万给我200块好处费，钱一到账就转走。我觉得不对劲，不想借，也想提醒他。他的手机号我一直存着。

My school friend Nina posted a link in our six-person WhatsApp group: 'Free $250 grocery voucher for every household, just enter your card details to claim!' It's really her, she says her sister sent it to her, and two people have already asked if it works. I haven't clicked it.

My gran, Edna, who's 84, just phoned me: a man calling himself DC Hughes from a police fraud squad told her staff at her bank are stealing from customers, and asked her to withdraw £4,000 in cash tomorrow and hand it to a courier at her door at 2pm 'as evidence', and to tell nobody. She hasn't withdrawn anything. I'm her granddaughter Sophie and I can be at hers by 1pm tomorrow.

On Wednesday 30 September $300 landed in my account from a name I don't know, Jordan Pell. Today a text from 555-0163 says it was sent to me by mistake and asks me to send it back to a different account 'urgently'. I haven't replied or sent anything, and I want to message my bank through its app.

I applied for a remote data entry job on a job board, and today someone calling herself Karen from Brightloop Staffing messaged me on Telegram saying I'm hired without an interview. She wants photos of my passport and both sides of my bank card by tonight for 'payroll setup'. I haven't sent anything, and the Brightloop website, which I looked up myself, lists careers@example.com.
我是3栋1201的住户。今天下午两个人敲门，说是燃气公司来做安全检查，说我家燃气软管老化必须马上换，要收280元，还不让我先打电话问。我没开门，他们接着去敲隔壁了。物业服务中心的电话我手机里一直存着，想先问物业有没有安排这次检查。

I'm Dee, admin of our Millbrook neighbourhood WhatsApp group. After last week's flooding, Rosa Kim, who manages the community centre, posted on Monday that donations are only being collected at the centre's front desk, and I have her number saved. Today a number I don't know, 555-0187, posted a bank account claiming to be 'Rosa's relief team' and asking everyone to transfer money by tonight; I've deleted the post.

I'm Nadia, a piano teacher. A new student's father, Paul Grady, who I've only dealt with by email, mailed me a cheque for $1,850 for ten lessons at $85 each, then said it was a mistake and asked me to send the $1,000 difference today by bank transfer to his 'assistant'. I deposited it yesterday, my banking app already shows the money as available, I haven't sent anything, and I'm messaging my bank through its app.

I lead a six-person marketing team. This morning our copywriter Ines Duarte's work email sent all of us a 'Q4 bonus review' link asking us to sign in to view it. IT has confirmed her account was compromised and asked me to warn the team in our Slack channel; Ines is on a flight until 6pm.

My dad Frank, 71, is selling his old lawnmower for $120 on a local marketplace. He's just texted me that a buyer called Kevin wants to 'make sure he's real' before driving over, so Kevin is sending a 6-digit code to Dad's phone and Dad should read it back; Dad says he'll do it in five minutes. The text with the code says not to share it with anyone.

I'm Priya Shah. Yesterday I posted publicly that Skyvale Air lost my suitcase; my claim reference is LB-7731. Within minutes an account called @SkyvaleCare_Help, using the airline's logo, replied asking me to DM my phone number and card details so they can pay compensation. I haven't replied, and I'm writing to the airline through the chat in its own app.

Meu irmão Rafael, de 34 anos, colocou R$ 5.000 num aplicativo chamado Lucro Certo que promete 3% de rendimento por dia e quer colocar mais R$ 10.000 na semana que vem; ele também me chamou para entrar. Ontem eu disse que parecia golpe e ele ficou bravo, disse que eu estou com inveja. Ele nunca tentou sacar nada e eu não quero que ele pare de falar comigo.

I'm Tom Reyes. Last night I paid $240 by bank transfer to a seller called Jade in a fan group on social media for two concert tickets, and this morning she's blocked me and the post is gone. I'm calling my bank's fraud line on the number on the back of my card and want to know what to say.
我和室友小雨在墨尔本读书。她今天下午接到自称“中国大使馆”和“公安”的电话，说她涉嫌洗钱，要她保密、一个人去住酒店、开着视频随时汇报；她刚在微信上跟我说今晚不回宿舍了，让我别告诉别人。她的手机号我存着，我现在在宿舍。

I'm Sam Ellis, buying my first flat, 4 Rowan Court, with completion next Friday. This morning an email that looks like it's from my solicitor, Anjali Mehta at Kettlewell Conveyancing, said their bank details have changed and asked me to transfer the £38,500 deposit to the new account by 5pm tomorrow. I haven't sent anything; I'm calling her direct line from the engagement letter they posted me in August, 0161 496 0723.

My team member Priya's last day is 30 October; she's leaving to start a PhD in computational biology, after two years with us. Marcus takes over her forecasting pipeline. She's happy for me to share that, and send-off drinks are on the 29th. Slack post to our team of 8.

I have to announce our team is joining the weekend on-call rotation from Nov 1, one weekend in six, with a paid day off in lieu. The reason: we now run the payments service, and weekend incidents were landing on two burnt-out people. People will hate it.
I announced a hiring freeze and the Slack thread got heated, people asking if layoffs are next. The freeze covers new roles only, and I honestly don't know yet what next year's budget looks like.
我是部门经理，公司刚决定今年的年终奖从原定的1月底推迟到明年3月发，金额按原方案不变，原因是四季度两笔大客户回款要到2月才到账。我同意这个决定，要在部门微信群里通知12个人，肯定有人不高兴。

I've resigned to lead a data team at a smaller company; my last day is Oct 30. I've told my boss Dana and she'll be interim manager for my team of 6 until they hire; their roles, projects and review dates don't change. Need to tell the team in our Thursday meeting and then post it in Slack.

I'm promoting Marisol to lead of our 5-person support team starting Monday Oct 5. She's run escalations since spring and cut first responses from 9 hours to 3; from the week of Oct 12 the team's 1:1s move to her and I'll meet each person monthly. Dev and Kate also applied and I've already told them 1:1. Slack post to the team.

This morning we laid off 3 people from my team of 11: Jonah, Wei and Carla. I told each of them myself at 9, then held a call with the other 8 at 11. Now I need the written summary for our team Slack. The cause is the Northwind contract ending in August; I agreed with the decision. Their accounts go to Priti, Sam and me. The other 8 keep their roles and pay, and we have an employee assistance programme. No more cuts are planned for us, but I can't see past March.
我带一个10人的销售团队，第三季度目标1200万，最后完成了970万，大概81%。主要是华信和德润两个大单推迟到第四季度签。这个目标当初我也同意了。第四季度重点客户从15家收窄到8家，11月中旬加一次中期复盘。明天周会讲完，要在部门群里发一条总结。
我是研发经理，10月12日周一有位新同事加入：高级后端工程师赵一鸣，之前在一家支付公司做了六年，来了负责对账系统。这半年对账一直是阿伟一个人扛着。想在部门群里发个欢迎。

Reorg: from Monday Nov 2, two of my 9 analysts, Hugo and Rina, move to the Growth team under Carmen and take the marketing dashboards with them. Growth wants analysts inside the team, and I agreed. The other seven stay with me, with the same role and pay, and marketing requests will go to Growth instead of our queue. Hugo and Rina will run handover sessions the weeks of Oct 12 and Oct 19. I told Hugo and Rina 1:1 yesterday. Posting in team Slack after today's meeting.

My report Daniel is going on medical leave from Monday Oct 5 for about three months. He's asked me to say only that it's a health matter and that he'd rather not be asked about it. I've already told Aisha and Ben: Aisha covers his Harwick and Lume accounts, Ben the Friday reporting. Posting in our team Slack of 7.

Our teammate Samir died suddenly on Sunday. His family has said we can share the news and that funeral details will follow. We have an employee assistance programme. I told my team of 9 on a call this morning and now need the written follow-up in our Slack.

From Friday 1 January, my design team of 7 moves from reporting into Product to reporting into Marketing, so design sits with the brand work it mostly serves; my own manager changes, their day-to-day work, pay and projects don't. I planned to tell them at Thursday's team meeting, but a slide about it leaked into the all-company Slack this morning and people are DMing me. I want to post in our team channel now.

Leadership just cancelled Project Atlas, the billing redesign my team of 6 has spent five months on, to put everyone on reliability after this quarter's outages. I argued to finish phase one and lost, but I agree with the call overall. The invoice engine they built will be folded into the current billing system. Their roles, pay and team stay the same, and reliability work starts Monday 5 October. I'm telling the team at standup tomorrow morning, then posting the summary in Slack.

On Monday I posted in our team Slack that everyone's 4% raise lands in the October 31 paycheck. HR just told me it's actually the November 30 paycheck, backdated to October 1, so nobody loses money but it arrives a month later. A couple of my 8 reports told me they were counting on it.
我管一个8人的运营团队。组员王磊从今天起不在公司了，是公司和我一起做的决定，HR要求不能透露原因。他负责的华东区门店活动交给小陈，华南区交给阿琳，两人已经单独聊过。想在团队群里说一声，免得大家乱猜。
我是设计部经理，带9个人。公司决定12月1日（周二）起从徐汇搬到张江办公，原因是现在的租约到期，张江的新场地能把三个部门放在一起。不少同事通勤会多40分钟以上。公司给每人每月500元交通补贴，11月16日到27日全员居家办公。具体工位安排我还不知道，HR说10月底出。

I run the night shift at a warehouse, 22 people. On Monday night a forklift reversing out of aisle 9 missed a picker by about a foot; nobody was hurt. From tonight, pedestrians stay out of any aisle with a forklift in it and drivers sound the horn at every aisle end. I covered it at the start-of-shift huddle and want the written version in our WhatsApp group.

Dirijo un equipo de 7 personas en una empresa de software en Sevilla. Hoy se ha anunciado que nos compra el grupo Nortia, porque necesitamos su red comercial para crecer fuera de España, y la operación se cierra el 1 de diciembre. Hasta entonces no cambian contratos, sueldos ni proyectos; lo que pase después lo sabremos antes del 15 de noviembre. Yo apoyo la operación y quiero escribir en el Slack del equipo justo después del comunicado general.

Leadership approved my pitch for my team of 8 to trial a four-day week from Monday 2 November to Friday 29 January: Fridays off, same pay, same targets. I pitched it because our ticket volume halves on Fridays. Two people will cover urgent tickets each Friday on a rota and take the following Monday off. If response times go above 4 hours, the trial ends. I'll post the rota by Friday 16 October. Announcing in Slack.

I manage 12 consultants. From Monday 2 November everyone logs billable hours daily in our time tracker instead of once on Fridays, because two clients disputed invoices last quarter and we couldn't back up £38,000 of billed hours. I agreed with the change. Each week I'll only look at totals per client, not anyone's day-by-day hours. I'm posting in our team channel and I expect people to read it as surveillance.

I manage a garden centre with 14 staff. Head office has decided no new holiday requests can be approved from Saturday 28 November to Thursday 24 December, our busiest weeks for Christmas trees; I agreed with it. Leave that's already approved stands, everyone gets at least one full weekend off in that period, and I'll post the December rota by Friday 16 October. Posting in our staff WhatsApp group.

Leadership has decided that my team of 10, fully remote since 2021, moves to two office days a week, Tuesday and Wednesday, from Monday 4 January, because cross-team projects stalled this year. I argued against it and lost, and I don't want to badmouth it or pretend I agree. Anyone living more than 50 miles from the office can apply to HR for an exception by Friday 13 November. I'm posting in Slack after telling them on a call.

Alex on my team of 9 has asked me to let everyone know she's now going by Ash and uses she/her, starting today. She asked me to mention her old name once so nobody is confused, and to ask people not to quiz her about it. Her email and Slack name change on Monday 5 October. Posting in our team Slack.
我带一个11人的数据团队。公司决定从明年1月1日起，每人每年的培训预算从8000元降到4000元，原因是今年海外业务亏损要控制成本，这个决定我同意。已经审批过的课程和考试照常报销，10月31日前提交的申请也按8000元的旧标准审。想在团队群里通知大家。
私は課長で部下は6名です。11月2日（月）から来年2月26日（金）まで育児休業を取ります。その間は田中さんが課長代理となり、休暇申請や経費の承認も田中さんに移ります。メンバーの担当業務や評価の時期は変わりません。引き継ぎ資料は10月23日（金）までに共有する予定で、チームのSlackで知らせたいです。
我是商场里一家服装店的店长，带8个店员，国庆期间照常营业。台风明天10月2日（周五）白天登陆，商场刚通知明天全天闭店，公司决定明天排班的同事不用来，当天工资照发。想今晚在门店群里通知大家。

I manage a café with 9 part-time staff. From Monday 2 November to Friday 26 February we'll close at 3pm on weekdays instead of 6pm, because weekday afternoon sales have dropped by about half since the office block next door emptied; the owner and I decided it together. That's 15 fewer weekday shift-hours a week across the team, I'll spread it so nobody loses more than 3 hours a week, weekend hours don't change, and the rota goes up by Friday 16 October. I've told Jade and Tomasz, who are hit hardest, in person, and now I'm posting in the staff WhatsApp group.
我带一个7人的测试团队。同事小何休了三个月病假，10月12日（周一）回来上班，前六周每周只上三天（周一、周二、周四），这段时间先不接紧急任务。她同意我在群里说这些，希望大家像平常一样对她，不要问病情。她休假期间的回归测试由阿凯代管，回来后先交还一半，具体怎么分他们俩这周定。

I manage a 10-person customer support team. From Monday 2 November a contracted team of six in Kraków, from a vendor called Northgate Support, takes over our overnight chat queue, because we can't cover nights without people working 2am shifts; I agreed with the decision. Nobody on my team loses their job, hours or pay, but the contract has a one-year review and I can't promise what happens after it. I'm posting in team Slack and I know people will read it as the start of outsourcing.
我是一家美发店的店长，带10个发型师和助理。总部决定从11月1日（周日）起，办卡提成从个人提成改成全店按月平分，原因是之前出现过抢客、互相挖顾客的情况，客诉也多了，我同意这个决定。按过去三个月的数据算，大部分人到手变化在正负300元以内；前三个月谁比原来少拿超过300元，差额公司补。想在门店群里通知大家。

I manage 9 account executives. From Monday 2 November, HR is changing job titles company-wide so ours match the other offices and internal moves are simpler: 'Senior Account Executive' becomes 'Account Executive II' and 'Account Executive' becomes 'Account Executive I', with pay, bands, duties and promotion criteria unchanged; I agree with it, and HR publishes the full ladder by Friday 16 October. Four of my people lose 'Senior' and will read it as a demotion, especially with clients; I've already told those four one to one, and now I'm posting in team Slack.

I manage a team of 7 engineers. The company has just decided there will be no salary increases in the January pay review, because new orders are down about 20% this year; I agree with the decision. The 2026 bonuses are still being paid as planned in March, and leadership will look again in July at whether a mid-year review is possible, but nobody can promise one. I'm telling the team on our Monday call and then posting in our Teams channel.
我带一个15人的客服团队。公司决定取消今年1月的年会，原因是今年利润下滑要控制费用，这个决定我同意，往年大家很期待年会抽奖。公司会给每人发一张300元购物卡，春节前随工资一起发；我们部门可以自己聚一次餐，人均150元由部门经费出。想在部门群里通知，顺便让大家投票选聚餐时间。

I manage a team of 12 at a logistics firm. On Tuesday a spreadsheet with all 12 of our home addresses and personal phone numbers was emailed by mistake to an external supplier, Brackwell Freight; they've confirmed in writing that they deleted it, and IT says no bank details were in it. I see it as a gap in how we stored the list, not one person's fault, so I won't name who sent it; from Monday staff contact details move to a restricted HR folder, and IT security will take a call with anyone who wants one before next Friday. Posting in team Slack.
我带一个9人的内容运营组。小罗10月30日（周五）调去品牌部，公司决定她的岗位不补人，这个决定我同意。她负责的公众号从日更改成每周三更，小红书交给阿美，视频号暂停到明年1月，其他人的工作不变。我已经单独跟小罗和阿美聊过，11月底会复盘一次大家的工作量，想在组里群发通知。
My colleague Kim just sent the all-company email for Friday's town hall, and the Zoom link goes to last month's meeting, which is expired. She's a peer.
好朋友小雨最近口气有点重，下周三我们要一起做模拟面试，我觉得应该告诉她。想私下发微信。
I manage a small warehouse office team. One of my reports, Derek, has had noticeable body odour for a few weeks and two people have mentioned it to me. I need to raise it with him privately.

My director Helen is presenting to the board on Zoom right now and she's sharing her whole screen. Her Slack notifications keep popping up in the corner, including one from HR about restructuring. I'm in the meeting.

I told my gym buddy Marcus, privately, that there's been a strong smell after our sessions lately. He replied 'wow, ok, thanks for that I guess' and has been short with me since. We train together Tuesdays and Thursdays.
A teammate who joined six weeks ago, Tom, keeps calling me Nicole. My name is Nicola. I let it go too long and he's now said it in meetings a dozen times. We get on well.
好朋友小婷刚在我们大学同学群里发了婚礼电子请柬，上面写的是“10月18日（星期六）”，可我查了，今年10月18日是星期日。群里有三十多个人，她可能还发给了长辈。
A woman from finance I've only met once, Joanne, is about to walk on stage to present at our all-hands, and the back of her skirt is tucked into her tights. We're both standing in the side corridor.
朋友阿琳开了家烘焙小店，刚在朋友圈发了国庆上新的海报，上面写着“巴斯克蛋糕 6寸 ¥18.8”，店里实际卖188。下面已经有好几个人评论说要订了。

Le dije a mi compañera Lucía, por mensaje privado y justo antes de una reunión, que tenía pintalabios en los dientes; lo acababa de ver. Se lo quitó, pero me escribió: «Qué vergüenza, ¿desde cuándo lo tenía?». Nos llevamos bien.

Minha colega de trabalho Carla me mandou por engano no WhatsApp um áudio que claramente era para o marido, sobre uma briga dos dois. Ouvi só os primeiros segundos, parei e apaguei. A gente se dá bem, mas não somos próximas.
My mother-in-law, Linda, just posted a photo of her new credit card in the family WhatsApp group (about 30 people) to say it finally arrived. You can see the full card number and the expiry date.

My manager, Farah, just posted on LinkedIn welcoming our new hire Siobhan Walsh, but spelled her name 'Shivon' and tagged a different Siobhan Walsh. It already has 40 likes. I'm fairly junior on the team.
儿子14岁，上初二，最近打完球回家身上汗味很重，他自己好像没察觉。想今晚单独跟他说，又怕伤他自尊。

My friend Sam is best man at his brother Chris's wedding on Saturday and sent me the slideshow to check. Slide 23, a group photo at the lake, clearly shows Chris's ex, Jess, standing next to him. The bride's whole family will be watching.
先輩の田中さんと、昼にニンニクたっぷりのラーメンを食べたあと、これから客先訪問です。田中さんの口臭が気になりますが、本人は気づいていないようです。移動中に二人きりなので、今言いたいです。ミントタブレットを持っています。

I just found my colleague Dan's resignation letter in the shared printer by the kitchen. Nobody else was around, so I turned it face down in the tray and didn't read past the first line. We're friendly but not close, and I want to DM him.
女儿的同学朵朵周末在我们家过夜，两个孩子玩得很开心。昨晚给朵朵梳头时，我看到她头发里有几只虱子和虱卵。我和朵朵妈妈只是接孩子时认识，想私下发微信告诉她。
明天上午要和同事小王一起去客户公司提案，对方负责人姓单，读shàn。今天周会上小王一直叫他“dān总”，说了好几次，他自己没发现。我们是平级，想私下微信提醒他。
部门线上周会，二十多个人在线。同事老周讲完他的部分后忘了关麦，现在大家都能听到他在跟家里人商量孩子补课的钱，主持人还没发现。我想私聊提醒他。
Voy en el metro de Madrid y la señora mayor sentada a mi lado lleva el bolso abierto; se le ve la cartera encima de todo. No la conozco y no quiero asustarla ni que parezca que la estaba mirando.

Ma collègue Sophie partage son agenda avec tout le service, une quarantaine de personnes, et ses rendez-vous du mardi soir s'affichent en clair : « Psy, Dr Morel ». On s'entend bien sans être proches, et je veux lui écrire en privé.

I teach a Tuesday and Thursday evening strength class. One of my regulars, Jen, wore black leggings today that went see-through under the studio lights every time we did squats, and she clearly hadn't noticed. I want to say something quietly after class.
好朋友阿敏明天上午10点要视频面试，今晚跟我视频练习。她身后的晾衣架上挂着几件内衣，镜头里看得很清楚，她自己没发现。
My desk neighbour Priya came back from two weeks' holiday on Monday, but her out-of-office is still on: I got it again when I emailed her this morning. We get on well and she clearly hasn't noticed.

My friend Hannah just posted an Instagram story ranting about her boss by name, and it went to all her followers, not just her close friends list. I know a few of her coworkers follow her. It's been up about ten minutes.

It's 11pm and I've just noticed my downstairs neighbour's car boot is wide open in our building's car park, with a laptop bag on show. I don't have his number, but I know he lives in flat 1B. I'm Ana from 2A and I'm going to knock on his door.

At my sister Mia's wedding reception, my dad Ray, who's 72, is about to stand up for his speech and his hearing aid is whistling loudly. Everyone at our table can hear it except him. I'm sitting right next to him.

I'm at my friend Leo's flat for a dinner party with eight of us. I'm helping in the kitchen while he carves his first ever roast chicken, and the meat by the bone is still pink with red juices. The plates haven't gone out yet and nobody else has seen it.
好朋友小美正在直播卖她自己做的手工香皂，现在在讲薰衣草款，但直播间挂出来的购物链接是玫瑰款，评论区已经有人在问了。我在看直播，想马上在微信上私信提醒她。

My mum, 78, has always been really particular about her clothes, but the last few times I've visited, her cardigans have had food stains down the front. Her eyesight has got worse since the spring and she's on the waiting list for a cataract operation. I'm seeing her on Sunday and want to mention it gently, once.

I've been dating Jonah for six weeks and really like him. His flat has a strong cat litter smell from his cat, Miso, and I think he's gone nose-blind to it. I'm staying over on Saturday and want to mention it once, kindly, by text beforehand.
我是外包设计师，甲方对接人刘经理刚在他们公司的公众号上发了周六读书会的推文，我扫了一下文中的报名二维码，打开的是去年的活动页面，已经显示“报名结束”。推文发出才二十分钟，我们只是工作上的合作关系。

I'm Maya Chen, a second-year student. My lecturer Dr Okafor just uploaded this week's slides to the course page, and slide 14 has a spreadsheet screenshot showing several students' names and their midterm marks. About 200 of us can see the page, and I want to email him privately.
我在二手平台上跟一个陌生卖家买了个书架，周三收到货，挺满意。翻她其他在售商品时发现，一张台灯照片的背景里有张快递单，能看清她的全名、小区地址和手机号。想通过平台私信提醒她。

I'm hosting a birthday barbecue in our garden. My partner's colleague Rachel, who I met an hour ago, has a period stain on the back of her light jeans and doesn't seem to have noticed. There's a spare cardigan on the hook by the back door and pads in the cabinet of the upstairs bathroom, and she's at the drinks table on her own right now.

I'm Clara. My neighbour Mrs. Alvarez watered my plants and fed my cat Pepper for 2 weeks while I was in Portugal. She left a little note saying Pepper slept on her lap. I want to leave a card with some pastéis de nata I brought back from a little bakery in Lisbon.
结婚的时候我大学导师陈老师随了2000块红包，还专门从成都赶来杭州参加婚礼，看到他坐在台下我特别感动。我们打算用这笔钱买一台一直想要的咖啡机，想给他发条微信好好谢谢。

My old manager Denise wrote me a reference in June for a role leading the analytics team at Harlow, and I got it. I've just finished my first quarter and I run my team a lot like she ran ours; she's in Leeds, where I visit now and then. I completely forgot to thank her and I feel awful.
私は佐藤美穂で、いま育休中。部長の山本さんから出産祝いにスタイ3枚セットと手書きのカードが届き、カードの「焦らずゆっくり」という一言に励まされた。来年4月に復帰予定で、メールでお礼を送りたい。
父亲上个月去世，他以前厂里的老同事刘叔前后忙了三天，帮着联系殡仪馆、招呼来吊唁的老工友。爸生前常说刘叔是厂里最靠得住的老哥们。我和我妈想等过了这阵请他来家里吃饭，先给他发条微信正式谢谢。

I'm Rachel and I live in Fairview. A stranger, Tomas, found my wallet on the 14 bus Saturday and drove it over to my flat because my licence had the address. Everything was still in it. He left his number on a note.
婆婆给我织了一件大红色的毛衣，老公建国说她每天晚上看电视的时候织，织了两个月，可颜色和款式我都不太会穿。想发微信谢谢她，但不想假装特别喜欢，不然以后得一直穿给她看。国庆我们打算回去看她。

I'm Claire Walsh. My dad, Peter, spent 9 days on Ward 7 at St. James's after a stroke and is home now, walking to the end of the road and back every morning. The nurses were incredible, especially Grace on nights, who sat with him at 3am when he was frightened; he still talks about it. I want to leave a card with a box of chocolates for the whole team.

My friend's brother Omar referred me for a product manager role at Fielding and spent half an hour on the phone explaining how their product team works the night before my final round. I didn't get it; they went with an internal candidate. I still want to thank him.

Je m'appelle Clara, j'habite à Nantes avec Hugo. J'ai passé le week-end chez les parents de mon copain Hugo, Martine et Gérard, à Quimper. Martine avait fait un kouign-amann maison et Gérard m'a emmenée voir le phare d'Eckmühl samedi matin. C'était notre première rencontre et je veux leur envoyer une carte.

After my divorce went through this summer, my friend Ben came over every Sunday evening for two months with takeaway to watch football with me so I wasn't alone. Those evenings got me through the worst of it, and I never properly thanked him. I started a new job on Monday and I'm doing much better; I want to text him.

I'm Maisie's mum; she's 7 and was terrified of putting her face in the water. Her swimming teacher, Coach Lena, spent the first three lessons just playing a 'blow bubbles at the fish' game with her on the steps, and last Saturday Maisie swam her first width. Her term ends next week, she's signed up again for next term, and I want to give Lena a card.
我9月中旬做了个小手术，请了两周假。同组的小周主动接了我手上两个客户项目，还每天下班前把进展整理成一页文档发给我，我回来第一天就接上了，客户那边一点没耽误。想在微信上好好谢谢她。
我叫林晓，2006届三班的。高三那年我差点退学，班主任王老师（教语文）每周五放学后把我留在办公室补课，还把她自己的复习笔记借给我。今年我出版了第一本书，刚从同学那拿到她的微信，想加上后好好谢谢她，也想寄一本书给她。

I'm leaving Fernhill Labs tomorrow, Friday, after six years. The design team chipped in for an old film camera, because years ago at a team lunch I once mentioned shooting film as a teenager, plus a book of handwritten notes from everyone. I want to post a thank-you in our #design Slack channel; leaving drinks are tomorrow evening.

I'm Jess. Our flat on Dunmore Street was gutted by a kitchen fire on 12 September; nobody was hurt. My friend Hollie set up a fundraiser and 64 people gave, which covered two months' rent on a temporary place and new school uniforms for our girls, Ava and Rose, who went back to school last week. I want to post a thank-you on the fundraiser page from me, my husband Martin and the girls.
女儿刚满月，老家82岁的姑婆（我爸的姑姑）托我爸带来一双她亲手做的虎头鞋，红底黄边，老虎胡子是一根根绣上去的。我爸说她眼睛不好，断断续续做了快一个月。她不怎么看手机，我想写几句短的，让表姐念给她听。我们打算过年带孩子回老家。
我在广州租王叔的房子住了三年，这周退租。这三年水管、热水器坏了，他都是当天就找人来修。验房时他说墙上的钉孔和厨房台面的小划痕都不算，4000押金全退了，还送了我一袋他自己种的芒果。想走之前发微信谢谢他。

My son Sami just turned 6. His grandpa Walt sent him a real wooden toolbox with a small hammer and a note saying 'for when you help me build the birdhouse next spring'. Sami has carried it everywhere for three days and already 'fixed' the wobbly leg on his bedroom chair. I want to help Sami write the card in his own words.

I'm Nadia and I run a one-woman bakery, Crumb & Co. A regular, Mr Okafor, told the owner of Harbour Café about my sourdough, and since September they've ordered 30 loaves every week, now my biggest account. I want to tuck a handwritten card into his usual Saturday order, with a loaf of the new rye I'm launching next month.

Me llamo Andrea Gil y este curso estudio el máster de enfermería en Zaragoza gracias a la Beca Elena Ruiz, de 4.000 euros, que creó la familia Ruiz en memoria de su hija Elena, enfermera de pediatría. Con la beca he podido dejar uno de mis dos trabajos de fin de semana y empezar las prácticas en la UCI pediátrica, y me emociona pensar que Elena trabajaba justo en lo que estoy aprendiendo. La fundación me pide una carta de agradecimiento para la familia, a la que no conozco.

I'm Hannah. Our 14-year-old beagle, Pickle, was put to sleep at Willow Lane Vets on Monday and went peacefully. Dr. Osei came in early so we didn't have to wait in the busy waiting room and let us stay with him on his blanket the whole time, and the nurse, Sam, sent us his paw print in clay two days later. We'll keep bringing our cat, Mabel, to them, and I want to send the practice a card.

Me chamo Beatriz e moro em Lisboa. A vizinha da minha mãe em Curitiba, Dona Lurdes, passou três tardes ensinando a minha mãe, Dona Neusa, de 79 anos, a fazer videochamada no celular e escreveu o passo a passo num caderninho para ela. Desde então eu e minha mãe nos vemos por vídeo todo domingo; vou a Curitiba em dezembro e quero mandar uma mensagem no WhatsApp para a Dona Lurdes.

I'm Tom, 34. In March I had a stem cell transplant for leukaemia from an anonymous donor, and the donor registry lets me send a card through them with my first name only, no surnames, towns or hospital names. Six months on I'm cycling to work again, and last month I walked my daughter, who's 4, to her first day at nursery.
我在小红书发帖问申请英国社工硕士的个人陈述怎么写，一个叫“阿檬”的网友（她正在英国读社工）主动私信我，前后帮我改了三遍，还跟我视频聊了一个小时讲面试会问什么。面试时真的被问到了她提醒过的“为什么从会计转行”。今天我收到了第一志愿的offer，我们从没见过面。

Ich bin Emma, 17, und war drei Monate als Austauschschülerin bei meiner Gastfamilie in Bern, Petra, Urs und ihrer Tochter Lara; wir duzen uns alle. Urs hat mich jeden Samstag auf den Markt mitgenommen, Lara hat mir geduldig Berndeutsch beigebracht, und sie haben mich sogar zum 80. Geburtstag von Grosi Anni mitgenommen. Im Februar kommt Lara zum Gegenbesuch zu uns nach Hamburg, und ich will der Familie eine Karte schicken.

I'm Hannah. While I was working in Singapore from June to September, my younger brother Ollie drove Mum to all nine of her physio appointments after her hip replacement, and sent me a photo after every one so I didn't feel so far away. Mum's walking to the shops on her own again now. I'm back in Leeds next week and want to text him.

I'm Priya. Our nanny, Marta, leaves on Friday 9 October after four years with us, moving back to Kraków to be near her parents; she started when our son Arlo was 8 months old. She taught him to ride his bike in the park, and last week she gave us a little notebook she'd kept of all his 'firsts'. She's agreed Arlo can video call her on Sundays, and my husband Sam and I want to give her a card.

I'm Daniel. In June, Professor Anika Brandt, my PhD second reader, spent a weekend writing 11 pages of comments that took apart the argument in my chapter 3, and it stung at the time. I rewrote it from the ground up and yesterday the Tidewater Review accepted it as an article. She retires in December and I want to email her.
去年6月我失业，好朋友小敏二话没说借了我两万块，没要利息，一年多也从没催过，那段时间我就靠这笔钱交房租、安心找工作。今天我把最后5000转给她，两万全部还清了。她下个月过生日，一直想去吃的那家火锅我想请她。
上周六（9月26日）我搬家，同事大刘开着他的面包车帮我跑了三趟，从早上八点忙到下午三点，六楼没电梯，那台旧洗衣机是他跟我一起抬下去的，中午我只请他吃了碗面。想发微信好好谢谢他，请他下周五（10月9日）晚上来新家吃我做的饭；以后他搬家，我也一定去帮忙。

I'm Leila. My mum died on 14 September, and my team of 11 at work sent white lilies to the funeral and a card everyone signed; reading it the evening after the funeral really helped. My colleague Tom wrote that Mum's fruitcake at last year's Christmas fair was the best he'd ever had. I went back to work on Monday and want to post a short thank-you in our team Slack.

After my baby shower on Sunday I texted my aunt Rosa to thank her for the knitted blanket, but the blanket was from my cousin Elena; Rosa gave us the bath set with the hooded duck towel. Rosa replied '??'. We used the duck towel on our son Noah for his first bath at home last night, and he looked like a tiny duckling.
私は高橋健です。昨夜、取引先の株式会社ミナト精工の森部長に会食でご馳走になりました。森部長が話してくれた新人時代の工場での失敗談がとても印象に残り、この春に営業へ異動したばかりの私には励みになりました。来週火曜日の打ち合わせでまたお会いするので、今日中にお礼のメールを送りたいです。

I'm Hannah. On our overnight flight from Boston to Dublin on Tuesday, the woman next to me, Fiona, a grandmother of five, walked my 10-month-old son Leo up and down the aisle for almost an hour so I could eat and sleep. She gave me her email, fiona.byrne@example.com, and asked me to send her a photo of Leo once we'd landed; we're in Dublin for a month visiting my sister.
我是文创小店“青柚纸品”的老板阿岚。合作的印刷厂周厂长为了赶我们国庆前上架的新年台历，让工人连着加了三个晚上的班，还亲自开车把2000本送到我们仓库，比约定早了两天。台历上架三天卖出了800本。想发微信好好谢谢他，明年的台历我还想交给他们厂印。

I work at a small camera shop. A customer wants the $1,200 telephoto lens to shoot his kid's school soccer games from the sideline. The $450 70 to 300 is light and would do fine outdoors; the $1,200 one is mainly better in low light.

I'm the receptionist at a hair salon. A client booked a cut with Ines on Saturday at 11 and mentioned she wants to go lighter for her sister's wedding next month. Face-framing highlights in the same visit would be $95 more and take about an hour longer.
小さなお米屋をやっています。常連の田中さんが3ヶ月前に10kg買っていったので、そろそろかなと思ってLINEしたい。今年の新米のコシヒカリも入りました。
我是做小程序的外包，帮张姐的社区烘焙店做的点单小程序刚上线两周，线上单量涨了四成，她之前提过店里老客很多。我觉得下一步做会员积分对她很有用，开发大概6800元、两周能上线，但不想像在推销。

I'm a wedding photographer. A couple booked my 6-hour package ($2,800) for their wedding on Saturday 17 October, and I suggested adding a second shooter for $600 since they have 180 guests. The bride replied: 'We told you our budget is tight, can you please stop upselling us.'

I'm an account manager at a small scheduling software company. A dental practice, Bright Smile Dental, has paid our monthly plan ($89) for 14 months and renews Oct 12. Annual is $890, paid up front and refundable only in the first 30 days. Their office manager Tanya has never asked about it.

I run a cleaning service. Last week Nora booked a $110 standard clean for Thursday 1 October at 10am and said no when I mentioned the $40 oven add-on, which takes about 45 minutes. Now she's texted 'how much was the oven thing again? could you add it Thursday?'

Tenho uma oficina de bicicletas em Curitiba.
